--[[
	ZOffset Mixin  -  per-frame position shift along the particle-to-camera line for Part / Model /
	Attachment. Positive = closer to camera. Runs after Orientation so velocity derivation uses the
	pre-shifted position. Moves the visual and never turns it: the rotation it writes is the one the
	visual has (ApplyOrientation wrote it this frame, Orientation.luau, or the update's own).
]]

return function(Particle)

local EPS = 1e-3

function Particle:ApplyZOffset(pData, camPos)
	local zo = pData.ZOffset
	if not zo or zo == 0 then return end
	if not camPos then return end
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end

	local isModel = t == "Model"
	local isAttachment = t == "Attachment"
	local liveCF = isModel and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame
		-- The shift starts from the pre-overlay base position, so it is absolute; from the live position it would compound each frame.
	local baseCF = pData._postUpdateCF or liveCF

	-- Attachment.CFrame is parent-local; convert to world for the camera shift, back to local on write.
	local parentPart
	if isAttachment then
		parentPart = pData.VisualPart.Parent
		if parentPart and parentPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			baseCF = parentPart.CFrame * baseCF
			liveCF = parentPart.CFrame * liveCF
		else
			parentPart = nil
		end
	end

	local pos = baseCF.Position
	local toCam = camPos - pos
	local mag = toCam.Magnitude
	if mag < EPS then return end
	local newPos = pos + (toCam / mag) * zo
	local newCF = CFrame.new(newPos) * liveCF.Rotation

	if parentPart then
		newCF = parentPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newCF)
	end

	if isModel then
		pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(newCF)
	else
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = newCF
	end
end

end

--!native
--!optimize 2

local Types = require(script.Types)

local chunkReaders = require(script.chunks)
local crc32 = require(script.crc32)
local zlib = require(script.zlib)

local COLOR_TYPE_CHANNELS = {
	[0] = 1,
	[2] = 3,
	[3] = 1,
	[4] = 2,
	[6] = 4,
}

local INTERLACE_ROW_START = { 0, 0, 4, 0, 2, 0, 1 }
local INTERLACE_COL_START = { 0, 4, 0, 2, 0, 1, 0 }
local INTERLACE_ROW_INCR = { 8, 8, 8, 4, 4, 2, 2 }
local INTERLACE_COL_INCR = { 8, 8, 4, 4, 2, 2, 1 }

-- https://github.com/Kampfkarren/selene/issues/584
-- selene: allow(bad_string_escape)
local SIGNATURE = "\x89PNG\x0D\x0A\x1A\x0A"

export type PNG = Types.PNG

export type DecodeOptions = {
	allowIncorrectCRC: boolean?,
}

export type EncodeOptions = {
	width: number,
	height: number,
}

local function decode(buf: buffer, options: DecodeOptions?): PNG
	local bufLen = buffer.len(buf)
	assert(bufLen >= 8, "not a PNG")
	assert(buffer.readstring(buf, 0, 8) == SIGNATURE, "not a PNG")

	local chunks: { Types.Chunk } = table.create(3) -- minimal: IHDR, IDAT, IEND
	local offset = 8

	local skipCRC = options ~= nil and options.allowIncorrectCRC == true
	repeat
		local dataLength = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, offset))
		local chunkType = buffer.readstring(buf, offset + 4, 4)
		assert(string.match(chunkType, "%a%a%a%a"), `invalid chunk type {chunkType}`)

		local dataOffset = offset + 8
		local nextOffset = dataOffset + dataLength + 4
		assert(nextOffset <= bufLen, `EOF while reading {chunkType} chunk`)

		local chunkCode = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, nextOffset - 4))
		local expectCode = crc32(buf, offset + 4, nextOffset - 5)
		assert(skipCRC or chunkCode == expectCode, `incorrect checksum in {chunkType}`)

		table.insert(chunks, {
			type = chunkType,
			offset = dataOffset,
			length = dataLength,
		})
		offset = nextOffset
	until offset >= bufLen
	assert(offset == bufLen, "trailing data in file")

	for _, chunk in chunks do
		local t = chunk.type
		if bit32.extract(string.byte(t, 1, 1), 5) == 0 then
			if t ~= "IHDR" and t ~= "IDAT" and t ~= "PLTE" and t ~= "IEND" then
				error(`unhandled critical chunk {t}`)
			end
		end
	end

	local header: Types.IHDRChunk
	local headerChunk = chunks[1]
	assert(headerChunk.type == "IHDR", "first chunk must be IHDR")
	for i = 2, #chunks do
		assert(chunks[i].type ~= "IHDR", "multiple IHDR chunks are not allowed")
	end
	header = chunkReaders.IHDR(buf, headerChunk)

	local dataChunkIndex0 = -1
	local dataChunkIndex1 = -1
	local compressedDataLength = 0
	for i, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "IDAT" then
			if dataChunkIndex0 < 0 then
				dataChunkIndex0 = i
			else
				assert(i == dataChunkIndex1 + 1, "multiple IDAT chunks must be consecutive")
			end
			dataChunkIndex1 = i
			compressedDataLength += chunk.length
		end
	end
	assert(dataChunkIndex0 > 0, "no IDAT chunks")
	assert(compressedDataLength > 0, "no image data in IDAT chunks")

	local palette: Types.PLTEChunk?
	local paletteChunkIndex = -1
	for i, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "PLTE" then
			assert(not palette, "multiple PLTE chunks are not allowed")
			assert(i < dataChunkIndex0, "PLTE not allowed after IDAT chunks")
			assert(header.colorType ~= 0 and header.colorType ~= 4, "PLTE not allowed for color type")
			palette = chunkReaders.PLTE(buf, chunk, header)
			paletteChunkIndex = i
		end
	end
	if header.colorType == 3 then
		assert(palette ~= nil, "color type requires a PLTE chunk")
	end

	local transparencyData: Types.tRNSChunk?
	for i, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "tRNS" then
			assert(transparencyData == nil, "multiple tRNS chunks are not allowed")
			assert(i < dataChunkIndex0, "tRNS not allowed after IDAT chunks")
			assert(not palette or i > paletteChunkIndex, "tRNS must be after PLTE")
			assert(header.colorType ~= 4 and header.colorType ~= 6, "tRNS not allowed for color type")
			transparencyData = chunkReaders.tRNS(buf, chunk, header, palette)
		end
	end

	local finalChunk = chunks[#chunks]
	assert(finalChunk.type == "IEND", "final chunk must be IEND")
	assert(finalChunk.length == 0, "IEND chunk must be empty")
	for i = 2, #chunks - 1 do
		assert(chunks[i].type ~= "IEND", "multiple IEND chunks are not allowed")
	end

	local compressedData = buffer.create(compressedDataLength)
	local compressedOffset = 0
	for _, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "IDAT" then
			buffer.copy(compressedData, compressedOffset, buf, chunk.offset, chunk.length)
			compressedOffset += chunk.length
		end
	end

	local width = header.width
	local height = header.height
	local bitDepth = header.bitDepth
	local colorType = header.colorType
	local channels = COLOR_TYPE_CHANNELS[colorType]

	local rawSize = 0
	if not header.interlaced then
		rawSize = height * (math.ceil(width * channels * bitDepth / 8) + 1)
	else
		for i = 1, 7 do
			local w = math.ceil((width - INTERLACE_COL_START[i]) / INTERLACE_COL_INCR[i])
			local h = math.ceil((height - INTERLACE_ROW_START[i]) / INTERLACE_ROW_INCR[i])
			if w > 0 and h > 0 then
				local scanlineSize = math.ceil(w * channels * bitDepth / 8) + 1
				rawSize += h * scanlineSize
			end
		end
	end

	local paletteColors
	if palette then
		paletteColors = palette.colors
	end

	local rescale
	if colorType ~= 3 and bitDepth < 8 then
		rescale = 0xFF / (2 ^ bitDepth - 1)
	end

	local bpp = math.ceil(channels * bitDepth / 8)
	local defaultAlpha = 2 ^ bitDepth - 1

	local idx = 0
	local working = buffer.create(rawSize)
	local inflatedSize = zlib.inflate(compressedData, working)
	assert(inflatedSize == rawSize, "decompressed data size mismatch")

	local rgba8 = buffer.create(width * height * 4)

	local alphaGray = if transparencyData then transparencyData.gray else -1
	local alphaRed = if transparencyData then transparencyData.red else -1
	local alphaGreen = if transparencyData then transparencyData.green else -1
	local alphaBlue = if transparencyData then transparencyData.blue else -1

	local function pass(sx: number, sy: number, dx: number, dy: number)
		local w = math.ceil((width - sx) / dx)
		local h = math.ceil((height - sy) / dy)
		if w < 1 or h < 1 then
			return
		end

		local scanlineSize = math.ceil(w * channels * bitDepth / 8)
		local newIdx = idx

		for y = 1, h do
			local rowFilter = buffer.readu8(working, idx)
			idx += 1

			if rowFilter == 0 or (rowFilter == 2 and y == 1) then
				idx += scanlineSize
			elseif rowFilter == 1 then
				for x = 1, scanlineSize do
					local sub = if x <= bpp then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - bpp)
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + sub, 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			elseif rowFilter == 2 then
				for _ = 1, scanlineSize do
					local up = buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - 1)
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + up, 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			elseif rowFilter == 3 then
				for x = 1, scanlineSize do
					local sub = if x <= bpp then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - bpp)
					local up = if y == 1 then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - 1)
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + bit32.rshift(sub + up, 1), 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			elseif rowFilter == 4 then
				for x = 1, scanlineSize do
					local sub = if x <= bpp then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - bpp)
					local up = if y == 1 then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - 1)
					local corner = if x <= bpp or y == 1
						then 0
						else buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - bpp - 1)
					local p0 = math.abs(up - corner)
					local p1 = math.abs(sub - corner)
					local p2 = math.abs(sub + up - 2 * corner)
					local paeth = if p0 <= p1 and p0 <= p2 then sub elseif p1 <= p2 then up else corner
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + paeth, 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			else
				error("invalid row filter")
			end
		end

		local bit = 8
		local function readValue()
			local b = buffer.readu8(working, newIdx)
			if bitDepth < 8 then
				b = bit32.extract(b, bit - bitDepth, bitDepth)
				bit -= bitDepth
				if bit == 0 then
					bit = 8
					newIdx += 1
				end
			elseif bitDepth == 8 then
				newIdx += 1
			else
				b = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(b, 8), buffer.readu8(working, newIdx + 1))
				newIdx += 2
			end
			return b
		end

		for y = 1, h do
			newIdx += 1
			if bit < 8 then
				bit = 8
				newIdx += 1
			end

			for x = 1, w do
				local r, g, b, a

				if colorType == 0 then
					local gray = readValue()
					r = gray
					g = gray
					b = gray
					a = if gray == alphaGray then 0 else defaultAlpha
				elseif colorType == 2 then
					r = readValue()
					g = readValue()
					b = readValue()
					a = if r == alphaRed and g == alphaGreen and b == alphaBlue then 0 else defaultAlpha
				elseif colorType == 3 then
					local color = paletteColors[readValue() + 1]
					r = color.r
					g = color.g
					b = color.b
					a = color.a
				elseif colorType == 4 then
					local gray = readValue()
					r = gray
					g = gray
					b = gray
					a = readValue()
				elseif colorType == 6 then
					r = readValue()
					g = readValue()
					b = readValue()
					a = readValue()
				end

				local py = sy + (y - 1) * dy
				local px = sx + (x - 1) * dx
				local i = (py * width + px) * 4

				if rescale then
					r = math.round(r * rescale)
					g = math.round(g * rescale)
					b = math.round(b * rescale)
					a = math.round(a * rescale)
				elseif bitDepth == 16 then
					r = bit32.rshift(r, 8)
					g = bit32.rshift(g, 8)
					b = bit32.rshift(b, 8)
					a = bit32.rshift(a, 8)
				end

				buffer.writeu32(rgba8, i, bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(a, 24), bit32.lshift(b, 16), bit32.lshift(g, 8), r))
			end
		end
	end

	if not header.interlaced then
		pass(0, 0, 1, 1)
	else
		for i = 1, 7 do
			pass(INTERLACE_COL_START[i], INTERLACE_ROW_START[i], INTERLACE_COL_INCR[i], INTERLACE_ROW_INCR[i])
		end
	end

	local function readPixel(x: number, y: number)
		assert(x >= 1 and x <= width and y >= 1 and y <= height, "pixel out of range")

		local i = ((y - 1) * width + x - 1) * 4
		return buffer.readu8(rgba8, i),
			buffer.readu8(rgba8, i + 1),
			buffer.readu8(rgba8, i + 2),
			buffer.readu8(rgba8, i + 3)
	end

	return {
		width = width,
		height = height,
		pixels = rgba8,
		readPixel = readPixel,
	}
end

local function encode(pixels: buffer, options: EncodeOptions): buffer
	local width = options.width
	local height = options.height

	local dataSize = buffer.len(pixels)
	local expectSize = width * height * 4
	assert(dataSize == expectSize, `expected {expectSize} bytes, got {dataSize} bytes`)

	local imageDataRowSize = width * 4 + 1
	local imageData = buffer.create(height * imageDataRowSize)
	for row = 0, height - 1 do
		local sourceOffset = row * width * 4
		local targetOffset = row * imageDataRowSize
		buffer.writeu8(imageData, targetOffset, 0) -- filter method = 0
		buffer.copy(imageData, targetOffset + 1, pixels, sourceOffset, 4 * width)
	end

	local imageDataDeflated, imageDataDeflatedLength = zlib.deflate(imageData)
	local outputLength = 8 -- signature
		+ 25 -- IHDR
		+ (8 + imageDataDeflatedLength + 4) -- IDAT
		+ 12 -- IEND

	local output = buffer.create(outputLength)
	buffer.writestring(output, 0, SIGNATURE)

	-- IHDR
	buffer.writeu32(output, 8, bit32.byteswap(13)) -- chunk length
	buffer.writestring(output, 12, "IHDR")
	buffer.writeu32(output, 16, bit32.byteswap(width))
	buffer.writeu32(output, 20, bit32.byteswap(height))
	buffer.writeu8(output, 24, 8) -- 8-bit depth
	buffer.writeu8(output, 25, 6) -- rgba color
	buffer.writeu8(output, 26, 0) -- deflate compression
	buffer.writeu8(output, 27, 0) -- adaptive filtering
	buffer.writeu8(output, 28, 0) -- non-interlaced
	buffer.writeu32(output, 29, bit32.byteswap(crc32(output, 12, 28)))

	-- IDAT
	buffer.writeu32(output, 33, bit32.byteswap(imageDataDeflatedLength))
	buffer.writestring(output, 37, "IDAT")
	buffer.copy(output, 41, imageDataDeflated, 0, imageDataDeflatedLength)
	local x = 41 + imageDataDeflatedLength
	buffer.writeu32(output, x, bit32.byteswap(crc32(output, 37, x - 1)))

	-- IEND
	buffer.writeu32(output, x + 4, 0)
	buffer.writestring(output, x + 8, "IEND")
	buffer.writeu32(output, x + 12, 0x826042AE)

	return output
end

return {
	decode = decode,
	encode = encode,
}

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local COLOR_TYPE_BIT_DEPTH = {
	[0] = { 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 },
	[2] = { 8, 16 },
	[3] = { 1, 2, 4, 8 },
	[4] = { 8, 16 },
	[6] = { 8, 16 },
}

local function read(buf: buffer, chunk: Types.Chunk): Types.IHDRChunk
	assert(chunk.length == 13, "IHDR data must be 13 bytes")

	local offset = chunk.offset

	local width = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, offset))
	local height = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, offset + 4))
	local bitDepth = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 8)
	local colorType = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 9)
	local compression = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 10)
	local filter = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 11)
	local interlace = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 12)

	assert(width > 0 and width <= 2 ^ 31 and height > 0 and height <= 2 ^ 31, "invalid dimensions")
	assert(compression == 0, "invalid compression method")
	assert(filter == 0, "invalid filter method")
	assert(interlace == 0 or interlace == 1, "invalid interlace method")

	local allowedBitDepth = COLOR_TYPE_BIT_DEPTH[colorType]
	assert(allowedBitDepth ~= nil, "invalid color type")
	assert(table.find(allowedBitDepth, bitDepth) ~= nil, "invalid bit depth")

	return {
		width = width,
		height = height,
		bitDepth = bitDepth,
		colorType = colorType,
		interlaced = interlace == 1,
	}
end

return read

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local function read(buf: buffer, chunk: Types.Chunk, header: Types.IHDRChunk): Types.PLTEChunk
	assert(chunk.length % 3 == 0, "malformed PLTE chunk")

	local count = chunk.length / 3
	assert(count > 0, "no entries in PLTE")
	assert(count <= 256, "too many entries in PLTE")
	assert(count <= 2 ^ header.bitDepth, "too many entries in PLTE for bit depth")

	local colors = table.create(count)
	local offset = chunk.offset

	for i = 1, count do
		colors[i] = {
			r = buffer.readu8(buf, offset),
			g = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 1),
			b = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 2),
			a = 255,
		}
		offset += 3
	end

	return {
		colors = colors,
	}
end

return read

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local function readU16(buf: buffer, offset: number, depth: number)
	return bit32.extract(
		bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(buffer.readu8(buf, offset), 8), buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 1)),
		0,
		depth
	)
end

local function read(
	buf: buffer,
	chunk: Types.Chunk,
	header: Types.IHDRChunk,
	palette: Types.PLTEChunk?
): Types.tRNSChunk
	local gray = -1
	local red = -1
	local green = -1
	local blue = -1

	if header.colorType == 0 then
		assert(chunk.length == 2, "invalid tRNS length for color type")
		gray = readU16(buf, chunk.offset, header.bitDepth)
	elseif header.colorType == 2 then
		assert(chunk.length == 6, "invalid tRNS length for color type")
		red = readU16(buf, chunk.offset, header.bitDepth)
		green = readU16(buf, chunk.offset + 2, header.bitDepth)
		blue = readU16(buf, chunk.offset + 4, header.bitDepth)
	else
		local count = chunk.length -- 1 byte per transparency entry
		assert(palette, "tRNS requires PLTE for color type")
		assert(count <= #palette.colors, "tRNS specified too many PLTE alphas")
		for i = 1, count do
			palette.colors[i].a = buffer.readu8(buf, chunk.offset + i - 1)
		end
	end

	return {
		gray = gray,
		red = red,
		green = green,
		blue = blue,
	}
end

return read

local function crc32(buf: buffer, i: number, j: number)
	local code = 0xFFFFFFFF
	for k = i, j do
		code = bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(code, 8), lookup[bit32.bxor(bit32.band(code, 0xFF), buffer.readu8(buf, k)) + 1])
	end
	return bit32.bxor(code, 0xFFFFFFFF)
end

return crc32

local WINDOW_LOOKAHEAD = 258
local WINDOW_SEARCH = 0x8000 - WINDOW_LOOKAHEAD

local MAX_CHAIN_NODES = 50_000
local MAX_CHAIN_SEARCH = 12
local MAX_MATCH_LENGTH = 96
local DEFLATE_BLOCK_SIZE = 0x8000

type HuffmanTable = { number }

local function createHuffmanTable(lengths: { number }): (HuffmanTable, { number }, { number })
	local lengthCount = table.create(MAX_BITS, 0)
	lengthCount[0] = 0
	for _, length in lengths do
		if length > 0 then
			lengthCount[length] = (lengthCount[length] or 0) + 1
		end
	end

	local lastCode = 1
	local nextCode = table.create(MAX_BITS)
	for bits = 1, MAX_BITS do
		lastCode = bit32.lshift(lastCode + lengthCount[bits - 1], 1)
		nextCode[bits] = lastCode
	end

	local mapping = {}
	local codeValues = {}
	local codeLengths = {}
	for i, length in lengths do
		if length > 0 then
			mapping[nextCode[length]] = i - 1
			codeValues[i - 1] = bit32.extract(nextCode[length], 0, length)
			codeLengths[i - 1] = length
			nextCode[length] += 1
		end
	end

	return mapping, codeValues, codeLengths
end

local cachedLitValues = {}
local cachedLitExtraValues = {}
local cachedLitExtraBits = {}
for length = 3, 258 do
	local idx
	for i = #LIT_LEN, 1, -1 do
		if length >= LIT_LEN[i] then
			idx = i
			break
		end
	end
	cachedLitValues[length] = 0x100 + idx
	cachedLitExtraValues[length] = length - LIT_LEN[idx]
	cachedLitExtraBits[length] = LIT_EXTRA[idx - 8] or 0
end

local cachedDistIndices = {}
for distance = 1, 1024 do
	local distIdx
	for i = #DIST_OFF, 1, -1 do
		if distance >= DIST_OFF[i] then
			distIdx = i
			break
		end
	end
	cachedDistIndices[distance] = distIdx
end

local fixedLitTable, fixedLitCodeValues, fixedLitCodeLengths = createHuffmanTable(FIXED_LIT)
local fixedDistTable, fixedDistCodeValues, fixedDistCodeLengths = createHuffmanTable(table.create(32, 5))

local function getStoreSize(blockSize: number)
	return math.ceil(blockSize / DEFLATE_BLOCK_SIZE) * 5 + blockSize
end

local function getDistIdx(distance: number)
	return if distance < 1025
		then cachedDistIndices[distance]
		elseif distance < 1537 then 21
		elseif distance < 2049 then 22
		elseif distance < 3073 then 23
		elseif distance < 4097 then 24
		elseif distance < 6145 then 25
		elseif distance < 8193 then 26
		elseif distance < 12289 then 27
		elseif distance < 16385 then 28
		elseif distance < 24577 then 29
		else 30
end

-- zlib adler32 applies modulo every 5552 cycles to keep s0 and s1 inside the 32-bit limit
-- however, using doubles allows us to wait >8.4m cycles in the worst case
local function adler32(input: buffer, offset: number, length: number): number
	local s0 = 1
	local s1 = 0
	local count = 0
	for i = offset, offset + length - 1 do
		s0 += buffer.readu8(input, i)
		s1 += s0
		count += 1
		if count == 8_400_000 then
			s0 %= 65521
			s1 %= 65521
			count = 0
		end
	end
	return bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(s1 % 65521, 16), s0 % 65521)
end

local function inflate(input: buffer, output: buffer): number
	local header0 = buffer.readu8(input, 0)
	local header1 = buffer.readu8(input, 1)
	assert(bit32.extract(header0, 0, 4) == 8, "invalid zlib comp method")
	assert(bit32.extract(header0, 4, 4) <= 7, "invalid zlib window size")
	assert(bit32.extract(header1, 5, 1) == 0, "preset dictionary is not allowed")
	assert(bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(header0, 8), header1) % 31 == 0, "zlib header sum mismatch")

	local readOffset = 2
	local readOffsetBit = 0

	local function readBit()
		local bit = bit32.extract(buffer.readu8(input, readOffset), readOffsetBit)
		readOffsetBit += 1
		if readOffsetBit == 8 then
			readOffsetBit = 0
			readOffset += 1
		end
		return bit
	end

	local function readBits(n: number)
		local bits = buffer.readbits(input, readOffset * 8 + readOffsetBit, n)
		readOffsetBit += n
		readOffset += bit32.rshift(readOffsetBit, 3)
		readOffsetBit = bit32.band(readOffsetBit, 0b111)
		return bits
	end

	local function readHuffmanTable(huffmanTable: HuffmanTable): number
		local code = 2 + readBit()
		while not huffmanTable[code] do
			code = 2 * code + readBit()
		end
		return huffmanTable[code]
	end

	local writeOffset = 0

	repeat
		local bfinal = readBit()
		local btype = readBits(2)
		assert(btype ~= 0b11, "reserved btype")

		if btype == 0b00 then
			if readOffsetBit > 0 then
				readOffset += 1
				readOffsetBit = 0
			end
			local len = buffer.readu16(input, readOffset)
			assert(bit32.bxor(len, buffer.readu16(input, readOffset + 2)) == 0xFFFF, "len ~= nlen")
			readOffset += 4
			buffer.copy(output, writeOffset, input, readOffset, len)
			writeOffset += len
			readOffset += len
		else
			local litTable = fixedLitTable
			local distTable = fixedDistTable

			if btype == 0b10 then
				local litsCount = readBits(5) + 257
				local distsCount = readBits(5) + 1
				local codesCount = readBits(4) + 4

				local codeLengths = table.create(19, 0)
				for i = 1, codesCount do
					codeLengths[LEN_ORDER[i] + 1] = readBits(3)
				end
				local codeLengthsTable = createHuffmanTable(codeLengths)

				local litLengths = table.create(litsCount)
				local litLength
				repeat
					local code = readHuffmanTable(codeLengthsTable)
					local repeatCount = 1
					if code <= 15 then
						litLength = code
					elseif code == 16 then
						repeatCount = readBits(2) + 3
					elseif code == 17 then
						litLength = 0
						repeatCount = readBits(3) + 3
					elseif code == 18 then
						litLength = 0
						repeatCount = readBits(7) + 11
					end
					for _ = 1, repeatCount do
						table.insert(litLengths, litLength)
					end
				until #litLengths >= litsCount
				litTable = createHuffmanTable(litLengths)

				local distLengths = table.create(distsCount)
				local distLength
				repeat
					local code = readHuffmanTable(codeLengthsTable)
					local repeatCount = 1
					if code <= 15 then
						distLength = code
					elseif code == 16 then
						repeatCount = readBits(2) + 3
					elseif code == 17 then
						distLength = 0
						repeatCount = readBits(3) + 3
					elseif code == 18 then
						distLength = 0
						repeatCount = readBits(7) + 11
					end
					for _ = 1, repeatCount do
						table.insert(distLengths, distLength)
					end
				until #distLengths >= distsCount
				distTable = createHuffmanTable(distLengths)
			end

			repeat
				local v = readHuffmanTable(litTable)
				if v < 0x100 then
					buffer.writeu8(output, writeOffset, v)
					writeOffset += 1
				elseif v > 0x100 then
					local len = LIT_LEN[v - 0x100]
					if v > 0x10C then
						len += readBits(LIT_EXTRA[v - 0x108])
					elseif v > 0x108 then
						len += readBit()
					end

					local d = readHuffmanTable(distTable)
					local dist = DIST_OFF[d + 1]
					if d > 5 then
						dist += readBits(DIST_EXTRA[d])
					elseif d > 3 then
						dist += readBit()
					end

					if len <= dist then
						buffer.copy(output, writeOffset, output, writeOffset - dist, len)
						writeOffset += len
					else
						repeat
							local size = math.min(len, dist)
							buffer.copy(output, writeOffset, output, writeOffset - dist, size)
							writeOffset += size
							len -= size
							dist += size
						until len == 0
					end
				end
			until v == 0x100
		end
	until bfinal == 0b1

	if readOffsetBit > 0 then
		readOffsetBit = 0
		readOffset += 1
	end

	assert(
		adler32(output, 0, buffer.len(output)) == bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(input, readOffset)),
		"adler-32 checksum mismatch"
	)

	return writeOffset
end

local function deflate(input: buffer): (buffer, number)
	-- upper bound: all data as uncompressed blocks + 6 zlib bytes
	local inputSize = buffer.len(input)
	local output = buffer.create(getStoreSize(inputSize) + 6)

	-- flevel (1 = fast), dict (0 = false), checks, window (7 = 32k), method (8 = deflate)
	buffer.writeu16(output, 0, 0b01_0_11110_0111_1000)

	local writeOffset = 2
	local writeOffsetBits = 0

	local function writeBits(n: number, width: number)
		buffer.writebits(output, writeOffset * 8 + writeOffsetBits, width, n)
		writeOffsetBits += width
		writeOffset += bit32.rshift(writeOffsetBits, 3)
		writeOffsetBits = bit32.band(writeOffsetBits, 0b111)
	end

	-- https://graphics.stanford.edu/~seander/bithacks.html
	local function writeHuffmanBits(n: number, w: number)
		n = bit32.bor(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(n, 1), 0x55555555), bit32.band(bit32.lshift(n, 1), 0xAAAAAAAA))
		n = bit32.bor(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(n, 2), 0x33333333), bit32.band(bit32.lshift(n, 2), 0xCCCCCCCC))
		n = bit32.bor(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(n, 4), 0x0F0F0F0F), bit32.band(bit32.lshift(n, 4), 0xF0F0F0F0))
		n = bit32.bor(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(n, 8), 0x00FF00FF), bit32.band(bit32.lshift(n, 8), 0xFF00FF00))
		n = bit32.bor(bit32.rshift(n, 16), bit32.lshift(n, 16))
		n = bit32.band(bit32.rshift(n, 32 - w), bit32.lshift(1, w) - 1)
		writeBits(n, w)
	end

	local function writeLitOrLen(value: number)
		writeHuffmanBits(fixedLitCodeValues[value], fixedLitCodeLengths[value])
	end

	local function writeBackRef(distance: number, length: number)
		writeLitOrLen(cachedLitValues[length])
		if length > 10 then
			writeBits(cachedLitExtraValues[length], cachedLitExtraBits[length])
		end
		local distIdx = getDistIdx(distance)
		writeHuffmanBits(fixedDistCodeValues[distIdx - 1], fixedDistCodeLengths[distIdx - 1])
		if distIdx > 3 then
			writeBits(distance - DIST_OFF[distIdx], DIST_EXTRA[distIdx - 1])
		end
	end

	local function getLitOrLenSize(value: number)
		return fixedLitCodeLengths[value]
	end

	local function getBackRefSize(distance: number, length: number)
		local distIdx = getDistIdx(distance)
		return getLitOrLenSize(cachedLitValues[length])
			+ cachedLitExtraBits[length]
			+ fixedDistCodeLengths[distIdx - 1]
			+ (DIST_EXTRA[distIdx - 1] or 0)
	end

	local offsets = {}
	local nexts = {}
	local heads = {}
	local nodeCount = 0

	local function insertNode(offset: number, nextIndex: number)
		nodeCount += 1
		offsets[nodeCount] = offset
		nexts[nodeCount] = nextIndex
		return nodeCount
	end

	local function clearTables()
		table.clear(offsets)
		table.clear(nexts)
		table.clear(heads)
		nodeCount = 0
	end

	for startReadOffset = 0, inputSize - 1, DEFLATE_BLOCK_SIZE do
		local huffmanSizeBits = 0

		local nextBlockReadOffset = math.min(inputSize, startReadOffset + DEFLATE_BLOCK_SIZE)
		local readOffset = startReadOffset

		local tokens: { vector } = {}
		while readOffset < nextBlockReadOffset - 3 do
			local hash = bit32.band(buffer.readu32(input, readOffset), 0xFFFFFF)
			local newNodeIndex = insertNode(readOffset, heads[hash] or 0)
			heads[hash] = newNodeIndex

			local bestLength = 0
			local bestOffset = -1

			local chainCount = 0
			local nodeIndex = nexts[newNodeIndex]
			while
				nodeIndex
				and (offsets[nodeIndex] or -math.huge) >= readOffset - WINDOW_SEARCH
				and chainCount < MAX_CHAIN_SEARCH
				and bestLength < MAX_MATCH_LENGTH
			do
				local searchLength = 3
				local searchOffset = offsets[nodeIndex]

				local exit = false
				local limit = math.min(nextBlockReadOffset, readOffset + WINDOW_LOOKAHEAD)
				if
					readOffset + bestLength < limit
					and buffer.readu8(input, searchOffset + bestLength)
						~= buffer.readu8(input, readOffset + bestLength)
				then
					exit = true -- pre-check the next byte after longest (early exit)
				end

				while
					not exit
					and searchLength < WINDOW_LOOKAHEAD
					and readOffset + searchLength < nextBlockReadOffset
					and buffer.readu8(input, searchOffset + searchLength)
						== buffer.readu8(input, readOffset + searchLength)
				do
					searchLength += 1
				end
				if searchLength > bestLength then
					bestLength = searchLength
					bestOffset = searchOffset
					if bestLength >= WINDOW_LOOKAHEAD then
						break
					end
				end
				nodeIndex = nexts[nodeIndex]
				chainCount += 1
			end

			if bestLength == 0 then
				local b = buffer.readu8(input, readOffset)
				huffmanSizeBits += getLitOrLenSize(b)
				table.insert(tokens, vector.create(0, b))
				readOffset += 1
			else
				huffmanSizeBits += getBackRefSize(readOffset - bestOffset, bestLength)
				table.insert(tokens, vector.create(1, readOffset - bestOffset, bestLength))
				for newOffset = readOffset + 1, math.min(readOffset + bestLength - 1, nextBlockReadOffset - 4) do
					local newHash = bit32.band(buffer.readu32(input, newOffset), 0xFFFFFF)
					heads[newHash] = insertNode(newOffset, heads[newHash] or 0)
				end
				readOffset += bestLength
			end
		end

		while readOffset < nextBlockReadOffset do
			local b = buffer.readu8(input, readOffset)
			huffmanSizeBits += getLitOrLenSize(b)
			table.insert(tokens, vector.create(0, b))
			readOffset += 1
		end

		huffmanSizeBits += getLitOrLenSize(0x100)
		table.insert(tokens, vector.create(0, 0x100))

		if nextBlockReadOffset == inputSize then
			writeBits(0b1, 1)
		else
			writeBits(0b0, 1)
		end

		local blockLength = nextBlockReadOffset - startReadOffset
		local fixedHuffmanSize = math.ceil(huffmanSizeBits / 8) + 1 -- bfinal/btype overhead
		if fixedHuffmanSize < getStoreSize(blockLength) then
			writeBits(0b01, 2)
			for _, token in tokens do
				if token.x == 0 then
					writeLitOrLen(token.y)
				else
					writeBackRef(token.y, token.z)
				end
			end
		else
			writeBits(0b00, 2)
			if writeOffsetBits > 0 then
				writeOffset += 1
				writeOffsetBits = 0
			end
			buffer.writeu16(output, writeOffset, blockLength)
			buffer.writeu16(output, writeOffset + 2, bit32.bxor(0xFFFF, blockLength))
			buffer.copy(output, writeOffset + 4, input, startReadOffset, blockLength)
			writeOffset += 4 + blockLength
		end

		if nodeCount > MAX_CHAIN_NODES then
			clearTables()
		end
	end

	if writeOffsetBits > 0 then
		writeOffset += 1
	end

	local checksum = adler32(input, 0, buffer.len(input))
	buffer.writeu32(output, writeOffset, bit32.byteswap(checksum))

	return output, writeOffset + 4
end

return {
	inflate = inflate,
	deflate = deflate,
}

--[[
	Which properties belong in which categories per type, for the Clipboard, the Shifter, their
	paste (ClipShiftFix) and the Randomizer.
	  TYPE_NAMES, TYPE_ITEM_KEYS, SECTIONS, SECTION_RANK; sectionRank(name, i), sortSections(list)
	  merge(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps, keepFn) -> sections, propTypeMap
	    sections = { { name = "CategoryA", props = { "PropX", ... } }, ... } in display order
	    propTypeMap = { PropX = { "Part", "Beam" }, PropY = { "PE" }, ... }
	    A property in several groups shows only in the FIRST that claims it (TYPE_NAMES order).
	    keepFn(typeName, prop) may drop props; PE props come as typeName "PE".
	  randomizableSections(TypeRegistry, peSections, RandomizerRules, excludeSet) -> as merge
	  randomizableSectionsByType(TypeRegistry, peSections, RandomizerRules, selectedTypeNames) -> list
]]

local PropertyCatalog = {}

-- The order the TypeRegistry types' sections are built in; PE sections come last (peSections).
PropertyCatalog.TYPE_NAMES = {"Part","Beam","BeamNative","PointLight","Sound","Trail","TrailEmitter","Highlight","Attachment","Model","Lightning","CameraShake","Rocks","Rope","Distortion","Container","Matte","Force","Reactor","Blur","Bloom","ColorCorrection","Atmosphere","ImageLabel","PE"}


-- TypeData clipboard groups carry the Properties panel's section names and members, so the
-- Clipboard, Shifter and Randomizer mirror the panel.

-- Display order shared by the Properties panel (WidgetSections.buildTypeSection, the Blender box),
-- the Clipboard / Shifter categories and the Randomizer: Emission, Appearance (Light / Scale stand
-- in), Blender, Decals, Spawn, Shape, Texture, Motion, Flipbook, the rest as authored, Events, Advanced.
PropertyCatalog.SECTION_RANK = { Emission = 10, Appearance = 20, Light = 20, Scale = 20, Blender = 25, Decals = 26, Spawn = 30, Shape = 35, Texture = 36, Motion = 40, Flipbook = 41, ["Mesh Frames"] = 42, Events = 100, Advanced = 1000 }

-- Rank for a section name; unlisted sections keep their authored order after Motion.
function PropertyCatalog.sectionRank(name, authoredIndex)
	return PropertyCatalog.SECTION_RANK[name] or (50 + (authoredIndex or 0))
end

-- Stable sort of {name = ...} entries by rank.
function PropertyCatalog.sortSections(list)
	local ranked = {}
	for index, entry in ipairs(list) do
		ranked[index] = { entry = entry, rank = PropertyCatalog.sectionRank(entry.name, index), index = index }
	end
	table.sort(ranked, function(a, b)
		if a.rank ~= b.rank then return a.rank < b.rank end
		return a.index < b.index
	end)
	local sorted = {}
	for index, item in ipairs(ranked) do sorted[index] = item.entry end
	return sorted
end

-- The Clipboard, the Shifter and ClipShiftFix's paste rely on this return shape and category order.
function PropertyCatalog.merge(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps, keepFn)
	local catOrder, catMap = {}, {} -- catOrder = ordered names, catMap[name] = {props seen set, props array}
	local propTypeMap = {} -- propName -> {typeName, ...}
	local propFirstGroup = {} -- propName -> first group that claimed it, so cross-group duplicates render once
	local T_ = TypeRegistry and TypeRegistry.Types or {}
	-- Collect from all TypeRegistry types. A group marked `borrowed` lists props that belong to
	-- other types (a mesh's Reactor group, TypeDataReactor.giveTo): it is collected after every
	-- other group, so each prop keeps the category its own type gave it and the group claims
	-- only what no other type lists.
	for _, borrowedPass in ipairs({ false, true }) do
		for _, typeName in ipairs(PropertyCatalog.TYPE_NAMES) do
			local cb = T_[typeName] and T_[typeName].clipboard or {}
			for _, cat in ipairs(cb) do
				if (cat.borrowed == true) ~= borrowedPass then continue end
				if not catMap[cat.name] then catMap[cat.name] = {seen={}, props={}}; catOrder[#catOrder+1] = cat.name end
				local cm = catMap[cat.name]
				for _, prop in ipairs(cat.props) do
					if excludeProps and excludeProps[prop] then continue end
					if keepFn and not keepFn(typeName, prop) then continue end
					local firstGroup = propFirstGroup[prop]
					if firstGroup and firstGroup ~= cat.name then
						-- Claimed by an earlier group: mapped there only.
					else
						if not cm.seen[prop] then cm.seen[prop] = true; cm.props[#cm.props+1] = prop end
						propFirstGroup[prop] = cat.name
					end
					if not propTypeMap[prop] then propTypeMap[prop] = {} end
					local found = false; for _, t in ipairs(propTypeMap[prop]) do if t == typeName then found = true; break end end
					if not found then table.insert(propTypeMap[prop], typeName) end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- A caller may pass no PE sections.
	for _, cat in ipairs(peSections or {}) do
		if not catMap[cat.name] then catMap[cat.name] = {seen={}, props={}}; catOrder[#catOrder+1] = cat.name end
		local cm = catMap[cat.name]
		for _, prop in ipairs(cat.props) do
			if excludeProps and excludeProps[prop] then continue end
			if keepFn and not keepFn("PE", prop) then continue end
			local firstGroup = propFirstGroup[prop]
			if firstGroup and firstGroup ~= cat.name then
				-- Claimed by a TypeRegistry group already.
			else
				if not cm.seen[prop] then cm.seen[prop] = true; cm.props[#cm.props+1] = prop end
				propFirstGroup[prop] = cat.name
			end
			if not propTypeMap[prop] then propTypeMap[prop] = {} end
			local found = false; for _, t in ipairs(propTypeMap[prop]) do if t == "PE" then found = true; break end end
			if not found then table.insert(propTypeMap[prop], "PE") end
		end
	end
	local result = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(catOrder) do result[#result+1] = {name = name, props = catMap[name].props} end
	return PropertyCatalog.sortSections(result), propTypeMap
end


-- merge() kept to the props RandomizerRules.derive gives a rule, in the same shape. Each prop's
-- rule comes from its first non-PE type; PE-only props are dropped (the per-type variant below
-- keeps them). randomizerExcludeSet: an optional {[propKey] = true} of more props to skip.
function PropertyCatalog.randomizableSections(TypeRegistry, peSections, RandomizerRules, randomizerExcludeSet)
	local sections, propTypeMap = PropertyCatalog.merge(TypeRegistry, peSections, randomizerExcludeSet)
	local filtered = {}
	for _, sec in ipairs(sections) do
		local keptProps = {}
		for _, prop in ipairs(sec.props) do
			local types = propTypeMap[prop]
			if not types or #types == 0 then continue end
			local hasNonPE = false
			for _, t in ipairs(types) do if t ~= "PE" then hasNonPE = true; break end end
			if not hasNonPE then continue end
			-- Types rarely differ in a key's propDef; derive handles that per type when it writes.
			local firstType
			for _, t in ipairs(types) do if t ~= "PE" then firstType = t; break end end
			local propDef
			local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types and TypeRegistry.Types[firstType]
			if typeDef and typeDef.properties then propDef = typeDef.properties[prop] end
			local rule = RandomizerRules.derive(firstType, prop, propDef)
			if rule then table.insert(keptProps, prop) end
		end
		if #keptProps > 0 then table.insert(filtered, {name = sec.name, props = keptProps}) end
	end
	return filtered, propTypeMap
end


-- Like randomizableSections without the cross-type dedupe: one entry per (type, category), so the
-- Randomize panel mirrors the Properties panel and a prop is ticked per type.
-- selectedTypeNames: a set of the types to list; nil lists all, {} none.
-- Returns { typeName, name, props } in TYPE_NAMES order, then each type's clipboard order.
function PropertyCatalog.randomizableSectionsByType(TypeRegistry, peSections, RandomizerRules, selectedTypeNames)
	local result = {}
	local T_ = TypeRegistry and TypeRegistry.Types or {}
	for _, typeName in ipairs(PropertyCatalog.TYPE_NAMES) do
		if selectedTypeNames and not selectedTypeNames[typeName] then continue end
		local typeDef = T_[typeName]
		-- PE has no TypeRegistry entry: peSections give its props, and a nil propDef sends derive to its
		-- PE_PROP_TYPES map.
		local cb
		if typeName == "PE" then
			cb = peSections or {}
		else
			if not typeDef then continue end
			cb = typeDef.clipboard or {}
		end
		local sectionOrder = {}
		local sectionMap = {}
		local function addToSection(name, prop)
			if not sectionMap[name] then
				sectionMap[name] = {}
				table.insert(sectionOrder, name)
			end
			for _, existing in ipairs(sectionMap[name]) do
				if existing == prop then return end
			end
			table.insert(sectionMap[name], prop)
		end
		for _, cat in ipairs(cb) do
			for _, prop in ipairs(cat.props) do
				local propDef = typeDef and typeDef.properties and typeDef.properties[prop] or nil
				local rule = RandomizerRules.derive(typeName, prop, propDef)
				if rule then addToSection(cat.name, prop) end
			end
		end
		local typeSections = {}
		for _, name in ipairs(sectionOrder) do
			table.insert(typeSections, {typeName = typeName, name = name, props = sectionMap[name]})
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(PropertyCatalog.sortSections(typeSections)) do
			table.insert(result, entry)
		end
	end
	return result
end

return PropertyCatalog

--[[
	The tools' logic: snapshot, resize, retime, shift and graph handles. Items and snapshots come in
	as arguments; no UI or selection. Requires only TypeRegistry.
	  snapshotItem / snapshotSelection / restoreSnapshots(snapshots, scoped)
	  applyResize(snapshots, factor, scaleShape), applyRetime(snapshots, factor)
	  shiftItems / shiftPEs / shiftValue(op, val, value, scaleEnv, clamp), opHandles, handleHost
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.Part.TypeRegistry)

local QOL = {}

-- In a scoped restore (Randomizer Cancel), NIL_SENTINEL marks a key that was touched and absent
-- before, so it is cleared; a key not in the snapshot is skipped. Cancel.luau reads it.
QOL.NIL_SENTINEL = {}


function QOL.scaleSequence(seq, factor, scaleEnv)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return seq end
	local kps = seq.Keypoints; local new = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		local env = scaleEnv and (kp.Envelope * factor) or kp.Envelope
		table.insert(new, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, kp.Value * factor, math.abs(env)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(new)
end

function QOL.shiftSequence(seq, amount, shiftEnv)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return seq end
	local kps = seq.Keypoints; local new = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		local env = shiftEnv and (kp.Envelope + amount) or kp.Envelope
		table.insert(new, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, kp.Value + amount, math.max(0, env)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(new)
end

-- Bezier handles: a graph edited with handles keeps them beside it as <key>_BezierHandles (JSON,
-- per keypoint: t, v, e, hix, hiy, hox, hoy). A tool that scales or shifts a graph does the same to
-- its handles; the editor also fits stored handles to their graph when it opens
-- (GraphEditor/Util.fitHandles).

-- Where an item's graph handles live: its config, else the item itself (a native emitter, Trail or
-- native Beam). A decal layer's or Blender state's live on the layer or state (PopulateDecals,
-- ClipSlots). Connectors and the Clipboard ask it too.
function QOL.handleHost(item)
	return TypeRegistry.getConfig(item) or item
end
local handleHost = QOL.handleHost

-- Handles JSON with every value taken through op / val as _opSeq takes a graph's keypoints
-- (envToo: the envelopes as well). nil for no handles or unreadable ones: nothing is written.
function QOL.opHandles(op, val, json, envToo)
	if type(json) ~= "string" or json == "" then return nil end
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
	local ok, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, json)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local factor, amount = 1, 0
	if op == "x" then factor = val
	elseif op == "/" then factor = 1 / val
	elseif op == "+" then amount = val
	elseif op == "-" then amount = -val
	else return nil end
	for _, kp in ipairs(data) do
		if type(kp) == "table" and type(kp.v) == "number" then
			kp.v = kp.v * factor + amount
			if type(kp.hiy) == "number" then kp.hiy *= factor end
			if type(kp.hoy) == "number" then kp.hoy *= factor end
			if envToo and type(kp.e) == "number" then
				if amount ~= 0 then kp.e = math.max(0, kp.e + amount) else kp.e = math.abs(kp.e * factor) end
			end
		end
	end
	return HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
end

-- Graph `key`'s handles as the snapshot holds them, taken through op / val: a tool's preview starts
-- from the snapshot, as its graph does.
local function writeSnapshotHandles(item, snap, key, op, val)
	local handles = snap._bezierHandles
	local changed = handles and QOL.opHandles(op, val, handles[key .. "_BezierHandles"], false)
	if changed then handleHost(item):SetAttribute(key .. "_BezierHandles", changed) end
end

-- Each listed graph from its snapshot value, scaled by factor ("x") or divided by it ("/"), its
-- handles alike. Resize and Retime write their graphs through it.
local function scaleGraphsFrom(item, snap, keys, op, factor)
	if op == "/" and factor == 0 then return end
	local scale = factor
	if op == "/" then scale = 1 / factor end
	for _, k in ipairs(keys or {}) do
		if snap[k] and typeof(snap[k]) == "NumberSequence" then
			TypeRegistry.write(item, k, QOL.scaleSequence(snap[k], scale, false))
			writeSnapshotHandles(item, snap, k, op, factor)
		end
	end
end

-- The handles the item holds now, taken through op / val: the Shifter works on live values.
local function shiftLiveHandles(item, key, op, val, envToo)
	local host = handleHost(item)
	local changed = QOL.opHandles(op, val, host:GetAttribute(key .. "_BezierHandles"), envToo)
	if changed then host:SetAttribute(key .. "_BezierHandles", changed) end
end

function QOL.scaleRange(r, factor)
	if not r or typeof(r) ~= "NumberRange" then return r end
	local a, b = r.Min * factor, r.Max * factor
	return NumberRange.new(math.min(a, b), math.max(a, b))
end

-- Scales a Vector3 or a Vector2 (ImageLabel.Acceleration); anything else passes through.
function QOL.scaleVector(v, factor)
	if not v then return v end
	local t = typeof(v)
	if t == "Vector3" or t == "Vector2" then return v * factor end
	return v
end
-- Same as scaleVector.
function QOL.scaleVector3(v, factor) return QOL.scaleVector(v, factor) end

-- Keypoint values at 0 or more, each envelope within its value.
function QOL.clampSeqNonNeg(seq)
	local kps = seq.Keypoints; local new = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		local v = math.max(0, kp.Value)
		local e = math.max(0, math.min(kp.Envelope, v))
		table.insert(new, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, v, e))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(new)
end


-- A PE's native properties, or a part-icle's TypeRegistry properties and PartSize.
function QOL.snapshotItem(item)
	local snap = {}
	if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		-- Every PE property the Randomizer rolls (RandomizerRules.PE_PROP_TYPES), or Cancel cannot restore it.
		for _, k in ipairs({"Size", "Transparency", "Squash"}) do
			local ok, v = pcall(function() return item[k] end)
			if ok then snap[k] = v end
		end
		snap.Lifetime = item.Lifetime
		snap.Rate = item.Rate
		snap.Speed = item.Speed
		snap.RotSpeed = item.RotSpeed
		snap.Rotation = item.Rotation
		snap.Drag = item.Drag
		snap.Acceleration = item.Acceleration
		snap.SpreadAngle = item.SpreadAngle
		snap.FlipbookFramerate = item.FlipbookFramerate
		snap.Brightness = item.Brightness
		snap.LightEmission = item.LightEmission
		snap.LightInfluence = item.LightInfluence
		snap.ZOffset = item.ZOffset
		snap.VelocityInheritance = item.VelocityInheritance
		snap.TimeScale = item.TimeScale
		local ok2, c = pcall(function() return item.Color end)
		if ok2 then snap._peColor = c end
		-- Part-Icles' own emit timing attributes on a native PE.
		snap._emitDelay = item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")
		snap._emitDuration = item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")
		snap._emitCount = item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
		-- Handles of the four graphs the editor wires for a raw PE, stored on the PE itself.
		local handleSnaps = {}
		for _, k in ipairs({"Size", "Transparency", "Squash", "Color"}) do
			handleSnaps[k .. "_BezierHandles"] = item:GetAttribute(k .. "_BezierHandles")
		end
		snap._bezierHandles = handleSnaps
		return snap
	end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return snap end
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and not item:IsA("Terrain") then
		snap.PartSize = item.Size
		-- Child attachments' CFrames, which resize scales.
		local attachSnaps = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Attachment") then attachSnaps[child] = child.CFrame end
		end
		if next(attachSnaps) then snap._attachCFrames = attachSnaps end
	end
	-- A Beam's or Trail's attachments' CFrames, which resize scales.
	if item:IsA("Beam") or item:IsA("Trail") then
		local attachSnaps = {}
		local a0 = item.Attachment0; if a0 then attachSnaps[a0] = a0.CFrame end
		local a1 = item.Attachment1; if a1 then attachSnaps[a1] = a1.CFrame end
		if next(attachSnaps) then snap._attachCFrames = attachSnaps end
	end
	for propName in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		if propName ~= "Enabled" then snap[propName] = TypeRegistry.read(item, propName) end
	end
	-- Handles go with their graphs: Randomizer Cancel restores them (its preview clears them) and the
	-- tools scale them. Kept under `_bezierHandles`, apart from property keys.
	local host = handleHost(item)
	local handleSnaps = {}
	for propName in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		local handleAttr = propName .. "_BezierHandles"
		handleSnaps[handleAttr] = host:GetAttribute(handleAttr)
	end
	snap._bezierHandles = handleSnaps
	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if config then
		-- An optional property (TypeData) that is absent reads as its default above, which the
		-- tools scale; restoreSnapshots takes the attribute away again instead of stamping it.
		for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
			if propDef.optional and config:GetAttribute(propDef.attrName or propName) == nil then
				snap._absent = snap._absent or {}
				snap._absent[propName] = true
			end
		end
	end
	-- Item-level emit timing, for retime and Randomizer Cancel.
	snap._emitDuration = item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")
	snap._emitDelay = item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")
	snap._emitCount = item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
	return snap
end

-- scoped: only what each snap holds is restored (Randomizer Cancel, so other edits stay);
-- otherwise everything.
function QOL.restoreSnapshots(snapshots, scoped)
	local function shouldRestoreVirtual(snap, key)
		if scoped then return snap[key] ~= nil end
		return true
	end
	-- Scoped: NIL_SENTINEL clears the attribute.
	local function virtualValue(snap, key)
		local v = snap[key]
		if v == QOL.NIL_SENTINEL then return nil end
		return v
	end
	for item, snap in pairs(snapshots) do
		if not item.Parent then continue end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			for _, k in ipairs({"Size", "Transparency", "Squash"}) do
				if snap[k] ~= nil then pcall(function() item[k] = snap[k] end) end
			end
			-- ~= nil so a 0 restores. Every PE property the Randomizer rolls is restored here.
			if snap.Lifetime ~= nil then item.Lifetime = snap.Lifetime end
			if snap.Rate ~= nil then item.Rate = snap.Rate end
			if snap.Speed ~= nil then item.Speed = snap.Speed end
			if snap.RotSpeed ~= nil then item.RotSpeed = snap.RotSpeed end
			if snap.Rotation ~= nil then item.Rotation = snap.Rotation end
			if snap.Drag ~= nil then item.Drag = snap.Drag end
			if snap.Acceleration ~= nil then item.Acceleration = snap.Acceleration end
			if snap.SpreadAngle ~= nil then item.SpreadAngle = snap.SpreadAngle end
			if snap.FlipbookFramerate ~= nil then item.FlipbookFramerate = snap.FlipbookFramerate end
			if snap.Brightness ~= nil then item.Brightness = snap.Brightness end
			if snap.LightEmission ~= nil then item.LightEmission = snap.LightEmission end
			if snap.LightInfluence ~= nil then item.LightInfluence = snap.LightInfluence end
			if snap.ZOffset ~= nil then item.ZOffset = snap.ZOffset end
			if snap.VelocityInheritance ~= nil then item.VelocityInheritance = snap.VelocityInheritance end
			if snap.TimeScale ~= nil then item.TimeScale = snap.TimeScale end
			if snap._peColor ~= nil then pcall(function() item.Color = snap._peColor end) end
			-- nil means the attribute was absent, and SetAttribute(name, nil) restores that. Scoped mode
			-- skips keys the snap does not carry.
			if shouldRestoreVirtual(snap, "_emitDuration") then item:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", virtualValue(snap, "_emitDuration")) end
			if shouldRestoreVirtual(snap, "_emitDelay") then item:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", virtualValue(snap, "_emitDelay")) end
			if shouldRestoreVirtual(snap, "_emitCount") then item:SetAttribute("EmitCount", virtualValue(snap, "_emitCount")) end
			-- A PE's handles live on the PE itself.
			if snap._bezierHandles then
				for handleAttr, value in pairs(snap._bezierHandles) do
					item:SetAttribute(handleAttr, value)
				end
			end
		else
			if snap.PartSize and item:IsA("BasePart") then item.Size = snap.PartSize end
			if snap._attachCFrames then for attach, origCF in pairs(snap._attachCFrames) do if attach.Parent then attach.CFrame = origCF end end end
			local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
			if typeDef then
				local absent = snap._absent
				local config = absent and TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
				for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
					if config and absent[propName] then
						config:SetAttribute(propDef.attrName or propName, nil)
					elseif snap[propName] ~= nil then
						TypeRegistry.write(item, propName, snap[propName])
					end
				end
			end
			-- Handles the Randomizer preview cleared; nil stays absent.
			if snap._bezierHandles then
				local host = handleHost(item)
				for handleAttr, value in pairs(snap._bezierHandles) do
					host:SetAttribute(handleAttr, value)
				end
			end
			-- Same for transformed items, except directAccess types: their Duration is a real Trail
			-- property, written above.
			if not (typeDef and typeDef.directAccess) then
				if shouldRestoreVirtual(snap, "_emitDuration") then item:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", virtualValue(snap, "_emitDuration")) end
				if shouldRestoreVirtual(snap, "_emitDelay") then item:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", virtualValue(snap, "_emitDelay")) end
				if shouldRestoreVirtual(snap, "_emitCount") then item:SetAttribute("EmitCount", virtualValue(snap, "_emitCount")) end
			end
		end
	end
end


-- Resize of one transformed item from its snapshot: its type's resize lists, its part's size and
-- the attachments it holds.
local function resizeTransformed(item, snap, factor, scaleShape)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not (typeDef and typeDef.resize) then return end
	scaleGraphsFrom(item, snap, typeDef.resize.scaleGraphs, "x", factor)
	scaleGraphsFrom(item, snap, typeDef.resize.divideGraphs, "/", factor)
	for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.resize.scaleVectors or {}) do
		if snap[k] then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, QOL.scaleVector(snap[k], factor)) end
	end
	-- UDim2 scales both Scale and Offset (as _opUDim2's x does), for ImageLabel Position / Size.
	for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.resize.scaleUDim2s or {}) do
		if snap[k] and typeof(snap[k]) == "UDim2" then
			local u = snap[k]
			TypeRegistry.write(item, k, UDim2.new(u.X.Scale * factor, u.X.Offset * factor, u.Y.Scale * factor, u.Y.Offset * factor))
		end
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.resize.scaleRanges or {}) do
		if snap[k] and typeof(snap[k]) == "NumberRange" then
			TypeRegistry.write(item, k, NumberRange.new(snap[k].Min * factor, snap[k].Max * factor))
		end
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.resize.scaleNumbers or {}) do
		if snap[k] and typeof(snap[k]) == "number" then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, snap[k] * factor) end
	end
	if item:IsA("BasePart") then
		if scaleShape and snap.PartSize then item.Size = snap.PartSize * factor
		elseif snap.PartSize then item.Size = snap.PartSize end
	end
	-- Positions scale, rotations stay.
	if snap._attachCFrames then
		for attach, origCF in pairs(snap._attachCFrames) do
			if attach.Parent then attach.CFrame = CFrame.new(origCF.Position * factor) * (origCF - origCF.Position) end
		end
	end
end

function QOL.applyResize(snapshots, factor, scaleShape)
	for item, snap in pairs(snapshots) do
		if not item.Parent then continue end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			if snap.Size and typeof(snap.Size) == "NumberSequence" then
				item.Size = QOL.clampSeqNonNeg(QOL.scaleSequence(snap.Size, factor, false))
				writeSnapshotHandles(item, snap, "Size", "x", factor)
			end
			if snap.Speed then item.Speed = QOL.scaleRange(snap.Speed, factor) end
			if snap.Acceleration then item.Acceleration = QOL.scaleVector3(snap.Acceleration, factor) end
		else
			resizeTransformed(item, snap, factor, scaleShape)
		end
	end
end


-- A Trail's Duration ("5,2") scaled with its Lifetime.
function QOL.syncTrailDuration(item, snap, factor)
	local raw = snap.Duration
	if raw == nil then return end
	local text = tostring(raw)
	local vals = {}
	for v in text:gmatch("[^,]+") do local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.+)%s*$")); if n then table.insert(vals, n) end end
	if #vals == 1 then TypeRegistry.write(item, "Duration", tostring(vals[1] / factor))
	elseif #vals >= 2 then TypeRegistry.write(item, "Duration", string.format("%.4g, %.4g", vals[1] / factor, vals[2] / factor))
	end
end

-- factor 2 is twice as fast: half the durations, double the rates.
function QOL.applyRetime(snapshots, factor)
	for item, snap in pairs(snapshots) do
		if not item.Parent then continue end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			if snap.Lifetime then item.Lifetime = QOL.scaleRange(snap.Lifetime, 1 / factor) end
			if snap.Rate then item.Rate = snap.Rate * factor end
			if snap.Speed then item.Speed = QOL.scaleRange(snap.Speed, factor) end
			-- Drag is a per-second decay rate, so it follows the time factor like the typeDef.retime lists.
			if snap.Drag then item.Drag = snap.Drag * factor end
			if snap.RotSpeed then item.RotSpeed = QOL.scaleRange(snap.RotSpeed, factor) end
			if snap.FlipbookFramerate then item.FlipbookFramerate = QOL.scaleRange(snap.FlipbookFramerate, factor) end
			if snap.Acceleration then item.Acceleration = QOL.scaleVector3(snap.Acceleration, factor * factor) end
			if snap._emitDuration and snap._emitDuration ~= 0 then item:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", snap._emitDuration / factor) end
			if snap._emitDelay and snap._emitDelay ~= 0 then item:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", snap._emitDelay / factor) end
		else
			local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
			if typeDef and typeDef.retime then
				for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.retime.divideRanges or {}) do
					if snap[k] then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, QOL.scaleRange(snap[k], 1 / factor)) end
				end
				for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.retime.multiplyRanges or {}) do
					if snap[k] then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, QOL.scaleRange(snap[k], factor)) end
				end
				for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.retime.divideNumbers or {}) do
					if snap[k] then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, snap[k] / factor) end
				end
				for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.retime.multiplyNumbers or {}) do
					if snap[k] then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, snap[k] * factor) end
				end
				scaleGraphsFrom(item, snap, typeDef.retime.multiplyGraphs, "x", factor)
				-- RotSpeed only in RotMode "Speed"; OverLife is an angle, not a rate.
				local rotMode = TypeRegistry.read(item, "RotMode")
				if rotMode == "Speed" then
					scaleGraphsFrom(item, snap, typeDef.retime.rotSpeedGraphs, "x", factor)
				end
				for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.retime.squareVectors or {}) do
					if snap[k] then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, QOL.scaleVector3(snap[k], factor * factor)) end
				end
				-- Scalar accelerations (studs/s²) scale by factor² like squareVectors.
				for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.retime.squareNumbers or {}) do
					if snap[k] then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, snap[k] * factor * factor) end
				end
				for _, k in ipairs(typeDef.retime.squareRanges or {}) do
					local range = snap[k]
					if typeof(range) == "NumberRange" then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, NumberRange.new(range.Min * factor * factor, range.Max * factor * factor)) end
				end
				if typeDef.directAccess then QOL.syncTrailDuration(item, snap, factor)
				else
					-- Not for Trails: syncTrailDuration handles theirs.
					if snap._emitDuration and snap._emitDuration ~= 0 then item:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", snap._emitDuration / factor) end
					if snap._emitDelay and snap._emitDelay ~= 0 then item:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", snap._emitDelay / factor) end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end


local function _opNum(op, val, v)
	if op == "x" then return v * val
	elseif op == "/" then return v / val
	elseif op == "+" then return v + val
	elseif op == "-" then return v - val
	end; return v
end

local function _opRange(op, val, r)
	if op == "x" then return QOL.scaleRange(r, val)
	elseif op == "/" then return QOL.scaleRange(r, 1 / val)
	elseif op == "+" then return NumberRange.new(r.Min + val, r.Max + val)
	elseif op == "-" then
		local a, b = r.Min - val, r.Max - val
		return NumberRange.new(math.min(a, b), math.max(a, b))
	end; return r
end

-- scaleEnv: the envelope follows the value: multiplied under x and /, shifted under + and -.
local function _opSeq(op, val, s, scaleEnv)
	if op == "x" then return QOL.scaleSequence(s, val, scaleEnv)
	elseif op == "/" then return QOL.scaleSequence(s, 1 / val, scaleEnv)
	elseif op == "+" then return QOL.shiftSequence(s, val, scaleEnv)
	elseif op == "-" then return QOL.shiftSequence(s, -val, scaleEnv)
	end; return s
end

local function _opVec3(op, val, a)
	if op == "x" then return a * val
	elseif op == "/" then return a / val
	elseif op == "+" then return a + Vector3.new(val, val, val)
	elseif op == "-" then return a - Vector3.new(val, val, val)
	end; return a
end

local function _opVec2(op, val, a)
	if op == "x" then return a * val
	elseif op == "/" then return a / val
	elseif op == "+" then return a + Vector2.new(val, val)
	elseif op == "-" then return a - Vector2.new(val, val)
	end; return a
end

-- + and - shift Offset only (a pixel amount means nothing to Scale); x and / scale both.
local function _opUDim2(op, val, u)
	if op == "x" then return UDim2.new(u.X.Scale * val, u.X.Offset * val, u.Y.Scale * val, u.Y.Offset * val)
	elseif op == "/" then return UDim2.new(u.X.Scale / val, u.X.Offset / val, u.Y.Scale / val, u.Y.Offset / val)
	elseif op == "+" then return UDim2.new(u.X.Scale, u.X.Offset + val, u.Y.Scale, u.Y.Offset + val)
	elseif op == "-" then return UDim2.new(u.X.Scale, u.X.Offset - val, u.Y.Scale, u.Y.Offset - val)
	end; return u
end

-- Keypoint values between 0 and 1, each envelope within both bounds.
function QOL.clampSeqUnit(seq)
	local new = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
		local v = math.clamp(kp.Value, 0, 1)
		table.insert(new, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, v, math.max(0, math.min(kp.Envelope, v, 1 - v))))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(new)
end

-- One value shifted as shiftItems shifts a property: a number, NumberRange or NumberSequence
-- (anything else gives nil). clamp "nonNeg" keeps it at 0 or more, "unit" between 0 and 1.
-- ClipSlots' Blender states and decal layers shift through it (ClipShiftFix).
function QOL.shiftValue(op, val, value, scaleEnv, clamp)
	local kind = typeof(value)
	if kind == "number" then
		local result = _opNum(op, val, value)
		if clamp == "unit" then return math.clamp(result, 0, 1) end
		if clamp == "nonNeg" then return math.max(0, result) end
		return result
	elseif kind == "NumberRange" then
		local result = _opRange(op, val, value)
		if clamp == "unit" then return NumberRange.new(math.clamp(result.Min, 0, 1), math.clamp(result.Max, 0, 1)) end
		if clamp == "nonNeg" then return NumberRange.new(math.max(0, result.Min), math.max(0, result.Max)) end
		return result
	elseif kind == "NumberSequence" then
		local result = _opSeq(op, val, value, scaleEnv)
		if clamp == "unit" then return QOL.clampSeqUnit(result) end
		if clamp == "nonNeg" then return QOL.clampSeqNonNeg(result) end
		return result
	end
	return nil
end

-- A Trail's Duration range string, shifted value by value.
function QOL.shiftTrailDuration(item, op, val)
	local raw = TypeRegistry.read(item, "Duration")
	if raw == nil then return end
	local text = tostring(raw)
	local vals = {}
	for v in text:gmatch("[^,]+") do local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.+)%s*$")); if n then table.insert(vals, n) end end
	if #vals == 1 then
		TypeRegistry.write(item, "Duration", tostring(math.max(0, _opNum(op, val, vals[1]))))
	elseif #vals >= 2 then
		local r1, r2 = math.max(0, _opNum(op, val, vals[1])), math.max(0, _opNum(op, val, vals[2]))
		TypeRegistry.write(item, "Duration", string.format("%.4g, %.4g", r1, r2))
	end
end

-- op: "x" | "/" | "+" | "-"
function QOL.shiftItems(items, propNames, op, val, scaleEnv)
	if op == "/" and val == 0 then return end

	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
		if not typeDef then continue end
		for _, n in ipairs(propNames) do
			local propDef = typeDef.properties[n]
			if not propDef then
				-- Else an item-level attribute (EmitCount, EmitDelay, EmitDuration).
				local av = item:GetAttribute(n)
				if av ~= nil and typeof(av) == "number" then item:SetAttribute(n, math.max(0, _opNum(op, val, av))) end
				continue
			end
			local v = TypeRegistry.read(item, n)
			if v == nil then continue end
			local nonNeg = TypeRegistry.isNonNegative(propDef)
			local kind = typeof(v)
			if kind == "NumberSequence" or kind == "NumberRange" or kind == "number" then
				TypeRegistry.write(item, n, QOL.shiftValue(op, val, v, scaleEnv, nonNeg and "nonNeg" or nil))
				if kind == "NumberSequence" then shiftLiveHandles(item, n, op, val, scaleEnv) end
			elseif kind == "ColorSequence" then
				-- Colours are not shifted.
			elseif typeof(v) == "Vector3" then
				local result = _opVec3(op, val, v)
				if nonNeg then result = Vector3.new(math.max(0, result.X), math.max(0, result.Y), math.max(0, result.Z)) end
				TypeRegistry.write(item, n, result)
			elseif typeof(v) == "Vector2" then
				local result = _opVec2(op, val, v)
				if nonNeg then result = Vector2.new(math.max(0, result.X), math.max(0, result.Y)) end
				TypeRegistry.write(item, n, result)
			elseif typeof(v) == "UDim2" then
				TypeRegistry.write(item, n, _opUDim2(op, val, v))
			elseif typeof(v) == "string" and propDef.attribute then
				QOL.shiftTrailDuration(item, op, val)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Native PE properties kept at 0 or more: the engine draws a negative as 0 but keeps it stored,
-- which breaks later shifts. RotSpeed is left out: a negative one spins the other way.
local PE_NONNEG_PROPS = {
	Size = true, Rate = true, Lifetime = true, Drag = true,
	FlipbookFramerate = true,
	Brightness = true, TimeScale = true,
	LightEmission = true, LightInfluence = true, VelocityInheritance = true,
}

-- scalarUnit native PE props  -  clamp scalar shifts at upper bound 1.0 too.
local PE_UNIT_PROPS = {
	LightEmission = true, LightInfluence = true, VelocityInheritance = true,
}

function QOL.shiftPEs(items, propNames, op, val, scaleEnv)
	if op == "/" and val == 0 then return end

	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		for _, n in ipairs(propNames) do
			local nonNeg = PE_NONNEG_PROPS[n] == true
			local unitCap = PE_UNIT_PROPS[n] == true
			local ok, g = pcall(function() return item[n] end)
			if not ok or g == nil then
				-- Else an item-level attribute (EmitCount, EmitDelay, EmitDuration).
				local av = item:GetAttribute(n)
				if av ~= nil and typeof(av) == "number" then item:SetAttribute(n, math.max(0, _opNum(op, val, av))) end
				continue
			end
			if typeof(g) == "NumberSequence" then
				local result = _opSeq(op, val, g, scaleEnv)
				if nonNeg then result = QOL.clampSeqNonNeg(result) end
				pcall(function() item[n] = result end)
				shiftLiveHandles(item, n, op, val, scaleEnv)
			elseif typeof(g) == "NumberRange" then
				local result = _opRange(op, val, g)
				if nonNeg then result = NumberRange.new(math.max(0, result.Min), math.max(0, result.Max)) end
				pcall(function() item[n] = result end)
			elseif typeof(g) == "number" then
				local result = _opNum(op, val, g)
				if nonNeg then result = math.max(0, result) end
				if unitCap then result = math.min(1, result) end
				pcall(function() item[n] = result end)
			elseif typeof(g) == "Vector2" then
				-- SpreadAngle, the PE's one Vector2: both parts kept at 0 or more.
				local result = Vector2.new(_opNum(op, val, g.X), _opNum(op, val, g.Y))
				if nonNeg or n == "SpreadAngle" then result = Vector2.new(math.max(0, result.X), math.max(0, result.Y)) end
				pcall(function() item[n] = result end)
			elseif typeof(g) == "Vector3" then
				pcall(function() item[n] = _opVec3(op, val, g) end)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- GraphBlender colour snapshots (Beam blender states; HueShift shifts them)

function QOL.snapshotBlender(beam)
	local gb = beam:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender"); if not gb then return nil end
	local snaps = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(gb:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Configuration") then
			local color = child:GetAttribute("Color")
			if color then table.insert(snaps, {config = child, origColor = color}) end
		end
	end
	return #snaps > 0 and snaps or nil
end

-- What a tool (Resize, Retime, Hue) works on for a selection. `seeds` is a list of lists of
-- items; with `withDescendants`, each transformed seed adds the transformed items and
-- ParticleEmitters nested in it (asked of the engine). Every Beam and Trail part-icle among them
-- also gets its GraphBlender's colours snapshotted, which it draws instead of its config's.
-- Returns items, snapshots, blenderSnapshots.
function QOL.snapshotSelection(seeds, transformedSeeds, withDescendants)
	local items, seen = {}, {}
	for _, bucket in ipairs(seeds) do
		for _, item in ipairs(bucket) do
			if not seen[item] then
				table.insert(items, item)
				seen[item] = true
			end
		end
	end
	if withDescendants then
		for _, item in ipairs(transformedSeeds) do
			-- An instance matching both selectors comes back twice: `seen` keeps it once.
			for _, nested in ipairs(item:QueryDescendants("[$Transformed], ParticleEmitter")) do
				if (nested:GetAttribute("Transformed") or nested:IsA("ParticleEmitter")) and not seen[nested] then
					table.insert(items, nested)
					seen[nested] = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local snapshots, blenderSnapshots = {}, {}
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		snapshots[item] = QOL.snapshotItem(item)
		if (item:IsA("Beam") or item:IsA("Trail")) and item:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME) then
			blenderSnapshots[item] = QOL.snapshotBlender(item)
		end
	end
	return items, snapshots, blenderSnapshots
end

function QOL.restoreBlenderSnapshots(blenderSnapshots)
	for _, snaps in pairs(blenderSnapshots) do
		for _, s in ipairs(snaps) do
			if s.config and s.config.Parent then pcall(function() s.config:SetAttribute("Color", s.origColor) end) end
		end
	end
end

return QOL

--[[
	Rolls random values for the selected items' properties, previews them, then applies or reverts.
	  Rules: bounds per property and a generator per value type.
	  Writer: writes one rolled value to an item.
	  Cancel: reverts only the properties the Randomizer wrote.
	  Wiring: the panel's state machine, a factory Bootstrap calls with its deps.
	  Bootstrap: attach(deps) wires the toolbar and panel buttons.
]]

-- Yields between requires so the submodules start across frames, not in one.
local Rules = require(script.RandomizerRules); task.wait()
local Writer = require(script.RandomizerWriter); task.wait()
local Cancel = require(script.Cancel); task.wait()
local Wiring = require(script.RandomizerWiring); task.wait()
local Bootstrap = require(script.Bootstrap); task.wait()

return {
	Rules = Rules,
	Writer = Writer,
	Cancel = Cancel,
	Wiring = Wiring,
	Bootstrap = Bootstrap,
}

--[[
	RandomizerBootstrap  -  Randomizer wiring entry point

	attach(deps) -> wiring: builds the state machine (kept on ctx.RandomizerWiring) and wires the
	toolbar toggle and the panel's Roll, Apply, Cancel and header X buttons.
	Every close path (Cancel, header X) goes through wiring.cancel(), which restores the preview.
	deps: ctx, UI, Connections, Randomizer (this barrel), PropertyCatalog, QOL, TypeRegistry,
	ChangeHistoryService, ToolPanels, Widgets, Theme.
]]

local Bootstrap = {}

function Bootstrap.attach(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local UI = deps.UI
	local Connections = deps.Connections
	local Randomizer = deps.Randomizer

	local wiring = Randomizer.Wiring({
		ctx = ctx,
		panel = {
			panel = UI.RandomizerPanel,
			sectionList = UI.RandomizerSectionList,
			rollAllBtn = UI.RandomizerRollAllBtn,
			applyBtn = UI.RandomizerApplyBtn,
			cancelBtn = UI.RandomizerCancelBtn,
			headerCloseBtn = UI.RandomizerHeaderCloseBtn,
		},
		PropertyCatalog = deps.PropertyCatalog,
		RandomizerRules = Randomizer.Rules,
		RandomizerWriter = Randomizer.Writer,
		QOL = deps.QOL,
		TypeRegistry = deps.TypeRegistry,
		ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService,
		PE_SECTIONS = (deps.ToolPanels and deps.ToolPanels.PE_SECTIONS) or {},
		Widgets = deps.Widgets,
		Theme = deps.Theme,
	})
	ctx.RandomizerWiring = wiring

	if UI.Randomize then
		Connections["RandomizeToggle"] = UI.Randomize.Activated:Connect(function()
			if wiring.isOpen() then wiring.cancel() else wiring.open() end
		end)
	end

	if UI.RandomizerRollAllBtn then
		Connections["RandomizeRoll"] = UI.RandomizerRollAllBtn.Activated:Connect(function() wiring.rollAll() end)
	end
	if UI.RandomizerApplyBtn then
		Connections["RandomizeApply"] = UI.RandomizerApplyBtn.Activated:Connect(function() wiring.apply() end)
	end
	if UI.RandomizerCancelBtn then
		Connections["RandomizeCancel"] = UI.RandomizerCancelBtn.Activated:Connect(function() wiring.cancel() end)
	end
	if UI.RandomizerHeaderCloseBtn then
		Connections["RandomizeHeaderClose"] = UI.RandomizerHeaderCloseBtn.Activated:Connect(function() wiring.cancel() end)
	end

	return wiring
end

return Bootstrap

--[[
	Randomizer/Cancel

	Cancel that reverts only the (item, property) pairs the Randomizer wrote, so an edit made
	elsewhere while the panel is open survives. Goes through QOL.restoreSnapshots' scoped path.
	  restoreTouchedOnly(bag): bag = { snapshots, lastBatch, retainedBatch, QOL }; the three
	    tables are RandomizerWiring's live ones.
]]

local Cancel = {}

-- Written propKey -> the snapshot key holding the original emit attribute.
local VIRTUAL_KEY = {
	EmitDuration = "_emitDuration",
	EmitDelay = "_emitDelay",
	EmitCount = "_emitCount",
}

-- Native PE properties whose snapshot sits under another key (QOL.restoreSnapshots reads that key).
local PE_KEY = {
	Color = "_peColor",
}

-- Reverts what both roll batches touched. Items without a Parent (deleted) are skipped.
function Cancel.restoreTouchedOnly(bag)
	local snapshots = bag.snapshots
	if not snapshots then return end
	local QOL = bag.QOL
	local touchedMap = {}

	local function harvest(batch)
		if not batch then return end
		for item, itemBatch in pairs(batch) do
			local origSnap = snapshots[item]
			if not (origSnap and item.Parent) then continue end
			local touched = touchedMap[item] or {}
			touchedMap[item] = touched
			for propKey in pairs(itemBatch) do
				if origSnap[propKey] ~= nil then
					touched[propKey] = origSnap[propKey]
				end
				-- An optional property that was absent (QOL.snapshotItem) is taken away again.
				if origSnap._absent and origSnap._absent[propKey] then
					touched._absent = touched._absent or {}
					touched._absent[propKey] = true
				end
				local virtualKey = VIRTUAL_KEY[propKey]
				if virtualKey then
					-- nil would drop the key, which scoped restore skips; NIL_SENTINEL clears the attribute again.
					local origVal = origSnap[virtualKey]
					touched[virtualKey] = (origVal == nil) and (QOL and QOL.NIL_SENTINEL) or origVal
				end
				local peKey = PE_KEY[propKey]
				if peKey then
					touched[peKey] = origSnap[peKey]
				end
				if origSnap._bezierHandles then
					touched._bezierHandles = touched._bezierHandles or {}
					local handleAttr = propKey .. "_BezierHandles"
					touched._bezierHandles[handleAttr] = origSnap._bezierHandles[handleAttr]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	harvest(bag.lastBatch)
	harvest(bag.retainedBatch)
	if next(touchedMap) then
		QOL.restoreSnapshots(touchedMap, true)
	end
end

return Cancel

--[[
	RandomizerOptions  -  the Randomizer panel's three session option rows (Group axes, Randomize
	keypoint count, Reset on uncheck). Their state lives in RandomizerWiring, reached through the bag.
]]

local RandomizerOptions = {}

local function optionRow(bag, name, labelText, isOn, onFlip)
	local W, Th = bag.W, bag.Th
	local row = W.makeBlob(name .. "Row", bag.sectionList, UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22))
	row.LayoutOrder = -1
	W.addPadding(row, 8, 4, 0, 0)
	local label = W.makeLabel("L", row, labelText, Th.MutedGold, Th.Font, 9)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
	local toggle = W.makeToggle(name, row)
	toggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0.5, -8)
	toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", isOn)
	local conn = toggle:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(function()
		onFlip(toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true)
	end)
	table.insert(bag.toggleConns, conn)
end

-- bag = { W, Th, sectionList, toggleConns, get/set for GroupAxes / RandomizeKeypoints / ResetOnUncheck,
--   hasRetained, clearRetained, hasLastBatch, restoreSnapshots, rollBatch, replayBatch }
function RandomizerOptions.emit(bag)
	-- Flipping drops the retained batch (keyed under the other grouping) and rolls again from the snapshot.
	optionRow(bag, "GroupAxes", "Group axes (X/Y/Z share one rolled value)", bag.getGroupAxes(), function(on)
		bag.setGroupAxes(on)
		bag.clearRetained()
		bag.restoreSnapshots()
		if bag.hasLastBatch() then bag.rollBatch() end
	end)

	-- OFF: sequences roll 2 keypoints; ON: NumberSequence 3..7, ColorSequence 3..6 (palette kept).
	optionRow(bag, "RandomizeKeypoints", "Randomize Keypoint/ColorSequence Count", bag.getRandomizeKeypoints(), function(on)
		bag.setRandomizeKeypoints(on)
		if bag.hasLastBatch() then bag.rollBatch() end
	end)

	-- ON: unchecking reverts that property's preview. OFF: the rolled look stays but leaves the apply batch.
	optionRow(bag, "ResetOnUncheck", "Reset to initial on uncheck", bag.getResetOnUncheck(), function(on)
		bag.setResetOnUncheck(on)
		if on and bag.hasRetained() then
			bag.clearRetained()
			bag.restoreSnapshots()
			bag.replayBatch()
		end
	end)
end

return RandomizerOptions
