-- A rule from override bounds, shaped by propDef.type.
local function _decorateOverride(override, propDef)
	if override.virtualEmitAttr then
		return {
			scalar = true,
			min = override.min, max = override.max,
			integer = override.integer,
			perfSensitive = override.perfSensitive,
			virtualEmitAttr = true,
		}
	end
	-- No propDef (a key not in TypeRegistry): no shape to roll.
	if not propDef then return nil end

	local nn = propDef.nonNegative or false
	-- nonNegative clamps lo to 0 even over a negative override, or TypeRegistry.write would clamp
	-- the roll afterwards and pile values up at 0.
	local lo = override.min if lo == nil then lo = nn and 0 or -10 end
	if nn and lo < 0 then lo = 0 end
	local hi = override.max if hi == nil then hi = 10 end
	local rule = {
		min = lo, max = hi,
		integer = override.integer,
		perfSensitive = override.perfSensitive,
	}
	local t = propDef.type
	if t == "boolean" then return {coin = true} end
	if t == "enum" then return nil end
	if t == "ColorSequence" then return {colorSequence = true} end
	if t == "NumberSequence" then
		rule.numberSequence = true
		rule.minKeypoints = override.minKeypoints or 3
		rule.maxKeypoints = override.maxKeypoints or 7
		return rule
	end
	if t == "NumberRange" then rule.numberRange = true; return rule end
	if t == "number" then rule.scalar = true; return rule end
	if t == "Vector3" then return {vector = true, axes = 3, min = lo, max = hi} end
	if t == "Vector2" then return {vector = true, axes = 2, min = lo, max = hi} end
	if t == "UDim2" then return {udim2 = true} end
	return nil
end

-- No override: defaults from propDef.type and nonNegative.
local function _autoFromPropDef(propDef)
	if not propDef then return nil end
	if propDef.type == "boolean" then return {coin = true} end
	if propDef.type == "enum" then return nil end
	if propDef.type == "ColorSequence" then return {colorSequence = true} end
	local nn = propDef.nonNegative or false
	if propDef.type == "NumberSequence" then
		return {numberSequence = true, min = nn and 0 or -10, max = 10, minKeypoints = 3, maxKeypoints = 7}
	end
	if propDef.type == "NumberRange" then
		return {numberRange = true, min = nn and 0 or -10, max = 10}
	end
	if propDef.type == "number" then
		return {scalar = true, min = nn and 0 or -10, max = 10}
	end
	if propDef.type == "Vector3" then return {vector = true, axes = 3, min = -10, max = 10} end
	if propDef.type == "Vector2" then return {vector = true, axes = 2, min = -10, max = 10} end
	if propDef.type == "UDim2" then return {udim2 = true} end
	return nil
end

-- Kinds of the native ParticleEmitter properties (a PE has no TypeRegistry entry). Booleans are
-- left out; the emit attributes take the virtualEmitAttr path.
local PE_PROP_TYPES = {
	Rate = "scalarPos",
	Lifetime = "numberRange",
	SpreadAngle = "vector2", -- degrees
	EmitCount = "scalarPosInt",
	EmitDelay = "scalarNonNeg",
	EmitDuration = "scalarNonNeg",
	Brightness = "scalarPos",
	Size = "numberSequence",
	Transparency = "numberSequence",
	Color = "colorSequence",
	Squash = "numberSequence",
	LightEmission = "scalarUnit",
	LightInfluence = "scalarUnit",
	ZOffset = "scalarSym",
	Speed = "numberRange",
	RotSpeed = "numberRange",
	Rotation = "numberRange",
	Acceleration = "vector3",
	Drag = "scalarNonNeg",
	VelocityInheritance = "scalarUnit",
	TimeScale = "scalarPos",
	FlipbookFramerate = "numberRange",
}

-- Native-scale bounds where the kind's defaults (numberRange 0..5, numberSequence 0..1) are too small.
local PE_BOUNDS = {
	Speed = {min = 0, max = 50},
	RotSpeed = {min = -360, max = 360},
	Rotation = {min = 0, max = 360},
	Lifetime = {min = 0.1, max = 5},
	Size = {min = 0.5, max = 5},
	Squash = {min = -10, max = 10},
	Rate = {min = 1, max = 80},
	FlipbookFramerate = {min = 1, max = 60},
	Brightness = {min = 0, max = 100},
	-- PE clamps both to 0..1. LightInfluence rolls a value 25% of the time and 0 otherwise, so most
	-- rolled PEs stay unlit.
	LightEmission = {min = 0, max = 1},
	LightInfluence = {min = 0, max = 1, probability = 0.25},
	-- Negative spread angles mean nothing.
	SpreadAngle = {vector = true, axes = 2, min = 0, max = 360},
}

local function _peRule(propKey)
	local kind = PE_PROP_TYPES[propKey]
	if not kind then return nil end
	local override = PE_BOUNDS[propKey]
	local rule
	if kind == "scalarPos" then
		local hi = override and override.max or ((propKey == "Rate" or propKey == "FlipbookFramerate") and 30 or 2)
		local lo = override and override.min or 0
		rule = {scalar = true, min = lo, max = hi}
	elseif kind == "scalarPosInt" then rule = {scalar = true, min = 0, max = 50, integer = true}
	elseif kind == "scalarNonNeg" then rule = {scalar = true, min = 0, max = 3}
	elseif kind == "scalarUnit" then
		local lo = override and override.min or 0
		local hi = override and override.max or 1
		rule = {scalar = true, min = lo, max = hi, probability = override and override.probability}
	elseif kind == "scalarSym" then rule = {scalar = true, min = -2, max = 2}
	elseif kind == "numberRange" then
		local lo = override and override.min or 0
		local hi = override and override.max or 5
		rule = {numberRange = true, min = lo, max = hi}
	elseif kind == "vector2" then
		local lo = override and override.min or -180
		local hi = override and override.max or 180
		rule = {vector = true, axes = 2, min = lo, max = hi}
	elseif kind == "vector3" then rule = {vector = true, axes = 3, min = -10, max = 10}
	elseif kind == "numberSequence" then
		local lo = override and override.min or 0
		local hi = override and override.max or 1
		rule = {numberSequence = true, min = lo, max = hi}
	elseif kind == "colorSequence" then rule = {colorSequence = true}
	end
	if rule then rule.nativePE = true end
	-- Emit attributes are written on the item, not as emitter properties.
	if propKey == "EmitCount" or propKey == "EmitDelay" or propKey == "EmitDuration" then
		rule.virtualEmitAttr = true
		rule.nativePE = nil
	end
	return rule
end

-- Per-type bounds where a property's native scale differs; ahead of byName
-- (ColorCorrection Brightness is -1..1).
RandomizerRules.byTypeAndName = {
	ColorCorrection = {
		Brightness = {min = -1, max = 1, minKeypoints = 3, maxKeypoints = 7},
		Contrast = {min = -1, max = 1, minKeypoints = 3, maxKeypoints = 7},
		Saturation = {min = -1, max = 1, minKeypoints = 3, maxKeypoints = 7},
	},
	Atmosphere = {
		Density = {min = 0, max = 1, minKeypoints = 3, maxKeypoints = 7},
		Offset = {min = 0, max = 1, minKeypoints = 3, maxKeypoints = 7},
		Glare = {min = 0, max = 24, minKeypoints = 3, maxKeypoints = 7},
		Haze = {min = 0, max = 10, minKeypoints = 3, maxKeypoints = 7},
	},
	Distortion = {
		-- byName's Amplitude and Speed are tuned for Lightning and Part.
		Amplitude = {min = 0.1, max = 1, minKeypoints = 2, maxKeypoints = 5},
		Speed = {min = -8, max = 8},
	},
}

function RandomizerRules.derive(typeName, propKey, propDef)
	if RandomizerRules.globalExcludes[propKey] then return nil end
	if typeName == "PE" then return _peRule(propKey) end
	local excludes = RandomizerRules.typeExcludes[typeName]
	if excludes and excludes[propKey] then return nil end

	-- Trail Duration is stored as a "min, max" string: roll a number, the writer makes it a string.
	if typeName == "Trail" and propKey == "Duration" then
		return {scalar = true, min = 0, max = 3, perfSensitive = true, stringForm = true}
	end

	local typeOverrides = RandomizerRules.byTypeAndName[typeName]
	local override = typeOverrides and typeOverrides[propKey] or RandomizerRules.byName[propKey]
	if override then return _decorateOverride(override, propDef) end

	return _autoFromPropDef(propDef)
end

function RandomizerRules.rollScalar(rule)
	-- probability: the chance of rolling a value instead of 0 (PE LightInfluence).
	if rule.probability and math.random() > rule.probability then
		return 0
	end
	local lo, hi = rule.min or 0, rule.max or 1
	if rule.integer then return math.random(math.floor(lo), math.floor(hi)) end
	return lo + math.random() * (hi - lo)
end

function RandomizerRules.rollNumberRange(rule)
	local lo, hi = rule.min or 0, rule.max or 1
	local a = lo + math.random() * (hi - lo)
	local b = lo + math.random() * (hi - lo)
	if a > b then a, b = b, a end
	return NumberRange.new(a, b)
end

-- 2 keypoints at 0 and 1, or minKeypoints..maxKeypoints when rule.randomizeKeypoints is on.
function RandomizerRules.rollNumberSequence(rule)
	local minKp, maxKp
	if rule.randomizeKeypoints then
		minKp = rule.minKeypoints or 3
		maxKp = rule.maxKeypoints or 7
	else
		minKp, maxKp = 2, 2
	end
	local n = math.random(minKp, maxKp)
	local times = {0}
	for i = 1, n - 2 do table.insert(times, math.random()) end
	table.insert(times, 1)
	table.sort(times)
	local lo, hi = rule.min or 0, rule.max or 1
	local rangeSpan = hi - lo
	local kps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local v = lo + math.random() * rangeSpan
		if rule.integer then v = math.floor(v + 0.5) end
		-- Envelope up to half the headroom to the nearer bound, so it stays inside [lo, hi].
		local headroom = math.min(v - lo, hi - v)
		local env = math.random() * headroom * 0.5
		if rule.integer then env = math.floor(env + 0.5) end
		table.insert(kps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, v, env))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(kps)
end

function RandomizerRules.rollColor()
	local h = math.random()
	local s = 0.6 + math.random() * 0.4
	local v = 0.5 + math.random() * 0.5
	return Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
end

-- Palette modes and their weights when the mode is Auto.
local COLOR_MODES = {
	{name = "Analogous",     weight = 3},
	{name = "Complementary", weight = 2},
	{name = "Monochrome",    weight = 2},
	{name = "Warm",          weight = 1},
	{name = "Cool",          weight = 1},
	{name = "WhiteToColor",  weight = 1},
}

local function pickColorMode()
	local total = 0
	for _, m in ipairs(COLOR_MODES) do total = total + m.weight end
	local r = math.random() * total
	local acc = 0
	for _, m in ipairs(COLOR_MODES) do
		acc = acc + m.weight
		if r <= acc then return m.name end
	end
	return COLOR_MODES[1].name
end

local function hsv(h, s, v) return Color3.fromHSV(h % 1, math.clamp(s, 0, 1), math.clamp(v, 0, 1)) end

-- Choices of the per-row palette dropdown (rule.paletteMode); Auto picks by weight.
RandomizerRules.PALETTE_MODES = {"Auto", "Analogous", "Complementary", "Monochrome", "Warm", "Cool", "WhiteToColor"}

-- An unknown mode (a typo, a stale saved setting) falls back to Auto, not to WhiteToColor.
local PALETTE_MODE_SET = {}
for _, name in ipairs(RandomizerRules.PALETTE_MODES) do PALETTE_MODE_SET[name] = true end

-- Colour of keypoint i (0-based) of n; Complementary and WhiteToColor alternate, the rest jitter.
local PALETTE_SAMPLERS = {
	Analogous = function(baseHue, _i, _n)
		local drift = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.32  -- ±0.16 around baseHue
		return hsv(baseHue + drift, 0.6 + math.random() * 0.25, 0.8 + math.random() * 0.15)
	end,
	Complementary = function(baseHue, i, _n)
		local h = ((i % 2) == 0) and baseHue or (baseHue + 0.5) % 1
		return hsv(h, 0.65 + math.random() * 0.2, 0.85 + math.random() * 0.1)
	end,
	Monochrome = function(baseHue, _i, _n)
		return hsv(baseHue, 0.5 + math.random() * 0.4, 0.4 + math.random() * 0.55)
	end,
	Warm = function(_baseHue, _i, _n)
		return hsv(math.random() * 0.2, 0.7 + math.random() * 0.2, 0.85 + math.random() * 0.1)
	end,
	Cool = function(_baseHue, _i, _n)
		return hsv(0.45 + math.random() * 0.25, 0.7 + math.random() * 0.2, 0.85 + math.random() * 0.1)
	end,
	WhiteToColor = function(baseHue, i, _n)
		if (i % 2) == 0 then return Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
		return hsv(baseHue, 0.7 + math.random() * 0.2, 0.85 + math.random() * 0.1)
	end,
}

-- 2 keypoints, or 3..6 when randomizeKeypoints is on; the palette mode applies either way.
function RandomizerRules.rollColorSequence(modeOverride, randomizeKeypoints)
	if modeOverride and not PALETTE_MODE_SET[modeOverride] then modeOverride = nil end
	local mode = (modeOverride and modeOverride ~= "Auto" and modeOverride) or pickColorMode()
	local sampler = PALETTE_SAMPLERS[mode] or PALETTE_SAMPLERS.WhiteToColor
	local n = randomizeKeypoints and math.random(3, 6) or 2
	local times
	if n == 2 then
		times = {0, 1}
	else
		times = {0}
		for _ = 1, n - 2 do table.insert(times, math.random()) end
		table.insert(times, 1)
		table.sort(times)
	end
	local baseHue = math.random()
	local kps = {}
	for i, t in ipairs(times) do
		table.insert(kps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, sampler(baseHue, i - 1, n)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(kps)
end

function RandomizerRules.rollVector(rule)
	local axes = rule.axes or 3
	local lo, hi = rule.min or -10, rule.max or 10
	local span = hi - lo
	if axes == 2 then
		return Vector2.new(lo + math.random() * span, lo + math.random() * span)
	end
	return Vector3.new(lo + math.random() * span, lo + math.random() * span, lo + math.random() * span)
end

-- Scale 0..1, offset 0..200 px.
function RandomizerRules.rollUDim2()
	return UDim2.new(math.random(), math.random(0, 200), math.random(), math.random(0, 200))
end

function RandomizerRules.rollBoolean()
	return math.random() < 0.5
end

-- profile: a list of Enum item names.
function RandomizerRules.rollEnum(profile)
	if not profile or #profile == 0 then return nil end
	return profile[math.random(1, #profile)]
end

function RandomizerRules.roll(rule)
	if not rule then return nil end
	if rule.coin then return RandomizerRules.rollBoolean() end
	if rule.colorSequence then return RandomizerRules.rollColorSequence(rule.paletteMode, rule.randomizeKeypoints) end
	if rule.numberSequence then return RandomizerRules.rollNumberSequence(rule) end
	if rule.numberRange then return RandomizerRules.rollNumberRange(rule) end
	if rule.vector then return RandomizerRules.rollVector(rule) end
	if rule.udim2 then return RandomizerRules.rollUDim2() end
	return RandomizerRules.rollScalar(rule)
end

return RandomizerRules

--[[
	RandomizerSection  -  Randomizer System

	Builds one category section of the Randomizer panel: a header (collapse arrow, none / some / all
	glyph, label) and a row per property (label, palette dropdown on colour sequences, toggle).
	  emit(bag, sec, sectionTypeName, sectionUid, headerText, parent)
	The bag passes RandomizerWiring's tables by reference and its changing scalars as getters, so
	the row closures always read current values.
]]

local M = {}

function M.emit(bag, sec, sectionTypeName, sectionUid, headerText, parent)
	local W = bag.W
	local Th = bag.Th
	local TypeRegistry = bag.TypeRegistry
	local Rules = bag.Rules
	local _checked = bag.checked
	local _paletteMode = bag.paletteMode
	local _itemTypeName = bag.itemTypeName
	local _sectionProps = bag.sectionProps
	local _sectionHeaderRefresh = bag.sectionHeaderRefresh
	local _typeRowToggles = bag.typeRowToggles
	local _typeHeaderRefresh = bag.typeHeaderRefresh
	local _toggleConns = bag.toggleConns
	local AXIS_TO_FAMILY = bag.AXIS_TO_FAMILY
	local _compKey = bag.compKey
	local _hasMixedLinkState = bag.hasMixedLinkState
	local _refreshHeaderGlyph = bag.refreshHeaderGlyph
	local _restoreSnapshots = bag.restoreSnapshots
	local _replayBatch = bag.replayBatch
	local _rollBatch = bag.rollBatch
	local getLastBatch = bag.getLastBatch
	local getGroupAxes = bag.getGroupAxes
	local getResetOnUncheck = bag.getResetOnUncheck
	local getOrInitRetainedBatch = bag.getOrInitRetainedBatch

	local hdr = W.makeBlob("Section_" .. sectionUid, parent, UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22))
	W.addPadding(hdr, 4, 4, 0, 0)
	local glyph = Instance.new("TextButton")
	glyph.Name = "Glyph"
	glyph.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	glyph.Text = "[ ]"
	glyph.Font = Th.Font; glyph.TextSize = 11; glyph.TextColor3 = Th.Gold
	glyph.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	-- As wide as the bracket text, so [ ] sits next to the label.
	glyph.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0); glyph.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, 0)
	glyph.Parent = hdr
	local label = W.makeLabel("L", hdr, headerText, Th.Gold, Th.Font, 11)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 0)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0)

	local sectionBody = Instance.new("Frame")
	sectionBody.Name = "Body_" .. sectionUid
	sectionBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sectionBody.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	sectionBody.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0)
	sectionBody.Parent = parent
	W.addListLayout(sectionBody, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)
	W.addCollapseButton(hdr, {sectionBody}, {anchorLeft = true, arrowPos = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)})

	local sectionComps = {}
	for _, propKey in ipairs(sec.props) do
		table.insert(sectionComps, _compKey(sectionTypeName, propKey))
	end
	_sectionProps[sectionUid] = sectionComps
	local sectionPropsRef = sec.props
	_sectionHeaderRefresh[sectionUid] = function()
		_refreshHeaderGlyph(sectionUid, glyph)
	end

	local rowToggles = {}
	for _, propKey in ipairs(sec.props) do
		local rowComp = _compKey(sectionTypeName, propKey)
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Name = "Row_" .. rowComp
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
		row.Parent = sectionBody

		-- "(mixed link)" when items of this type disagree on whether this axis is linked.
		local labelText = propKey
		if _hasMixedLinkState(sectionTypeName, propKey) then
			labelText = labelText .. "  (mixed link)"
		end

		-- Rules.derive, not the propDef, so PE Color (no TypeRegistry entry) still gets the palette dropdown.
		local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[sectionTypeName]
		local pd = typeDef and typeDef.properties and typeDef.properties[propKey]
		local probeRule = Rules.derive(sectionTypeName, propKey, pd)
		local isColorSeq = probeRule and probeRule.colorSequence
		-- Right padding keeps the text clear of the toggle and, on colour sequences, the dropdown.
		local rightPad = isColorSeq and 122 or 34

		local labelBlob = W.makeBlob("LabelBlob_"..rowComp, row, UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -2))
		labelBlob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1)
		W.addPadding(labelBlob, 14, rightPad, 0, 0)
		W.makeLabel("L", labelBlob, labelText, Th.MutedGold, Th.Font, 10)

		if isColorSeq then
			local current = _paletteMode[rowComp] or "Auto"
			local _, dd, setOnChanged = W.makeDropdown(
				"Pal_" .. rowComp, row,
				Rules.PALETTE_MODES, current
			)
			dd.Size = UDim2.new(0, 84, 0, 18)
			dd.Position = UDim2.new(1, -116, 0.5, -9)
			setOnChanged(function(modeName)
				_paletteMode[rowComp] = modeName ~= "Auto" and modeName or nil
				if _checked[rowComp] and getLastBatch() then _rollBatch() end
			end)
		end

		local toggle = W.makeToggle("Rand_" .. rowComp, row)
		toggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0.5, -8)
		rowToggles[propKey] = toggle
		table.insert(_typeRowToggles[sectionTypeName], {comp = rowComp, toggle = toggle})

		-- Uncheck: the row's entries leave the last batch. With Reset on uncheck they are reverted;
		-- without it they move to the retained batch and still apply. Re-check brings them back.
		local conn = toggle:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(function()
			local on = toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true
			_checked[rowComp] = on or nil
			local lastBatch = getLastBatch()
			-- A grouped axis moves its family's entries only once no sibling axis is checked.
			local family = getGroupAxes() and AXIS_TO_FAMILY[propKey]
			local originsToRemove = {}
			if family then
				local anySiblingChecked = false
				for _, axis in ipairs(family.all) do
					if axis ~= propKey and _checked[_compKey(sectionTypeName, axis)] then
						anySiblingChecked = true; break
					end
				end
				if not anySiblingChecked then originsToRemove[family.primary] = true end
			else
				originsToRemove[propKey] = true
			end

			if on then
				-- Back into the last batch so Apply records them in its undo step; a Roll rebuilds it anyway.
				if next(originsToRemove) then
					local retained = getOrInitRetainedBatch()
					local target = lastBatch
					for item, itemBatch in pairs(retained) do
						if _itemTypeName[item] == sectionTypeName then
							for axis, entry in pairs(itemBatch) do
								if entry.origin and originsToRemove[entry.origin] then
									if target then
										target[item] = target[item] or {}
										target[item][axis] = entry
									end
									itemBatch[axis] = nil
								end
							end
							if not next(itemBatch) then retained[item] = nil end
						end
					end
				end
			elseif lastBatch and next(originsToRemove) then
				local resetOn = getResetOnUncheck()
				local retained = (not resetOn) and getOrInitRetainedBatch() or nil
				for item, itemBatch in pairs(lastBatch) do
					if _itemTypeName[item] == sectionTypeName then
						for axis, entry in pairs(itemBatch) do
							if entry.origin and originsToRemove[entry.origin] then
								if retained then
									retained[item] = retained[item] or {}
									retained[item][axis] = entry
								end
								itemBatch[axis] = nil
							end
						end
						-- An emptied item would pass Apply's _batchHasEntries check.
						if not next(itemBatch) then lastBatch[item] = nil end
					end
				end
				if resetOn then
					_restoreSnapshots()
					_replayBatch()
				end
			end
			if _sectionHeaderRefresh[sectionUid] then _sectionHeaderRefresh[sectionUid]() end
			if _typeHeaderRefresh[sectionTypeName] then _typeHeaderRefresh[sectionTypeName]() end
		end)
		table.insert(_toggleConns, conn)
	end

	-- Any on -> all off, else all on. Each row's IsOn handler does the rest.
	local hdrConn = glyph.Activated:Connect(function()
		local anyOn = false
		for _, pk in ipairs(sectionPropsRef) do
			if _checked[_compKey(sectionTypeName, pk)] then anyOn = true; break end
		end
		local target = not anyOn
		for _, pk in ipairs(sectionPropsRef) do
			local t = rowToggles[pk]
			if t then t:SetAttribute("IsOn", target) end
		end
	end)
	table.insert(_toggleConns, hdrConn)
end

return M

--[[
	RandomizerWiring  -  Randomizer System

	State machine of the Randomizer panel: snapshot, preview, then apply or revert.
	  require(RandomizerWiring)(deps) -> M
	  M.open(): snapshots the selected items and builds the panel; a selection change snapshots again.
	  M.rollAll(): restores the snapshots, rolls each checked property and writes the preview.
	  M.apply(): restores, then writes the batches between two waypoints, so undo holds one step.
	  M.cancel(): reverts only what the Randomizer wrote.
	  M.isOpen(), M.isChecked(typeName, propKey), M.populateSections()
	Rows are keyed "TypeName::PropKey", so each type's section keeps its own ticks. Toggles are read
	from their IsOn attribute, which stays in step with Widgets.makeToggle's own flip.
]]

-- Links are read through AxisLinks.sanitize, as the runtime reads them, so both agree on followers.
local AxisLinks = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.AxisLinks)
local RandomizerSection = require(script.Parent.RandomizerSection)
local RandomizerOptions = require(script.Parent.RandomizerOptions)
local Cancel = require(script.Parent.Cancel)
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local panel = deps.panel
	local PropertyCatalog = deps.PropertyCatalog
	local Rules = deps.RandomizerRules
	local Writer = deps.RandomizerWriter
	local QOL = deps.QOL
	local TypeRegistry = deps.TypeRegistry
	local CHS = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local PE_SECTIONS = deps.PE_SECTIONS or {}
	-- UIBuilder does not re-export Widgets, so it comes as a dep.
	local Widgets = deps.Widgets
	-- The live theme table: each populate reads its current colours.
	local Theme = deps.Theme

	local M = {}

	local _items = nil           -- array of {item, typeName}
	local _snapshots = nil       -- {[item] = QOL.snapshotItem(item)}
	local _checked = {}          -- {[compositeKey] = true|nil}
	-- The last roll, {[item] = {[propKey] = {value, rule, origin}}}; Apply replays it on the snapshots.
	local _lastBatch = nil
	-- Entries unchecked while Reset on uncheck is off: replayed after every restore, and applied.
	local _retainedBatch = nil
	local _open = false
	local _toggleConns = {} -- IsOn listeners, disconnected on close
	-- sectionUid ("TypeName::Category") -> its rows' composite keys, for the header glyph.
	local _sectionProps = {}
	local _sectionHeaderRefresh = {} -- sectionUid -> refreshes its header glyph
	-- typeName -> {{comp, toggle}} of every row of that type; the type glyph flips them all.
	local _typeRowToggles = {}
	local _typeHeaderRefresh = {} -- typeName -> refreshes its type glyph

	-- Axis keys that can be linked (<Key>LinkedTo).
	local AXIS_KEYS_LIST = {
		"SizeX", "SizeY", "SizeZ", "RotX", "RotY", "RotZ",
		"RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ", "PosX", "PosY", "PosZ",
		"PosOffsetX", "PosOffsetY", "PosOffsetZ",
	}
	local AXIS_PROPS = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(AXIS_KEYS_LIST) do AXIS_PROPS[k] = true end

	-- Group axes: one value per family and type, rolled for the primary and written to X, Y and Z
	-- (a linked follower writes its primary instead). Off: each checked axis rolls alone.
	local AXIS_FAMILIES = {
		{primary = "SizeX",      all = {"SizeX", "SizeY", "SizeZ"}},
		{primary = "RotX",       all = {"RotX", "RotY", "RotZ"}},
		{primary = "RotSpeedX",  all = {"RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ"}},
		{primary = "PosX",       all = {"PosX", "PosY", "PosZ"}},
		{primary = "PosOffsetX", all = {"PosOffsetX", "PosOffsetY", "PosOffsetZ"}},
	}
	local AXIS_TO_FAMILY = {}
	for _, fam in ipairs(AXIS_FAMILIES) do
		for _, axis in ipairs(fam.all) do AXIS_TO_FAMILY[axis] = fam end
	end
	local _groupAxes = false
	-- Off: sequences roll 2 keypoints (start, end). On: 3..7 for numbers, 3..6 for colours.
	local _randomizeKeypoints = false
	-- On: unchecking a row reverts its preview. Off: the rolled look stays and Apply still writes it
	-- (the retained batch).
	local _resetOnUncheck = true
	-- "TypeName::PropKey" -> that colour row's palette mode; absent means Auto.
	local _paletteMode = {}

	-- Sanitized links per item, or "none" without a Configuration. Cleared before each roll and on
	-- open and close, so link edits made in Properties are read again.
	local _resolvedLinks = {}  -- {[item] = AxisLinks.sanitize(raw) | "none"}

	-- item -> typeName, read by the uncheck pass.
	local _itemTypeName = {}
	local function _compKey(typeName, propKey) return typeName .. "::" .. propKey end
	local function _splitComp(comp) return comp:match("^(.-)::(.+)$") end

	local function _resolveLinksFor(item)
		local cached = _resolvedLinks[item]
		if cached == "none" then return nil end
		if cached then return cached end
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		if not config then _resolvedLinks[item] = "none"; return nil end
		local raw = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(AXIS_KEYS_LIST) do raw[k] = config:GetAttribute(k .. "LinkedTo") end
		local resolved = AxisLinks.sanitize(raw)
		_resolvedLinks[item] = resolved
		return resolved
	end

	-- True when items of this type disagree on whether propKey is linked: its row says "(mixed link)".
	local function _hasMixedLinkState(typeName, propKey)
		if not AXIS_PROPS[propKey] or not _items then return false end
		local linkedSeen, unlinkedSeen = false, false
		for _, e in ipairs(_items) do
			if e.typeName ~= typeName then continue end
			-- No Configuration (Trail, PE): no links.
			local resolved = _resolveLinksFor(e.item)
			if resolved then
				if resolved[propKey] ~= nil then linkedSeen = true else unlinkedSeen = true end
				if linkedSeen and unlinkedSeen then return true end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function _typeNameFor(item)
		local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
		if not typeDef then return nil end
		for _, name in ipairs(PropertyCatalog.TYPE_NAMES) do
			if TypeRegistry.Types[name] == typeDef then return name end
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- {item, typeName} for each selected item, raw PEs and Trails included.
	local function _collectFromSelection()
		local list = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(ctx.currentTransformed or {}) do
			local typeName = _typeNameFor(item)
			if typeName then table.insert(list, {item = item, typeName = typeName}) end
		end
		for _, trail in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails or {}) do
			table.insert(list, {item = trail, typeName = "Trail"})
		end
		for _, pe in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs or {}) do
			table.insert(list, {item = pe, typeName = "PE"})
		end
		-- A plain BeamNative has nothing to roll and is left out.
		return list
	end

	-- Reverts only what the Randomizer wrote, so edits made in Properties meanwhile survive.
	local function _restoreSnapshots()
		if not _snapshots then return end
		Cancel.restoreTouchedOnly({
			snapshots = _snapshots,
			lastBatch = _lastBatch,
			retainedBatch = _retainedBatch,
			QOL = QOL,
		})
	end

	-- An item's batch can be empty after uncheck pruning.
	local function _batchHasEntries(batch)
		if not batch then return false end
		for _, itemBatch in pairs(batch) do if next(itemBatch) then return true end end
		return false
	end

	local function _writeBatch(batch)
		if not batch then return end
		for item, itemBatch in pairs(batch) do
			if item.Parent then
				for propKey, entry in pairs(itemBatch) do
					Writer.write(item, propKey, entry.value, entry.rule)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- Retained first, so a fresh roll wins where both write.
	local function _replayBatch() _writeBatch(_retainedBatch); _writeBatch(_lastBatch) end

	-- Restores the snapshots, then rolls each checked property once per (type, bucket) and writes it to
	-- every item of that type. The bucket is the family primary when axes are grouped, else the propKey.
	-- _lastBatch records the writes actually made, promoted primaries included.
	local function _rollBatch()
		if not _items or not _snapshots then return end
		_resolvedLinks = {}
		_restoreSnapshots()
		-- Retained entries first; fresh rolls overwrite them where both write.
		_writeBatch(_retainedBatch)
		_lastBatch = {}

		-- (typeName, bucketKey) -> {value, rule}, or false when nothing rolls. A nil propDef still derives
		-- (emit attributes are not in TypeRegistry).
		local rolledBuckets = {}
		local function _ensureBucketRoll(typeName, bucketKey)
			rolledBuckets[typeName] = rolledBuckets[typeName] or {}
			local cache = rolledBuckets[typeName]
			local cached = cache[bucketKey]
			if cached ~= nil then return cached or nil end
			local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
			local propDef = typeDef and typeDef.properties and typeDef.properties[bucketKey]
			local rule = Rules.derive(typeName, bucketKey, propDef)
			if not rule then cache[bucketKey] = false; return nil end
			if rule.colorSequence and _paletteMode[_compKey(typeName, bucketKey)] then
				rule.paletteMode = _paletteMode[_compKey(typeName, bucketKey)]
			end
			rule.randomizeKeypoints = _randomizeKeypoints
			local value = Rules.roll(rule)
			if value == nil then cache[bucketKey] = false; return nil end
			local entry = {value = value, rule = rule}
			cache[bucketKey] = entry
			return entry
		end

		-- Per type: checking Part SizeX does not roll a Beam's axes.
		local familyTouchedByType = {}  -- {[typeName]={[primary]=true}}
		if _groupAxes then
			for comp, on in pairs(_checked) do
				if on then
					local tn, pk = _splitComp(comp)
					if tn and pk and AXIS_TO_FAMILY[pk] then
						familyTouchedByType[tn] = familyTouchedByType[tn] or {}
						familyTouchedByType[tn][AXIS_TO_FAMILY[pk].primary] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for _, e in ipairs(_items) do
			if not e.item.Parent then continue end
			local itemBatch = {}
			local typeName = e.typeName
			local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
			local resolved = _resolveLinksFor(e.item)
			local typeChecked = {}  -- {[propKey]=true}
			for comp, on in pairs(_checked) do
				if on then
					local tn, pk = _splitComp(comp)
					if tn == typeName and pk then typeChecked[pk] = true end
				end
			end
			if not next(typeChecked) then continue end

			-- Writes one rolled entry to axis, or to its linked primary. origin is the checked key (the family
			-- primary when grouped) that the uncheck pass looks for. Emit attributes and native PE properties
			-- skip the property check and the links.
			-- mode "any": follow links. "direct": skip linked axes. "promoted": only linked axes, and only when
			-- the primary is still unwritten, so a directly checked primary wins.
			local function _writeOrPromote(axis, origin, entry, mode)
				mode = mode or "any"
				local isVirtual = entry.rule and entry.rule.virtualEmitAttr
				-- A PE has no TypeRegistry entry; derive already checked the key.
				local isNativePE = entry.rule and entry.rule.nativePE
				if not isVirtual and not isNativePE
					and not (typeDef and typeDef.properties and typeDef.properties[axis]) then
					return
				end
				local link = (not isVirtual) and (not isNativePE) and resolved and resolved[axis] or nil
				if mode == "direct" and link then return end
				if mode == "promoted" and (isVirtual or not link) then return end
				local target
				if isVirtual then
					target = axis
				elseif link and (mode == "any" or mode == "promoted") then
					target = link
				else
					target = axis
				end
				if itemBatch[target] then return end
				itemBatch[target] = {value = entry.value, rule = entry.rule, origin = origin}
				Writer.write(e.item, target, entry.value, entry.rule)
			end

			if _groupAxes then
				-- One roll per family touched. origin is the family primary, so unchecking its last axis finds it.
				local typeFamilies = familyTouchedByType[typeName] or {}
				for primary, _ in pairs(typeFamilies) do
					local family = AXIS_TO_FAMILY[primary]
					local entry = _ensureBucketRoll(typeName, primary)
					if entry then
						for _, axis in ipairs(family.all) do _writeOrPromote(axis, primary, entry) end
					end
				end
				for propKey, _on in pairs(typeChecked) do
					if not AXIS_TO_FAMILY[propKey] then
						local entry = _ensureBucketRoll(typeName, propKey)
						if entry then _writeOrPromote(propKey, propKey, entry) end
					end
				end
			else
				-- Two passes: with SizeX and its linked follower SizeY both checked, the direct SizeX value wins
				-- whatever order pairs() gives.
				for propKey, _on in pairs(typeChecked) do
					local entry = _ensureBucketRoll(typeName, propKey)
					if entry then _writeOrPromote(propKey, propKey, entry, "direct") end
				end
				for propKey, _on in pairs(typeChecked) do
					local entry = _ensureBucketRoll(typeName, propKey)
					if entry then _writeOrPromote(propKey, propKey, entry, "promoted") end
				end
			end

			if next(itemBatch) then _lastBatch[e.item] = itemBatch end
		end
	end

	-- Studio can clear and restore Selection during a click: snapshot again only when the items or
	-- their types really change.
	local function _sameItems(a, b)
		if not a or not b or #a ~= #b then return false end
		local seen = {}
		for _, e in ipairs(a) do seen[e.item] = e.typeName end
		for _, e in ipairs(b) do
			if seen[e.item] ~= e.typeName then return false end
			seen[e.item] = nil
		end
		return true
	end

	-- Restores, then snapshots the selection again. Ticks and palette modes of types still selected
	-- survive, so growing the selection keeps them.
	local function _reinitFromSelection(precollected)
		_restoreSnapshots()
		local items = precollected or _collectFromSelection()
		_items = items
		_snapshots = {}
		_itemTypeName = {}
		local typeNamesPresent = {}
		for _, e in ipairs(_items) do
			_snapshots[e.item] = QOL.snapshotItem(e.item)
			_itemTypeName[e.item] = e.typeName
			typeNamesPresent[e.typeName] = true
		end
		_lastBatch = nil
		_retainedBatch = nil
		_resolvedLinks = {}
		for compositeKey in pairs(_checked) do
			local typeName = compositeKey:match("^([^:]+)::")
			if not (typeName and typeNamesPresent[typeName]) then _checked[compositeKey] = nil end
		end
		for compositeKey in pairs(_paletteMode) do
			local typeName = compositeKey:match("^([^:]+)::")
			if not (typeName and typeNamesPresent[typeName]) then _paletteMode[compositeKey] = nil end
		end
	end

	local _selectionConn = nil

	function M.open()
		if _open then return end
		_snapshots = nil -- so the first restore does nothing
		_reinitFromSelection()
		-- Session options start at their defaults on every open.
		_groupAxes = true
		_randomizeKeypoints = false
		_resetOnUncheck = true
		_open = true
		M.populateSections()
		panel.panel.Visible = true
		-- Deferred: connection order is not guaranteed, and the plugin's own selection handler must update
		-- ctx.currentTransformed first.
		if _selectionConn then _selectionConn:Disconnect() end
		_selectionConn = Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()
			task.defer(function()
				if not _open then return end
				local nextItems = _collectFromSelection()
				if _sameItems(_items or {}, nextItems) then return end
				_reinitFromSelection(nextItems)
				M.populateSections()
			end)
		end)
	end

	function M.rollAll() _rollBatch() end

	function M.apply()
		if not _open then return end
		-- Nothing rolled: close without a waypoint.
		if not _batchHasEntries(_lastBatch) and not _batchHasEntries(_retainedBatch) then
			M._teardown()
			return
		end
		CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Randomize")
		_restoreSnapshots()
		_replayBatch()
		CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Randomize")
		M._teardown()
	end

	function M.cancel()
		if not _open then return end
		Cancel.restoreTouchedOnly({
			snapshots = _snapshots,
			lastBatch = _lastBatch,
			retainedBatch = _retainedBatch,
			QOL = QOL,
		})
		M._teardown()
	end

	-- The palette dropdown's list lives in the ScreenGui and outlives the panel, and makeDropdown turns
	-- the section list's ScrollingEnabled off while hovered: rows rebuilt under the cursor never get
	-- MouseLeave. Used by populateSections and _teardown.
	local function _closeDropdownUi()
		if Widgets.hideDropdownExpansion then Widgets.hideDropdownExpansion() end
		if panel.sectionList then panel.sectionList.ScrollingEnabled = true end
	end

	function M._teardown()
		_snapshots = nil
		_items = nil
		_itemTypeName = {}
		_lastBatch = nil
		_retainedBatch = nil
		_checked = {}
		_open = false
		for _, conn in ipairs(_toggleConns) do conn:Disconnect() end
		_toggleConns = {}
		_resolvedLinks = {}
		if _selectionConn then _selectionConn:Disconnect(); _selectionConn = nil end
		_closeDropdownUi()
		panel.panel.Visible = false
		-- A minimized panel has a tray chip; the session it would reopen is gone.
		if Widgets.restoreChip then Widgets.restoreChip(panel.panel) end
	end

	function M.isChecked(typeName, propKey) return _checked[_compKey(typeName, propKey)] == true end
	function M.isOpen() return _open end

	-- A section header's glyph from _checked: [ ], [~] or [X].
	local function _refreshHeaderGlyph(sectionName, glyphLabel)
		local props = _sectionProps[sectionName]
		if not props or #props == 0 then glyphLabel.Text = "[ ]"; return end
		local on = 0
		for _, k in ipairs(props) do if _checked[k] then on = on + 1 end end
		if on == 0 then glyphLabel.Text = "[ ]"
		elseif on == #props then glyphLabel.Text = "[X]"
		else glyphLabel.Text = "[~]" end
	end

	-- Rebuilds the option rows, a header per type and each category section.
	function M.populateSections()
		_closeDropdownUi()
		for _, child in ipairs(panel.sectionList:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		for _, conn in ipairs(_toggleConns) do conn:Disconnect() end
		_toggleConns = {}
		_sectionProps = {}
		_sectionHeaderRefresh = {}
		_typeRowToggles = {}
		_typeHeaderRefresh = {}
		-- One header per selected type ("Part (3 selected)") with its categories beneath, as in Properties.
		local typesInSel = {}
		local countByType = {}
		if _items then
			for _, e in ipairs(_items) do
				typesInSel[e.typeName] = true
				countByType[e.typeName] = (countByType[e.typeName] or 0) + 1
			end
		end
		local sections = PropertyCatalog.randomizableSectionsByType(TypeRegistry, PE_SECTIONS, Rules, typesInSel)
		local Th = Theme
		local W = Widgets

		RandomizerOptions.emit({
			W = W, Th = Th, sectionList = panel.sectionList, toggleConns = _toggleConns,
			getGroupAxes = function() return _groupAxes end,
			setGroupAxes = function(on) _groupAxes = on end,
			getRandomizeKeypoints = function() return _randomizeKeypoints end,
			setRandomizeKeypoints = function(on) _randomizeKeypoints = on end,
			getResetOnUncheck = function() return _resetOnUncheck end,
			setResetOnUncheck = function(on) _resetOnUncheck = on end,
			hasRetained = function() return _retainedBatch ~= nil end,
			clearRetained = function() _retainedBatch = nil end,
			hasLastBatch = function() return _lastBatch ~= nil end,
			restoreSnapshots = _restoreSnapshots, rollBatch = _rollBatch, replayBatch = _replayBatch,
		})

		local sectionsByType = {}
		local typeOrder = {}
		for _, sec in ipairs(sections) do
			if not sectionsByType[sec.typeName] then
				sectionsByType[sec.typeName] = {}
				table.insert(typeOrder, sec.typeName)
			end
			table.insert(sectionsByType[sec.typeName], sec)
		end
		for _, typeName in ipairs(typeOrder) do
			-- The type header's arrow collapses typeChildren, every category beneath it.
			local typeContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
			typeContainer.Name = "TypeContainer_"..typeName
			typeContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			typeContainer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			typeContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
			typeContainer.Parent = panel.sectionList
			W.addListLayout(typeContainer, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)

			local typeHdr = W.makeBlob("Type_"..typeName, typeContainer, UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26))
			W.addPadding(typeHdr, 4, 4, 0, 0)
			local typeGlyph = Instance.new("TextButton")
			typeGlyph.Name = "TypeGlyph"
			typeGlyph.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			typeGlyph.Text = "[ ]"
			typeGlyph.Font = Th.Font; typeGlyph.TextSize = 12; typeGlyph.TextColor3 = Th.BrightGold
			typeGlyph.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			-- As wide as the bracket text, so [ ] sits next to the label.
			typeGlyph.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0); typeGlyph.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, 0)
			typeGlyph.Parent = typeHdr
			-- A raw PE has no TypeRegistry entry: titled "Particles", as in Properties.
			local typeDef0 = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
			local displayName = (typeDef0 and typeDef0.uiSection)
				or (typeName == "PE" and "Particles")
				or typeName
			local typeLbl = W.makeLabel("L", typeHdr,
				("%s (%d selected)"):format(displayName, countByType[typeName] or 0),
				Th.BrightGold, Th.Font, 12)
			typeLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 0)
			typeLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0)
			typeLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

			local typeChildren = Instance.new("Frame")
			typeChildren.Name = "TypeChildren_"..typeName
			typeChildren.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			typeChildren.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			typeChildren.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
			typeChildren.Parent = typeContainer
			W.addListLayout(typeChildren, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)
			W.addPadding(typeChildren, 12, 0, 0, 0)
			W.addCollapseButton(typeHdr, {typeChildren}, {anchorLeft = true, arrowPos = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)})

			_typeRowToggles[typeName] = {}
			local typeNameRef = typeName
			local typeGlyphRef = typeGlyph
			_typeHeaderRefresh[typeName] = function()
				local lst = _typeRowToggles[typeNameRef]
				if not lst or #lst == 0 then typeGlyphRef.Text = "[ ]"; return end
				local on = 0
				for _, e in ipairs(lst) do if _checked[e.comp] then on = on + 1 end end
				typeGlyphRef.Text = (on == 0 and "[ ]") or (on == #lst and "[X]") or "[~]"
			end
			local typeGlyphConn = typeGlyph.Activated:Connect(function()
				local lst = _typeRowToggles[typeNameRef]
				if not lst then return end
				local anyOn = false
				for _, e in ipairs(lst) do if _checked[e.comp] then anyOn = true; break end end
				local target = not anyOn
				for _, e in ipairs(lst) do e.toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", target) end
			end)
			table.insert(_toggleConns, typeGlyphConn)

			local sectionBag = {
				W = W, Th = Th, TypeRegistry = TypeRegistry, Rules = Rules,
				checked = _checked, paletteMode = _paletteMode, itemTypeName = _itemTypeName,
				sectionProps = _sectionProps, sectionHeaderRefresh = _sectionHeaderRefresh,
				typeRowToggles = _typeRowToggles, typeHeaderRefresh = _typeHeaderRefresh,
				toggleConns = _toggleConns, AXIS_TO_FAMILY = AXIS_TO_FAMILY, compKey = _compKey,
				hasMixedLinkState = _hasMixedLinkState, refreshHeaderGlyph = _refreshHeaderGlyph,
				restoreSnapshots = _restoreSnapshots, replayBatch = _replayBatch, rollBatch = _rollBatch,
				getLastBatch = function() return _lastBatch end,
				getGroupAxes = function() return _groupAxes end,
				getResetOnUncheck = function() return _resetOnUncheck end,
				getOrInitRetainedBatch = function()
					_retainedBatch = _retainedBatch or {}
					return _retainedBatch
				end,
			}
			for _, sec in ipairs(sectionsByType[typeName]) do
				local sectionUid = _compKey(sec.typeName, sec.name)
				RandomizerSection.emit(sectionBag, sec, sec.typeName, sectionUid, sec.name, typeChildren)
			end
		end
		if #typeOrder == 0 then
			local emptyBlob = W.makeBlob("EmptyHint", panel.sectionList, UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22))
			W.addPadding(emptyBlob, 8, 4, 0, 0)
			local emptyLbl = W.makeLabel("L", emptyBlob,
				"No transformed items selected", Th.DarkGold, Th.Font, 10)
			emptyLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		end
	end

	return M
end

--[[
	Writes one rolled value to an item.
	  write(item, propKey, value, rule): emit attributes (EmitCount, EmitDelay, EmitDuration) go on
	    the item, native PE properties on the emitter, the rest through TypeRegistry.write. A graph
	    write also clears <propKey>_BezierHandles, which no longer match the new keypoints.
	  writeBatch(item, batch): batch = {[propKey] = {value, rule}}.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.TypeRegistry)

local RandomizerWriter = {}

function RandomizerWriter.write(item, propKey, value, rule)
	if rule and rule.virtualEmitAttr then
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute(propKey, value) end)
		return
	end
	-- A raw PE has no Configuration: its properties are the emitter's own.
	if rule and rule.nativePE then
		local nativeOk = pcall(function() item[propKey] = value end)
		-- Leftover handles would make the Graph editor redraw the pre-roll curve.
		if nativeOk and (rule.numberSequence or rule.colorSequence) then
			pcall(function() item:SetAttribute(propKey .. "_BezierHandles", nil) end)
		end
		return
	end
	-- stringForm rules (Trail Duration) store a string.
	local writeValue = value
	if rule and rule.stringForm and type(value) == "number" then
		writeValue = tostring(value)
	end
	-- pcall so one bad write does not stop a Roll All.
	local writeOk = pcall(function() TypeRegistry.write(item, propKey, writeValue) end)

	-- Only after a good write, so a failed one keeps its graph's handles. Keyed by the logical propKey,
	-- not the attrName override.
	if writeOk and rule and (rule.numberSequence or rule.colorSequence) then
		-- On the Configuration when there is one, else on the item (raw PE, directAccess Trail).
		local target = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item) or item
		pcall(function() target:SetAttribute(propKey .. "_BezierHandles", nil) end)
	end
end

function RandomizerWriter.writeBatch(item, batch)
	for propKey, entry in pairs(batch) do
		RandomizerWriter.write(item, propKey, entry.value, entry.rule)
	end
end

return RandomizerWriter

--[[
	Scatter  -  fills a region with copies of the user's own pieces, as real parts inside a Reactor.
	  Scatter.points(width, depth, distance, count, random, inside, share) -> { { x, z }, ... }: up to
	    `count` places no two closer than `distance` (Poisson-disk sampling), spread over the whole
	    rectangle; `inside(x, z)` keeps them to a shape covering `share` of it
	  Scatter.outline(shape, width, depth, hollow) -> inside, share ("Circle", or "Box": nil, 1)
	  Scatter.upright(frame, size) -> frame, size: a Region part's box seen from above
	  Scatter.fill(reactor, settings) -> placed, problem, wanted: clones the Pieces (else the Reactor's
	    own parts) over the Region (else a square around them) into its "Scattered" folder, each set
	    on what lies under it; a new Fill replaces the last
	  Scatter.clear(reactor) -> removed; also distance, openSide, ensureValue, sequence
	settings: Count, Spacing, Turn, SizeMin, SizeMax, Seed, Shape ("Box" | "Circle" | "Region shape"), Hollow.
	Mutates LIVE user content: parts under the Reactor (the caller holds the undo waypoints). The
	Pieces and the Region are only read.
	Cross-file: the copies react because Reactor/Pieces takes every part under a Reactor, and
	Reactor/init's roughBounds reaches as far as they lie.
]]

local Index = require(script.Parent.Part.Reactor.Index)
local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.Part.TypeRegistry)

local Scatter = {}

Scatter.FOLDER = "Scattered"
Scatter.SOURCE = "ScatterSource"
Scatter.REGION = "ScatterRegion"
-- The most pieces one Fill places; the Count row is held to it.
Scatter.MAX_COUNT = 2000

local TRIES = 24
local LEAST_DISTANCE = 0.1
-- A count with room to spare is sampled at this share of the even spacing (about a quarter more
-- places than asked): above 0.8 some seeds come out short, below 0.7 shows gaps.
local SPREAD_SHARE = 0.75
local SPREAD_LIMIT = 4
-- Whole-region tries once no place has room beside it; a thin shape gets more, up to MOST_DARTS.
local DARTS = 40
local MOST_DARTS = 2000
-- Places tried for the first one, which a shape may refuse.
local FIRST_TRIES = 200
-- Rays that measure how much of the Region's box its own outline covers.
local OUTLINE_PROBES = 240
local MOST_HOLLOW = 0.95
-- How far below the Region's top a surface is looked for.
local DROP_REACH = 1000
-- No Region: the filled square's side, in piece distances per square root of the count.
local OPEN_SHARE = 1.5
local LEAST_SCALE = 0.05

-- A source of numbers from 0 to 1 that is the same for the same seed.
function Scatter.sequence(seed)
	local state = math.floor(seed) % 2147483647 + 1
	return function()
		state = (state * 48271 + 11) % 2147483647
		return state / 2147483647
	end
end

local function sample(width, depth, distance, limit, random, inside, share)
	local darts = math.min(math.ceil(DARTS / math.max(share, DARTS / MOST_DARTS)), MOST_DARTS)
	local points = {}
	local cell = distance / math.sqrt(2)
	local columns = math.max(math.ceil(width / cell), 1)
	local rows = math.max(math.ceil(depth / cell), 1)
	local grid = {}
	local active = {}

	local function cellOf(x, z)
		local column = math.clamp(math.floor((x + width / 2) / cell), 0, columns - 1)
		local row = math.clamp(math.floor((z + depth / 2) / cell), 0, rows - 1)
		return column, row
	end
	local function fits(x, z)
		if math.abs(x) > width / 2 or math.abs(z) > depth / 2 then
			return false
		end
		if inside and not inside(x, z) then
			return false
		end
		local column, row = cellOf(x, z)
		for nearColumn = math.max(column - 2, 0), math.min(column + 2, columns - 1) do
			for nearRow = math.max(row - 2, 0), math.min(row + 2, rows - 1) do
				local other = grid[nearColumn * rows + nearRow]
				if other then
					local offsetX, offsetZ = other.x - x, other.z - z
					if offsetX * offsetX + offsetZ * offsetZ < distance * distance then
						return false
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return true
	end
	local function add(x, z)
		local point = { x = x, z = z }
		local column, row = cellOf(x, z)
		grid[column * rows + row] = point
		table.insert(points, point)
		table.insert(active, point)
	end
	-- Anywhere in the region: gaps between far-apart pieces are out of reach of any one piece's ring.
	local function dart()
		for _ = 1, darts do
			local x, z = (random() - 0.5) * width, (random() - 0.5) * depth
			if fits(x, z) then
				add(x, z)
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	for _ = 1, FIRST_TRIES do
		local x, z = (random() - 0.5) * width, (random() - 0.5) * depth
		if fits(x, z) then
			add(x, z)
			break
		end
	end
	if #points == 0 then
		return points
	end
	while #points < limit do
		if #active == 0 then
			if not dart() then
				break
			end
		else
			local pick = math.floor(random() * #active) + 1
			local from = active[pick]
			local placed = false
			for _ = 1, TRIES do
				local angle = random() * math.pi * 2
				local reach = distance * (1 + random())
				local x, z = from.x + math.cos(angle) * reach, from.z + math.sin(angle) * reach
				if fits(x, z) then
					add(x, z)
					placed = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not placed then
				active[pick] = active[#active]
				active[#active] = nil
			end
		end
	end
	return points
end

function Scatter.points(width, depth, distance, count, random, inside, share)
	if count < 1 or width <= 0 or depth <= 0 or (share ~= nil and share <= 0) then
		return {}
	end
	distance = math.max(distance, LEAST_DISTANCE)
	local spread = math.max(distance, SPREAD_SHARE * math.sqrt(width * depth * (share or 1) / count))
	local points = sample(width, depth, spread, count * SPREAD_LIMIT, random, inside, share or 1)

	-- More than asked: keep an even draw of them.
	if #points > count then
		for index = #points, 2, -1 do
			local swap = math.floor(random() * index) + 1
			points[index], points[swap] = points[swap], points[index]
		end
		for index = #points, count + 1, -1 do
			points[index] = nil
		end
	end
	return points
end

function Scatter.outline(shape, width, depth, hollow)
	if shape ~= "Circle" then
		return nil, 1
	end
	local inner = math.clamp(hollow or 0, 0, MOST_HOLLOW)
	local function inside(x, z)
		local along = x / (width / 2)
		local across = z / (depth / 2)
		local radius = math.sqrt(along * along + across * across)
		return radius <= 1 and radius >= inner
	end
	return inside, math.pi / 4 * (1 - inner * inner)
end

-- Centre to centre: the clear ground plus the widest a piece can be, so Spacing 0 lets pieces touch.
function Scatter.distance(spacing, span)
	return math.max(spacing, 0) + math.max(span, 0)
end

function Scatter.openSide(distance, count)
	return OPEN_SHARE * math.max(distance, LEAST_DISTANCE) * math.sqrt(math.max(count, 1))
end

function Scatter.upright(frame, size)
	local axes = {
		{ direction = frame.XVector, length = size.X },
		{ direction = frame.YVector, length = size.Y },
		{ direction = frame.ZVector, length = size.Z },
	}
	local tallest = 1
	for index = 2, 3 do
		if math.abs(axes[index].direction.Y) > math.abs(axes[tallest].direction.Y) then
			tallest = index
		end
	end
	-- The two that are left, in X, Y, Z order: the first gives the footprint its heading.
	local first = axes[tallest % 3 + 1]
	local second = axes[(tallest + 1) % 3 + 1]
	if tallest == 2 then
		first, second = axes[1], axes[3]
	end
	local heading = Vector3.new(first.direction.X, 0, first.direction.Z)
	if heading.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
		heading = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
	end
	local upright = CFrame.fromMatrix(frame.Position, heading.Unit, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
	return upright, Vector3.new(first.length, axes[tallest].length, second.length)
end

local function valueOf(reactor, name)
	local holder = reactor:FindFirstChild(name)
	if holder and holder:IsA("ObjectValue") then
		return holder.Value
	end
	return nil
end

function Scatter.ensureValue(reactor, name)
	local holder = reactor:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not holder or not holder:IsA("ObjectValue") then
		holder = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		holder.Name = name
		holder.Parent = reactor
	end
	return holder
end

function Scatter.source(reactor)
	return valueOf(reactor, Scatter.SOURCE)
end

function Scatter.region(reactor)
	return valueOf(reactor, Scatter.REGION)
end

-- The picked part or model, or the parts and models directly in a picked folder.
local function variantsOf(source)
	if source:IsA("BasePart") then
		return { source }
	end
	local variants = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("Model") then
			table.insert(variants, child)
		end
	end
	if #variants == 0 and source:IsA("Model") then
		return { source }
	end
	return variants
end

-- No Pieces: the Reactor's part itself, or what lies directly in its Model.
local function ownVariants(reactor)
	if reactor:IsA("BasePart") then
		return { reactor }
	end
	local variants = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(reactor:GetChildren()) do
		if (child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("Model")) and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			table.insert(variants, child)
		end
	end
	return variants
end

local function sizeOf(variant)
	if variant:IsA("Model") then
		local _, size = variant:GetBoundingBox()
		return size
	end
	return variant.Size
end

local function frameOf(variant)
	if variant:IsA("Model") then
		return variant:GetPivot()
	end
	return variant.CFrame
end

-- How wide a piece of `size` can be on the ground, whichever way it is turned.
local function spanOf(size, turn)
	if turn == "Any way" then
		return size.Magnitude
	end
	return math.sqrt(size.X * size.X + size.Z * size.Z)
end

-- How far a turned box of `size` reaches upward from its centre.
local function riseOf(rotation, size)
	return (math.abs(rotation.XVector.Y) * size.X + math.abs(rotation.YVector.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(rotation.ZVector.Y) * size.Z) / 2
end

-- The world box around the Reactor's own parts (not the scattered ones), or nil.
local function ownBox(reactor)
	local scattered = reactor:FindFirstChild(Scatter.FOLDER)
	local parts = reactor:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(parts, reactor)
	local low, high = nil, nil
	for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and not (scattered and part:IsDescendantOf(scattered)) then
			local frame, size = part.CFrame, part.Size
			local half = Vector3.new(
				math.abs(frame.XVector.X) * size.X + math.abs(frame.YVector.X) * size.Y + math.abs(frame.ZVector.X) * size.Z,
				math.abs(frame.XVector.Y) * size.X + math.abs(frame.YVector.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(frame.ZVector.Y) * size.Z,
				math.abs(frame.XVector.Z) * size.X + math.abs(frame.YVector.Z) * size.Y + math.abs(frame.ZVector.Z) * size.Z
			) / 2
			low = (low or frame.Position - half):Min(frame.Position - half)
			high = (high or frame.Position + half):Max(frame.Position + half)
		end
	end
	return low, high
end

-- No Region: a `side`-wide square around the Reactor's parts, up to the nearest ceiling or half
-- its width, so pieces find rising ground and stay under a roof.
local function openRegion(reactor, side, params)
	local low, high = ownBox(reactor)
	if not low then
		return nil
	end
	local centre = (low + high) / 2
	local top = high.Y + side / 2
	local ceiling = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(centre.X, high.Y, centre.Z), Vector3.new(0, side / 2, 0), params)
	if ceiling then
		top = math.max(ceiling.Position.Y - LEAST_DISTANCE, high.Y)
	end
	return {
		frame = CFrame.new(centre.X, (low.Y + top) / 2, centre.Z),
		size = Vector3.new(side, top - low.Y, side),
	}
end

-- The Region part's outline from above: a ray down through the box at x, z meets the part or
-- not. Returns inside, share (measured with rays too).
local function regionOutline(part, frame, size, width, depth, random)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { part }
	local reach = Vector3.new(0, -(size.Y + 2), 0)
	local function inside(x, z)
		return workspace:Raycast(frame * Vector3.new(x, size.Y / 2 + 1, z), reach, params) ~= nil
	end
	local met = 0
	for _ = 1, OUTLINE_PROBES do
		if inside((random() - 0.5) * width, (random() - 0.5) * depth) then
			met += 1
		end
	end
	return inside, met / OUTLINE_PROBES
end

-- An ordinary part: a copied Reactor loses its marks, settings and field.
local function plainCopy(variant)
	local copy = variant:Clone()
	if not copy then
		return nil
	end
	if copy:GetAttribute("IsReactor") then
		Index.unmark(copy)
		for _, name in ipairs({ TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME, Scatter.FOLDER, Scatter.SOURCE, Scatter.REGION }) do
			local child = copy:FindFirstChild(name)
			if child then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	return copy
end

local function placeCopy(variant, ground, rotation, scale, folder)
	local copy = plainCopy(variant)
	if not copy then
		return false
	end
	if copy:IsA("Model") then
		copy:ScaleTo(copy:GetScale() * scale)
		copy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ground) * rotation)
		-- A model's pivot may be anywhere: its box is set over the place, underside on the ground.
		local boxFrame, boxSize = copy:GetBoundingBox()
		local lowest = boxFrame.Position.Y - riseOf(boxFrame, boxSize)
		copy:PivotTo(copy:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(ground.X - boxFrame.Position.X, ground.Y - lowest, ground.Z - boxFrame.Position.Z))
		for _, descendant in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
				descendant.Anchored = true
			end
		end
	else
		copy.Size = variant.Size * scale
		copy.CFrame = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, riseOf(rotation, copy.Size), 0)) * rotation
		copy.Anchored = true
	end
	copy.Parent = folder
	return true
end

function Scatter.fill(reactor, settings)
	if not (reactor:IsA("Model") or reactor:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return 0, "Not a Reactor", 0
	end
	local source = Scatter.source(reactor)
	local variants = nil
	if source then
		variants = variantsOf(source)
	else
		variants = ownVariants(reactor)
	end
	if #variants == 0 then
		return 0, "Pick Pieces", 0
	end
	local picked = Scatter.region(reactor)
	if picked and not picked:IsA("BasePart") then
		return 0, "Needs a part", 0
	end

	local wanted = math.clamp(math.floor(settings.Count), 0, Scatter.MAX_COUNT)
	local smallest = math.max(math.min(settings.SizeMin, settings.SizeMax), LEAST_SCALE)
	local largest = math.max(settings.SizeMin, settings.SizeMax, LEAST_SCALE)
	local span = 0
	for _, variant in ipairs(variants) do
		span = math.max(span, spanOf(sizeOf(variant), settings.Turn) * largest)
	end
	local distance = Scatter.distance(settings.Spacing, span)

	-- Pieces settle on what would carry them in a play: not the Reactor, the Region, the Pieces
	-- or the camera's unsaved content (stand-ins, previews), and nothing a part passes through.
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local left = { reactor, workspace.CurrentCamera }
	if source then
		table.insert(left, source)
	end
	if picked then
		table.insert(left, picked)
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = left

	-- With no Region the Reactor's own outline is no shape to fill: the square it is.
	local shape = settings.Shape
	if shape == "Region shape" and not picked then
		shape = "Box"
	end
	if shape == "Region shape" and not picked.CanQuery then
		return 0, "CanQuery?", wanted
	end

	local region = nil
	if picked then
		local frame, size = Scatter.upright(picked.CFrame, picked.Size)
		region = { frame = frame, size = size }
	else
		-- A circle covers less of its square than the square does: wider, so the count still fits.
		local _, covered = Scatter.outline(shape, 1, 1, settings.Hollow)
		region = openRegion(reactor, Scatter.openSide(distance, wanted) / math.sqrt(covered) + span, params)
	end
	if not region then
		return 0, "Pick a Region", wanted
	end

	-- Places keep half a piece's width from the edge, so no piece hangs over it.
	local random = Scatter.sequence(settings.Seed)
	local width = math.max(region.size.X - span, LEAST_DISTANCE)
	local depth = math.max(region.size.Z - span, LEAST_DISTANCE)
	local inside, share = nil, 1
	if shape == "Region shape" then
		inside, share = regionOutline(picked, region.frame, region.size, width, depth, random)
	else
		inside, share = Scatter.outline(shape, width, depth, settings.Hollow)
	end
	local points = Scatter.points(width, depth, distance, wanted, random, inside, share)

	Scatter.clear(reactor)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = Scatter.FOLDER
	folder.Parent = reactor

	local placed = 0
	for _, point in ipairs(points) do
		local variant = variants[math.floor(random() * #variants) + 1]
		local scale = smallest + (largest - smallest) * random()
		-- Upright keeps a piece as it was built and turns it about the vertical.
		local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, random() * math.pi * 2, 0) * frameOf(variant).Rotation
		if settings.Turn == "Any way" then
			rotation = CFrame.Angles(random() * math.pi * 2, random() * math.pi * 2, random() * math.pi * 2)
		end
		local top = region.frame * Vector3.new(point.x, region.size.Y / 2, point.z)
		local ground = top - Vector3.new(0, region.size.Y, 0)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(top, Vector3.new(0, -DROP_REACH, 0), params)
		if hit then
			ground = hit.Position
		end
		if placeCopy(variant, ground, rotation, scale, folder) then
			placed += 1
		end
	end
	return placed, nil, wanted
end

function Scatter.clear(reactor)
	local folder = reactor:FindFirstChild(Scatter.FOLDER)
	if not folder then
		return 0
	end
	local removed = #folder:GetChildren()
	-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
	folder.Parent = nil
	return removed
end

return Scatter

--[[
	SequenceClipboard  -  one in-memory clipboard for NumberSequence / ColorSequence values, shared by
	the Shift-click dots menu (PropertyInputsPE) and the Color editor's Copy / Paste (plugins have no
	system clipboard). Only a new copy replaces what it holds, never a change of selection: copying
	from one item to another is what it is for.
]]

local SequenceClipboard = {}

local _entry = nil

function SequenceClipboard.set(value)
	if value == nil then
		_entry = nil
		return
	end
	_entry = { type = typeof(value), value = value }
end

function SequenceClipboard.has(expectedType)
	if not _entry then return false end
	return expectedType == nil or _entry.type == expectedType
end

function SequenceClipboard.get(expectedType)
	if not SequenceClipboard.has(expectedType) then return nil end
	return _entry.value
end

function SequenceClipboard.clear()
	_entry = nil
end

return SequenceClipboard

--[[
	SettingsHandoff  -  moves a user's settings from a GitHub copy of the plugin to the Creator Store
	copy. Studio keeps a store-installed plugin's settings apart from local plugins' and neither can
	read the other's, so the two copies hand them over while both run in one Studio window, through
	CoreGui, which every plugin sees: the store copy asks, the GitHub copy answers, the store copy keeps
	what it lacked when it asked (its own first start writes defaults meanwhile). Each copy marks that
	it runs, every session: a GitHub copy that sees the store copy's mark steps aside, and a store copy
	that sees a GitHub copy's waits a moment for the answer before its first build.
	  SettingsHandoff.KEYS     every setting the plugin keeps, with how a handed-over value merges;
	                           server/tools/settings_keys.py fails a key the source uses and this lacks
	  SettingsHandoff.FAMILIES prefixes of keys named after a panel or deck (PanelPersistence.settingKeys)
	  SettingsHandoff.ask(plugin, hooks)      the store copy, once a session, before its first build: the
	    mark, and a request until one was answered (setting HandoffDone). hooks.familyKeys() -> { key };
	    hooks.importInventory(json) -> how many entries it added; hooks.arrived({ settings, items })
	  SettingsHandoff.awaitAnswer(seconds)    the store copy: with a GitHub copy here, waits up to that
	    long for its answer
	  SettingsHandoff.answer(plugin, hooks)   a GitHub copy: its mark, answers a request with its
	    settings, calls hooks.storeCopy() once when a store copy runs here. hooks.familyKeys() as above
	  SettingsHandoff.storeCopyRuns()         a store copy's mark is in CoreGui now
	  SettingsHandoff.stop()                  takes back what this copy put in CoreGui
]]

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local SettingsHandoff = {}

-- How a handed-over value meets the store copy's own: "missing" fills a setting it does not have,
-- "earliest" / "latest" / "most" keep the smaller or larger number, "inventory" merges the local
-- Inventory, "skip" never crosses.
SettingsHandoff.KEYS = {
	{ "LocalInventory", "inventory" },
	{ "ThemeJSON", "missing" },
	{ "ThemeDefaults", "missing" },
	{ "UIScale", "missing" },
	{ "UIScaleBase", "missing" },
	{ "PanelPositions", "missing" },
	{ "PanelSizes", "missing" },
	{ "PropsViewMode", "missing" },
	{ "PropSectionCollapsed", "missing" },
	{ "Shortcuts", "missing" },
	{ "DisplayCmdAsMeta", "missing" },
	{ "AutoEmitDelay", "missing" },
	{ "AutoEmitMode", "missing" },
	{ "ParticleCap", "missing" },
	{ "PreviewMotion", "missing" },
	{ "ShowHUD", "missing" },
	{ "ShowInventory", "missing" },
	{ "EdgeSnap", "missing" },
	{ "Workspaces", "missing" },
	{ "ConsoleOutput", "missing" },
	{ "InventoryFavourites", "missing" },
	{ "InventoryRecents", "missing" },
	{ "InventoryOrder", "missing" },
	{ "InventoryScale", "missing" },
	{ "GraphEditorPresetsOpen", "missing" },
	{ "GraphEditorScale", "missing" },
	{ "GraphWindowSize", "missing" },
	{ "ColorSequencePresets", "missing" },
	{ "ColorPickerRecent", "missing" },
	{ "ColorPickerSaved", "missing" },
	-- The licence: a trial and the days unregistered count from the first start of either copy.
	{ "LocalTrialStart", "earliest" },
	{ "_UnregisteredSince", "earliest" },
	{ "_ReminderTurn", "most" },
	{ "_LicenceSeen", "latest" },
	-- Each copy's own.
	{ "LocalInventoryOwner", "skip" },
	{ "LocalInventory_Pending", "skip" },
	{ "PartIcles_PluginActive", "skip" },
	{ "HandoffDone", "skip" },
}
SettingsHandoff.FAMILIES = { "Panel_", "Tab_", "Split_" }

local DONE_SETTING = "HandoffDone"
local REQUEST_NAME = "PartIclesSettingsHandoff"
local PRESENCE_NAME = "PartIclesStoreCopy"
local GITHUB_NAME = "PartIclesGitHubCopy"
-- A StringValue refuses 200,000 characters or more (Studio's error says so); a part stays well under.
local CHUNK = 100000
-- The Inventory read again after a nil, as that may only be another window writing (Plugin:GetSetting).
local READ_TRIES = 3
local READ_RETRY_SECONDS = 0.2

local _made = {}
local _connections = {}
-- The store copy's request while it waits, and whether an answer was kept.
local _request = nil
local _kept = false

local function own(instance)
	table.insert(_made, instance)
	return instance
end

local function listen(signal, handler)
	table.insert(_connections, signal:Connect(handler))
end

-- Every key this copy keeps: the list, and the ones named after its panels.
local function keysOf(hooks)
	local keys = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(SettingsHandoff.KEYS) do
		if entry[2] ~= "skip" then
			keys[entry[1]] = entry[2]
		end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(hooks.familyKeys and hooks.familyKeys() or {}) do
		keys[key] = keys[key] or "missing"
	end
	return keys
end

local function ruleOf(key)
	for _, entry in ipairs(SettingsHandoff.KEYS) do
		if entry[1] == key then
			return entry[2]
		end
	end
	for _, prefix in ipairs(SettingsHandoff.FAMILIES) do
		if string.sub(key, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
			return "missing"
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The store copy's own value and the handed-over one, merged by the key's rule; nil leaves its own.
local function merged(rule, own, given)
	if own == nil then
		return given
	end
	if type(own) ~= "number" or type(given) ~= "number" then
		return nil
	end
	if rule == "earliest" and given < own then
		return given
	elseif (rule == "latest" or rule == "most") and given > own then
		return given
	end
	return nil
end

local function read(plugin, key)
	local ok, value = pcall(function() return plugin:GetSetting(key) end)
	return if ok then value else nil
end

local function readAgain(plugin, key)
	for attempt = 1, READ_TRIES do
		local value = read(plugin, key)
		if value ~= nil then
			return value
		end
		if attempt < READ_TRIES then
			task.wait(READ_RETRY_SECONDS)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The GitHub copy: its settings, as JSON in StringValues under the request; "Answered" last.
local function respond(plugin, hooks, request)
	if request:GetAttribute("Answered") then
		return
	end
	local settings = {}
	for key, rule in pairs(keysOf(hooks)) do
		local value = if rule == "inventory" then readAgain(plugin, key) else read(plugin, key)
		if value ~= nil then
			settings[key] = value
		end
	end
	local ok, json = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode({ settings = settings }) end)
	if not ok then
		return
	end
	local parts = math.max(1, math.ceil(#json / CHUNK))
	for index = 1, parts do
		local part = Instance.new("StringValue")
		part.Name = "Part" .. index
		part.Value = string.sub(json, (index - 1) * CHUNK + 1, index * CHUNK)
		part.Parent = request
	end
	request:SetAttribute("Parts", parts)
	request:SetAttribute("Answered", true)
end

function SettingsHandoff.answer(plugin, hooks)
	local mark = own(Instance.new("Folder"))
	mark.Name = GITHUB_NAME
	mark.Parent = CoreGui
	local stepped = false
	local function seen(child)
		if child.Name == REQUEST_NAME and child:IsA("Folder") then
			respond(plugin, hooks, child)
		elseif child.Name == PRESENCE_NAME and not stepped then
			stepped = true
			if hooks.storeCopy then
				hooks.storeCopy()
			end
		end
	end
	listen(CoreGui.ChildAdded, seen)
	-- A waiting request is answered before the store copy's mark sets this copy aside.
	local children = CoreGui:GetChildren()
	table.sort(children, function(a, b)
		return a.Name == REQUEST_NAME and b.Name ~= REQUEST_NAME
	end)
	for _, child in ipairs(children) do
		seen(child)
	end
end

-- The store copy: what an answer holds, kept as the rules say against `mine`, its values when it
-- asked; the plain settings first, so the Inventory merge, which can wait, finds them in. Returns how
-- many settings it wrote and how many Inventory entries it added.
local function keep(plugin, hooks, request, mine)
	local pieces = {}
	for index = 1, request:GetAttribute("Parts") or 0 do
		local part = request:FindFirstChild("Part" .. index)
		if not part then
			return nil
		end
		table.insert(pieces, part.Value)
	end
	request:Destroy()
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(table.concat(pieces)) end)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.settings) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local written, items = 0, 0
	local inventory = {}
	for key, given in pairs(data.settings) do
		local rule = ruleOf(key)
		if rule == "inventory" then
			table.insert(inventory, given)
		elseif rule and rule ~= "skip" then
			local own = if mine.asked[key] then mine.values[key] else read(plugin, key)
			local value = merged(rule, own, given)
			if value ~= nil then
				pcall(function() plugin:SetSetting(key, value) end)
				written += 1
			end
		end
	end
	for _, given in ipairs(inventory) do
		if type(given) == "string" and hooks.importInventory then
			items += hooks.importInventory(given) or 0
		end
	end
	return { settings = written, items = items }
end

function SettingsHandoff.ask(plugin, hooks)
	local presence = own(Instance.new("Folder"))
	presence.Name = PRESENCE_NAME
	presence.Parent = CoreGui
	if read(plugin, DONE_SETTING) ~= nil then
		return
	end
	-- Its values now, before its own first start writes defaults: those do not count as its own.
	local mine = { values = {}, asked = {} }
	for key in pairs(keysOf(hooks)) do
		mine.values[key] = read(plugin, key)
		mine.asked[key] = true
	end
	local request = own(Instance.new("Folder"))
	request.Name = REQUEST_NAME
	_request = request
	_kept = false
	local function answered()
		if not request:GetAttribute("Answered") or request.Parent == nil then
			return
		end
		local summary = keep(plugin, hooks, request, mine)
		_request = nil
		if summary then
			pcall(function() plugin:SetSetting(DONE_SETTING, os.time()) end)
			_kept = true
			if hooks.arrived then
				hooks.arrived(summary)
			end
		end
	end
	listen(request:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Answered"), answered)
	request.Parent = CoreGui
	answered()
end

function SettingsHandoff.awaitAnswer(seconds)
	if not _request or not CoreGui:FindFirstChild(GITHUB_NAME) then
		return
	end
	local started = os.clock()
	while _request ~= nil and not _kept and os.clock() - started < seconds do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end

function SettingsHandoff.storeCopyRuns()
	return CoreGui:FindFirstChild(PRESENCE_NAME) ~= nil
end

function SettingsHandoff.stop()
	for _, connection in ipairs(_connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(_connections)
	for _, instance in ipairs(_made) do
		instance:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(_made)
	_request = nil
end

return SettingsHandoff
