--[[
	Bindings  -  ShortcutKey storage layer

	Loads, checks and saves the shortcut settings, all under the one plugin setting "Shortcuts"
	(SetSetting fails silently on keys with a period or backslash).
	  { version = 2, overlayEnabled = true, leaderKey = "P" | false,
	    bindings = { [actionId] = {key = KeyCode name, ctrl, alt, shift, meta} },
	    unbound = { [actionId] = true } }  -- direct actions whose default the user removed
	A combo is stored as a key and four modifier flags; text is for display only.
	Chords fire while the leader key is held, or on their key alone with no leader. Direct actions
	(`direct = true` in the catalog) always fire on their key alone and start on their `default`;
	every other action starts unbound. load() drops bindings of unknown or unimplemented actions.
	  load(plugin, ActionCatalog), save(plugin, settings), fresh(ActionCatalog), reset(settings, ActionCatalog)
	  isValidCombo, isValidLeader, getLeaderKey, comboKey, keyLabel, formatCombo(combo, isMac, leader)
	  findOwner, assign, clear, normalize, isDirect
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)

local Bindings = {}

-- Settings saved before version 2 are migrated on load.
Bindings.VERSION = 2

-- Version 1 default chords: load() clears a saved binding that still equals one.
local OLD_DEFAULTS_V1 = {
	{actionId = "ToggleUI",         combo = {key = "P", ctrl = true,  alt = true,  shift = false, meta = false}},
	{actionId = "ToggleInventory",  combo = {key = "I", ctrl = true,  alt = false, shift = true,  meta = false}},
	{actionId = "ToggleProperties", combo = {key = "R", ctrl = true,  alt = false, shift = true,  meta = false}},
	{actionId = "ToggleUI",         combo = {key = "P", ctrl = false, alt = false, shift = false, meta = false}},
	{actionId = "ToggleInventory",  combo = {key = "I", ctrl = false, alt = false, shift = false, meta = false}},
	{actionId = "ToggleProperties", combo = {key = "R", ctrl = false, alt = false, shift = false, meta = false}},
}

Bindings.DEFAULTS = {}
Bindings.SUGGESTED = {}

-- A modifier alone is never a key: it would fire on a plain Ctrl press.
local MODIFIER_ONLY_KEYS = {
	LeftControl = true, RightControl = true, LeftAlt = true, RightAlt = true,
	LeftShift = true, RightShift = true, LeftMeta = true, RightMeta = true,
	LeftSuper = true, RightSuper = true,
}

Bindings.DEFAULT_LEADER = "P"

-- The leader's KeyCode name, or false for none.
function Bindings.getLeaderKey(settings)
	if type(settings) ~= "table" then return Bindings.DEFAULT_LEADER end
	local lk = settings.leaderKey
	if lk == false then return false end
	if type(lk) == "string" and lk ~= "" then return lk end
	return Bindings.DEFAULT_LEADER
end

-- -> the cleaned leader (string or false), and whether it was valid.
function Bindings.isValidLeader(lk)
	if lk == false then return false, true end
	if type(lk) ~= "string" or lk == "" then return nil, false end
	if MODIFIER_ONLY_KEYS[lk] then return nil, false end
	local ok, kc = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[lk] end)
	if not ok or kc == nil then return nil, false end
	return lk, true
end

function Bindings.isValidCombo(combo)
	if type(combo) ~= "table" then return false end
	if type(combo.key) ~= "string" or combo.key == "" then return false end
	if type(combo.ctrl) ~= "boolean" then return false end
	if type(combo.alt) ~= "boolean" then return false end
	if type(combo.shift) ~= "boolean" then return false end
	if type(combo.meta) ~= "boolean" then return false end
	if MODIFIER_ONLY_KEYS[combo.key] then return false end
	-- A bare key (plain "I") is allowed. Enum.KeyCode raises on an unknown name, hence the pcall.
	local ok, kc = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[combo.key] end)
	if not ok or kc == nil then return false end
	return true
end

-- A string key for a combo, modifiers always in one order: equal combos give equal keys.
function Bindings.comboKey(combo)
	return string.format("%s+%s+%s+%s+%s",
		combo.ctrl and "C" or "_",
		combo.alt  and "A" or "_",
		combo.shift and "S" or "_",
		combo.meta and "M" or "_",
		combo.key)
end

-- Punctuation keys read better as the character they type than as their KeyCode name.
local KEY_LABELS = {
	Slash = "/", BackSlash = "\\", Equals = "=", Minus = "-", Plus = "+", Period = ".", Comma = ",",
	Semicolon = ";", Quote = "'", Backquote = "`", LeftBracket = "[", RightBracket = "]",
}

function Bindings.keyLabel(key)
	return KEY_LABELS[key] or key
end

-- "P + I", "T + Shift+T", or "Ctrl+I" with no leader. A binding stores the chord alone; the leader
-- is added for display.
function Bindings.formatCombo(combo, isMac, leader)
	if not combo then return "(unbound)" end
	local parts = {}
	if combo.ctrl then table.insert(parts, "Ctrl") end
	if combo.alt then table.insert(parts, "Alt") end
	if combo.shift then table.insert(parts, "Shift") end
	if combo.meta then table.insert(parts, isMac and "Cmd" or "Win") end
	table.insert(parts, Bindings.keyLabel(combo.key))
	local chord = table.concat(parts, "+")
	if leader == false then return chord end
	local lk = (type(leader) == "string" and leader ~= "") and leader or Bindings.DEFAULT_LEADER
	return lk .. " + " .. chord
end

-- Loads and checks against the catalog. No setting or a newer version gives fresh settings; an older
-- version is migrated first; unknown, unimplemented or malformed bindings are dropped with a warning;
-- normalize() then settles duplicates and defaults.
function Bindings.load(plugin, ActionCatalog)
	local raw = plugin:GetSetting("Shortcuts")
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then
		return Bindings.fresh(ActionCatalog)
	end
	-- A hand-edited version can be a string, a table or NaN, and comparing it would throw.
	local rawVersion = tonumber(raw.version)
	if rawVersion ~= rawVersion then rawVersion = nil end -- NaN guard
	if rawVersion and rawVersion > Bindings.VERSION then
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] settings version unsupported (saved="..tostring(raw.version)..", current="..Bindings.VERSION.."); using defaults")
		return Bindings.fresh(ActionCatalog)
	end
	-- A saved TogglePlugin chord moves to ToggleUI, before the checks.
	if type(raw.bindings) == "table" and raw.bindings.TogglePlugin and not raw.bindings.ToggleUI then
		raw.bindings.ToggleUI = raw.bindings.TogglePlugin
		raw.bindings.TogglePlugin = nil
	end
	-- A saved ToggleAnimateLoop chord moves to ToggleEnable (which covers both modes) when that is free.
	if type(raw.bindings) == "table" and raw.bindings.ToggleAnimateLoop then
		if not raw.bindings.ToggleEnable then
			raw.bindings.ToggleEnable = raw.bindings.ToggleAnimateLoop
		else
			Log.warn("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] ToggleAnimateLoop binding dropped  -  ToggleEnable already bound (which now covers both modes)")
		end
		raw.bindings.ToggleAnimateLoop = nil
	end
	-- Bindings still on a version 1 default are cleared; the user's own chords stay.
	if type(raw.bindings) == "table" and (not rawVersion or rawVersion < 2) then
		for _, entry in ipairs(OLD_DEFAULTS_V1) do
			local current = raw.bindings[entry.actionId]
			if current and Bindings.isValidCombo(current) and Bindings.comboKey(current) == Bindings.comboKey(entry.combo) then
				raw.bindings[entry.actionId] = nil
			end
		end
	end
	local validated = {}
	if type(raw.bindings) == "table" then
		for actionId, combo in pairs(raw.bindings) do
			local def = ActionCatalog[actionId]
			if not def then
				Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] binding for unknown action %q ignored; remove via Settings panel"):format(actionId))
			elseif def.implemented ~= true then
				-- Stub actions are never dispatchable, whatever a hand-edited setting says.
				Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] binding for unimplemented action %q dropped; rebind via the Settings panel once it ships"):format(actionId))
			elseif not Bindings.isValidCombo(combo) then
				Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] binding for %q is malformed; falling back to unbound"):format(actionId))
			else
				validated[actionId] = combo
			end
		end
	end
	local unbound = {}
	if type(raw.unbound) == "table" then
		for actionId, marked in pairs(raw.unbound) do
			local def = ActionCatalog[actionId]
			if marked == true and def and def.default then
				unbound[actionId] = true
			end
		end
	end
	-- Always true: no UI turns it off, and false would silence Runtime.
	local overlayEnabled = true
	-- A corrupt leader falls back to the default with a warning.
	local leaderClean, leaderOk = Bindings.isValidLeader(raw.leaderKey)
	if raw.leaderKey ~= nil and not leaderOk then
		Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] invalid leaderKey %q; using default %q"):format(tostring(raw.leaderKey), Bindings.DEFAULT_LEADER))
	end
	if raw.leaderKey == nil then leaderClean = Bindings.DEFAULT_LEADER end
	if leaderClean == nil then leaderClean = Bindings.DEFAULT_LEADER end
	local result = {version = Bindings.VERSION, overlayEnabled = overlayEnabled, leaderKey = leaderClean, bindings = validated, unbound = unbound}
	-- Duplicate combos and the direct actions' defaults; needs the leader, so it runs last.
	Bindings.normalize(result, ActionCatalog)
	-- Saved after a migration so it runs once.
	if rawVersion ~= Bindings.VERSION then
		pcall(Bindings.save, plugin, result)
	end
	return result
end

function Bindings.save(plugin, settings)
	local leader = Bindings.getLeaderKey(settings)
	plugin:SetSetting("Shortcuts", {
		version = Bindings.VERSION,
		overlayEnabled = settings.overlayEnabled ~= false,
		leaderKey = leader,
		bindings = settings.bindings or {},
		unbound = settings.unbound or {},
	})
end

function Bindings._copyDefaults()
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs(Bindings.DEFAULTS) do
		out[k] = {key = v.key, ctrl = v.ctrl, alt = v.alt, shift = v.shift, meta = v.meta}
	end
	return out
end

local function copyCombo(combo)
	return {key = combo.key, ctrl = combo.ctrl, alt = combo.alt, shift = combo.shift, meta = combo.meta}
end

-- True for a catalog action that fires on its key alone instead of through the leader.
function Bindings.isDirect(ActionCatalog, actionId)
	if not ActionCatalog or actionId == nil then
		return false
	end
	local def = ActionCatalog[actionId]
	return def ~= nil and def.direct == true
end

-- Which other action owns the combo, or nil. With the catalog and the asking action given, only
-- an action that fires on the same press counts: with a leader set, chords and direct actions do not meet.
function Bindings.findOwner(settings, combo, ActionCatalog, actionId)
	if not Bindings.isValidCombo(combo) then return nil end
	local target = Bindings.comboKey(combo)
	local oneSpace = ActionCatalog == nil or Bindings.getLeaderKey(settings) == false
	local direct = Bindings.isDirect(ActionCatalog, actionId)
	for otherId, existing in pairs(settings.bindings or {}) do
		if otherId ~= actionId and Bindings.comboKey(existing) == target then
			if oneSpace or Bindings.isDirect(ActionCatalog, otherId) == direct then
				return otherId
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- The user's own choice for one action.
function Bindings.assign(settings, actionId, combo)
	settings.bindings[actionId] = combo
	if settings.unbound then
		settings.unbound[actionId] = nil
	end
end

-- Removes an action's binding. An action with a default is marked, or the next load would
-- put the default back.
function Bindings.clear(settings, ActionCatalog, actionId)
	settings.bindings[actionId] = nil
	local def = ActionCatalog and ActionCatalog[actionId]
	if def and def.default then
		settings.unbound = settings.unbound or {}
		settings.unbound[actionId] = true
	end
end

-- Settles the bindings after a load or a change of leader. Actions that fire on the same press
-- cannot share a combo: a chord wins over a direct action, then the first id alphabetically. A direct
-- action on the leader's key could never fire and is dropped. A direct action without a binding takes
-- its default unless the user removed it (`unbound`) or the combo is taken.
function Bindings.normalize(settings, ActionCatalog)
	local leader = Bindings.getLeaderKey(settings)
	local ordered = {}
	for actionId in pairs(settings.bindings) do
		table.insert(ordered, actionId)
	end
	table.sort(ordered, function(first, second)
		local firstDirect = Bindings.isDirect(ActionCatalog, first)
		local secondDirect = Bindings.isDirect(ActionCatalog, second)
		if firstDirect ~= secondDirect then
			return secondDirect
		end
		return first < second
	end)

	local saved = settings.bindings
	settings.bindings = {}
	for _, actionId in ipairs(ordered) do
		local combo = saved[actionId]
		local owner = Bindings.findOwner(settings, combo, ActionCatalog, actionId)
		local onLeader = Bindings.isDirect(ActionCatalog, actionId) and combo.key == leader
		if owner then
			Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] duplicate combo: %q wins over %q"):format(owner, actionId))
		elseif not onLeader then
			settings.bindings[actionId] = combo
		end
	end

	settings.unbound = settings.unbound or {}
	local withDefault = {}
	for actionId, def in pairs(ActionCatalog) do
		if def.implemented == true and Bindings.isValidCombo(def.default) then
			table.insert(withDefault, actionId)
		end
	end
	table.sort(withDefault)
	for _, actionId in ipairs(withDefault) do
		local default = ActionCatalog[actionId].default
		local free = settings.bindings[actionId] == nil and not settings.unbound[actionId]
		if free and default.key ~= leader and not Bindings.findOwner(settings, default, ActionCatalog, actionId) then
			settings.bindings[actionId] = copyCombo(default)
		end
	end
end

-- A fresh install: no chords, the direct actions on their defaults.
function Bindings.fresh(ActionCatalog)
	local settings = {
		version = Bindings.VERSION,
		overlayEnabled = true,
		leaderKey = Bindings.DEFAULT_LEADER,
		bindings = Bindings._copyDefaults(),
		unbound = {},
	}
	Bindings.normalize(settings, ActionCatalog)
	return settings
end

-- Puts an existing settings table back to a fresh install's bindings; the leader stays.
function Bindings.reset(settings, ActionCatalog)
	settings.bindings = Bindings._copyDefaults()
	settings.unbound = {}
	Bindings.normalize(settings, ActionCatalog)
end

return Bindings

--[[
	Bootstrap  -  ShortcutKey wiring entry point

	attach(deps) -> wiring, in this order:
	  1. builds the Shortcuts panel's state machine (ctx.ShortcutsWiring);
	  2. wiring.ensureSettings() loads the saved bindings, before Runtime builds its first index;
	  3. creates the Dispatcher (ctx.ShortcutsDispatcher) and starts Runtime with it (ctx.ShortcutsRuntime);
	  4. wires the Settings panel's Shortcuts button (toggle) and the panel's header X (close).
	deps: ctx (plugin, Actions), UI (the Shortcuts panel's parts and the Settings button), Connections
	(the shared ConnectionManager), Shortcuts (this barrel), Widgets, Theme.
]]

local Bootstrap = {}

function Bootstrap.attach(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local UI = deps.UI
	local Connections = deps.Connections
	local Shortcuts = deps.Shortcuts

	local wiring = Shortcuts.Wiring({
		ctx = ctx,
		panel = {
			panel = UI.ShortcutPanel,
			scrollList = UI.ShortcutsList,
			searchBox = UI.ShortcutsSearch,
			resetBtn = UI.ShortcutsReset,
			headerCloseBtn = UI.ShortcutsHeaderClose,
			leaderLabel = UI.ShortcutsLeaderLabel,
			leaderSetBtn = UI.ShortcutsLeaderSet,
			leaderClearBtn = UI.ShortcutsLeaderClear,
		},
		Bindings = Shortcuts.Bindings,
		Connections = Connections,
		Widgets = deps.Widgets,
		Theme = deps.Theme,
	})
	ctx.ShortcutsWiring = wiring

	wiring.ensureSettings()

	local dispatcher = Shortcuts.Dispatcher.create(ctx)
	ctx.ShortcutsDispatcher = dispatcher

	-- Runtime rebuilds its index on every save through wiring.setOnChanged.
	local runtime = Shortcuts.Runtime.start({
		ctx = ctx,
		wiring = wiring,
		Bindings = Shortcuts.Bindings,
		Connections = Connections,
		dispatcher = dispatcher,
		workspacesLabel = UI.WorkspacesLabel,
	})
	ctx.ShortcutsRuntime = runtime

	-- A no-op (see PluginActions).
	if ctx.plugin then
		ctx.ShortcutsPluginActions = Shortcuts.PluginActions.register(ctx.plugin, ctx, wiring, dispatcher)
	end

	if UI.ShortcutsButton then
		Connections["ShortcutsToggle"] = UI.ShortcutsButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			if wiring.isOpen() then wiring.close() else wiring.open() end
		end)
	end

	-- close(), so the key capture stops.
	if UI.ShortcutsHeaderClose then
		Connections["ShortcutsHeaderClose"] = UI.ShortcutsHeaderClose.Activated:Connect(function()
			wiring.close()
		end)
	end

	return wiring
end

return Bootstrap

--[[
	Dispatcher  -  ShortcutKey shared dispatch

	The one path from a shortcut to its action's handler (Runtime calls it). Runs implemented
	actions only, and drops a repeat within 50 ms, of the same action or any, in case a key repeat
	gets through Runtime's focus gates.
	  create(ctx) -> {dispatch(actionId)}; Bootstrap keeps it on ctx.ShortcutsDispatcher.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)

local Dispatcher = {}

local DEDUP_WINDOW = 0.05

function Dispatcher.create(ctx)
	local self = {}
	local _lastFire = {} -- per actionId
	-- nil, not 0, so the first dispatch is not dropped while os.clock() is under the window.
	local _lastAnyFire = nil -- across actions

	function self.dispatch(actionId)
		if type(actionId) ~= "string" or actionId == "" then return end
		local Actions = ctx.Actions
		local def = Actions and Actions[actionId]
		-- Stub actions never run, whatever the caller checked.
		if not def or def.implemented ~= true then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		local last = _lastFire[actionId]
		if last and (now - last) < DEDUP_WINDOW then return end
		if _lastAnyFire and (now - _lastAnyFire) < DEDUP_WINDOW then return end
		_lastFire[actionId] = now
		_lastAnyFire = now
		local ok, err = pcall(def.handler, ctx)
		if not ok then
			Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] handler error for %q: %s"):format(actionId, tostring(err)))
		end
	end

	return self
end

return Dispatcher

--[[
	Runtime  -  ShortcutKey UIS dispatch

	Turns key presses into actions through an index comboKey -> actionId, built from
	wiring.getSettings() and rebuilt after every save (wiring.setOnChanged).
	  start(deps) -> {stop}; deps: ctx (Actions), wiring (getSettings, isOpen, isCapturing,
	    captureHoldsKeys, setOnChanged), Bindings, Connections, dispatcher, workspacesLabel
	    (optional: the Settings panel's Workspaces row).
	Leader: while the leader key (default P, set in Settings, or none) is held, each other key
	pressed fires its chord, so one hold can fire several actions. The leader alone fires nothing.
	Direct actions fire on their key alone, never while the leader is held. The workspace keys go to
	Shortcuts/WorkspaceKeys instead, which Modules/Workspaces reads from its own listener.
	Gates: nothing fires while a shortcut is being captured or a TextBox has focus; while the
	Shortcuts panel is open only ToggleShortcuts (to close it) and ToggleUI (to show a hidden UI) do.
	gameProcessedEvent is not used: Studio sets it for nearly every key in Edit mode.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)
local WorkspaceKeys = require(script.Parent.WorkspaceKeys)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- The keys the Settings panel's Workspaces row names, by their WorkspaceKeys name.
local WORKSPACE_ROW_KEYS = { "next", "new", "merge" }

-- Used when the saved leader is no KeyCode name.
local DEFAULT_LEADER_KEYCODE = Enum.KeyCode.P

local Runtime = {}

function Runtime.start(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local wiring = deps.wiring
	local Bindings = deps.Bindings
	local Connections = deps.Connections
	local dispatcher = deps.dispatcher

	local runtime = {}
	local _index = {}        -- comboKey -> actionId
	local _directIndex = {}  -- comboKey -> a direct actionId that is no workspace key

	function runtime._rebuildIndex()
		_index = {}
		_directIndex = {}
		local settings = wiring.getSettings()
		if not settings or settings.overlayEnabled == false then return end
		local Actions = ctx.Actions
		for actionId, combo in pairs(settings.bindings or {}) do
			local def = Actions and Actions[actionId]
			-- Stub actions are left out; Dispatcher checks again when firing.
			if def and def.implemented == true and not def.direct and Bindings.isValidCombo(combo) then
				_index[Bindings.comboKey(combo)] = actionId
			elseif def and def.implemented == true and def.direct and not def.workspaceKey and Bindings.isValidCombo(combo) then
				_directIndex[Bindings.comboKey(combo)] = actionId
			end
		end
	end

	-- Hands the workspace keys to Shortcuts/WorkspaceKeys and names them on the Settings row.
	function runtime._pushWorkspaceKeys()
		local settings = wiring.getSettings()
		if not settings then
			return
		end
		local combos = {}
		for actionId, def in pairs(ctx.Actions or {}) do
			local combo = settings.bindings[actionId]
			if def.workspaceKey and combo and Bindings.isValidCombo(combo) then
				combos[def.workspaceKey] = combo
			end
		end
		WorkspaceKeys.set(combos, Bindings.getLeaderKey(settings))

		local rowLabel = deps.workspacesLabel
		if not rowLabel then
			return
		end
		local names = {}
		for _, workspaceKey in ipairs(WORKSPACE_ROW_KEYS) do
			if combos[workspaceKey] then
				table.insert(names, Bindings.formatCombo(combos[workspaceKey], false, false))
			end
		end
		if #names > 0 then
			rowLabel.Text = "Workspaces ( " .. table.concat(names, "  ") .. " )"
		else
			rowLabel.Text = "Workspaces"
		end
	end

	-- Built as Wiring's capture builds it, so the comboKey matches the saved one.
	local function _buildComboFromInput(input)
		local combo = {
			key = input.KeyCode.Name,
			ctrl = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl),
			alt = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt),
			shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift),
			meta = false,
		}
		pcall(function()
			combo.meta = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftMeta) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightMeta)
		end)
		return combo
	end

	-- The leader's KeyCode, or nil with no leader.
	local function _currentLeaderKeyCode()
		local settings = wiring.getSettings()
		local lk = Bindings.getLeaderKey(settings)
		if lk == false then return nil end
		local ok, kc = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[lk] end)
		if ok and kc then return kc end
		return DEFAULT_LEADER_KEYCODE
	end

	-- True with no leader, so chords fire on their key alone.
	local function _isLeaderHeld()
		local kc = _currentLeaderKeyCode()
		if kc == nil then return true end
		return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(kc)
	end

	local function _dispatchActionId(actionId)
		if not actionId then return end
		if dispatcher then
			dispatcher.dispatch(actionId)
			return
		end
		-- Without a dispatcher there is no dedup.
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] Runtime built without dispatcher; firing direct (dedup absent)")
		local def = ctx.Actions and ctx.Actions[actionId]
		if def and def.implemented == true then
			local ok, err = pcall(def.handler, ctx)
			if not ok then
				Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] handler error for %q: %s"):format(actionId, tostring(err)))
			end
		end
	end

	function runtime._onInputBegan(input, _gameProcessedEvent)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
		if wiring.isCapturing and wiring.isCapturing() then return end
		if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end

		-- The leader alone fires nothing.
		local leaderKC = _currentLeaderKeyCode()
		if leaderKC and input.KeyCode == leaderKC then return end
		-- A direct action on its key alone: never while the leader is held, and not while the
		-- Shortcuts panel is open (it may be binding that key).
		if not (leaderKC and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(leaderKC)) then
			local pressed = _buildComboFromInput(input)
			local direct = Bindings.isValidCombo(pressed) and _directIndex[Bindings.comboKey(pressed)]
			if direct then
				if not wiring.isOpen() then _dispatchActionId(direct) end
				return
			end
		end
		if not _isLeaderHeld() then return end
		local combo = _buildComboFromInput(input)
		if not Bindings.isValidCombo(combo) then return end
		local actionId = _index[Bindings.comboKey(combo)]
		if not actionId then return end
		-- Panel open: only ToggleShortcuts and ToggleUI (see the header).
		if wiring.isOpen() and actionId ~= "ToggleShortcuts" and actionId ~= "ToggleUI" then return end
		_dispatchActionId(actionId)
	end

	-- Bootstrap has called ensureSettings, so the settings are loaded.
	runtime._rebuildIndex()
	runtime._pushWorkspaceKeys()
	wiring.setOnChanged(function()
		runtime._rebuildIndex()
		runtime._pushWorkspaceKeys()
	end)
	WorkspaceKeys.setGate(wiring.captureHoldsKeys)

	local conn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(runtime._onInputBegan)
	if Connections then
		Connections["ShortcutsRuntime"] = conn
	end

	function runtime.stop()
		if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
		wiring.setOnChanged(nil)
		-- The workspace keys stay as they are: Modules/Workspaces runs on without this UI.
		WorkspaceKeys.setGate(nil)
		_index = {}
	end

	return runtime
end

return Runtime

--[[
	Wiring  -  ShortcutKey panel state machine

	The Shortcuts panel: a row per implemented action (filtered by the search box), with a Bind
	button that captures the next key and an X that clears it, plus the leader row and Reset.
	  require(Wiring)(deps) -> mod: open, close, isOpen, isCapturing, captureHoldsKeys, populate,
	    reset, ensureSettings, getSettings, setOnChanged, destroy
	  deps: ctx (plugin, Actions), panel = {panel, scrollList, searchBox, resetBtn, headerCloseBtn,
	    leaderLabel, leaderSetBtn, leaderClearBtn}, Bindings, Connections, Widgets, Theme
	A capture ends on Esc, on a valid key (a modifier alone waits for one), or on another row's
	Bind. A combo another action holds on the same press moves to the new action, and the old row
	says so for 3 s. Every save calls the setOnChanged callback (Runtime rebuilds its index).
	Reset takes a second click within 3 s: chords unbound, direct actions back on their defaults.
	Direct actions (`direct = true`: the workspace keys) are bound without the leader.
	Shortcuts/WorkspaceKeys asks captureHoldsKeys() before acting, so the press that binds a key
	does not also run it. Settings load on first use, as Runtime reads them before the panel opens.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local plugin = ctx.plugin
	local Actions = ctx.Actions
	local panel = deps.panel.panel
	local scrollList = deps.panel.scrollList
	local searchBox = deps.panel.searchBox
	local resetBtn = deps.panel.resetBtn
	local leaderLabel = deps.panel.leaderLabel
	local leaderSetBtn = deps.panel.leaderSetBtn
	local leaderClearBtn = deps.panel.leaderClearBtn
	local Bindings = deps.Bindings
	local Widgets = deps.Widgets
	local Theme = deps.Theme
	local Connections = deps.Connections

	local W = Widgets
	local T = Theme
	local mod = {}

	local _settings -- Bindings.load's table
	local _open = false
	local _captureActionId = nil
	local _captureConn = nil
	-- When the last capture ended. The press that ends a capture reaches the other input
	-- listeners in the same frame, in an order the engine does not promise.
	local _captureEndedAt = -math.huge
	local CAPTURE_SETTLE_SECONDS = 0.1
	-- Declared here so _startCapture can stop a leader capture.
	local _leaderCapturing = false
	local _leaderCaptureConn = nil
	local _rows = {} -- actionId -> {frame, comboLabel, bindBtn, unbindBtn}
	local _conflictTimer = nil
	local _destroyed = false
	-- Runtime's callback, fired after every save (bind, clear, reset, leader).
	local _onChanged = nil
	local function _fireChanged()
		if _onChanged then pcall(_onChanged) end
	end
	-- Labels say Cmd instead of Win when the plugin setting DisplayCmdAsMeta is true (the plugin API
	-- cannot tell the OS); read on every open.
	local _isMac = false
	local function _refreshIsMac()
		local v = plugin:GetSetting("DisplayCmdAsMeta")
		_isMac = (type(v) == "boolean") and v or false
	end

	-- The leader an action's combo is shown and captured with: none for a direct action.
	local function _leaderFor(actionId)
		if Bindings.isDirect(Actions, actionId) then
			return false
		end
		return Bindings.getLeaderKey(_settings)
	end

	local function _stopCapture(reason)
		if _captureConn then
			_captureConn:Disconnect()
			_captureConn = nil
			_captureEndedAt = os.clock()
		end
		_captureActionId = nil
		-- Rebuilding the rows restores their labels.
		mod.populate()
	end

	-- {actionId, expiresAt, message}: populate shows the message in red on that row until expiresAt.
	local _conflictNotice = nil

	local function _commitCombo(actionId, combo)
		-- nil when an InputBegan in flight races _stopCapture.
		if type(actionId) ~= "string" or actionId == "" then return false end
		if not Bindings.isValidCombo(combo) then return false end
		mod.ensureSettings()
		local owner = Bindings.findOwner(_settings, combo, Actions, actionId)
		if owner and owner ~= actionId then
			Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] %s overrides previous binding %s -> %s"):format(
				tostring(actionId), tostring(owner), Bindings.formatCombo(combo, _isMac, _leaderFor(actionId))))
			Bindings.clear(_settings, Actions, owner)
			-- The row that lost its binding says so for 3 s.
			local newName = (Actions[actionId] and Actions[actionId].displayName) or actionId
			_conflictNotice = {
				actionId = owner,
				expiresAt = os.clock() + 3,
				message = "Reassigned to " .. newName,
			}
			if _conflictTimer then pcall(task.cancel, _conflictTimer); _conflictTimer = nil end
			_conflictTimer = task.delay(3, function()
				_conflictTimer = nil
				if _destroyed then return end
				if _conflictNotice and _conflictNotice.actionId == owner then
					_conflictNotice = nil
					mod.populate()
				end
			end)
		end
		Bindings.assign(_settings, actionId, combo)
		Bindings.save(plugin, _settings)
		_fireChanged()
		return true
	end

	local function _startCapture(actionId)
		-- Any armed capture stops first, or a double-click would leave its listener alive.
		if _captureConn then _stopCapture("rearm") end
		-- A leader capture stops too: the next key must commit as a chord.
		if _leaderCaptureConn then
			_leaderCaptureConn:Disconnect()
			_leaderCaptureConn = nil
			_leaderCapturing = false
			-- _refreshLeaderLabel is defined below this function.
			if leaderLabel then
				local lk = Bindings.getLeaderKey(_settings)
				leaderLabel.Text = lk == false and "Leader: (none)" or ("Leader: " .. tostring(lk))
				leaderLabel.TextColor3 = lk == false and T.MutedGold or T.BrightGold
			end
		end
		_captureActionId = actionId
		local row = _rows[actionId]
		if row and row.comboLabel then
			local leaderName = _leaderFor(actionId)
			local hint = leaderName == false
				and "Press key... (Esc cancels)"
				or ("Press key... (hold "..tostring(leaderName).." + key; Esc cancels)")
			row.comboLabel.Text = hint
		end
		-- Pinned here, so an InputBegan in flight when _stopCapture clears _captureActionId still commits
		-- to the right action.
		local capturingActionId = actionId
		-- InputBegan sees combos Studio binds too; modifiers are read with IsKeyDown.
		_captureConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
			-- Escape cancels even with a TextBox focused; other keys typed in a TextBox are not chords.
			if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then _stopCapture("escape"); return end
			if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
			-- The leader is held first, so its own press is never the chord key.
			local leaderName = Bindings.getLeaderKey(_settings)
			if leaderName ~= false and input.KeyCode.Name == leaderName then return end
			local kcName = input.KeyCode.Name
			-- Built as Runtime's _buildComboFromInput builds it, so the comboKeys match.
			local combo = {
				key = kcName,
				ctrl = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl),
				alt = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt),
				shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift),
				meta = false,
			}
			-- pcall: LeftMeta is missing on some Studio runtimes.
			pcall(function()
				combo.meta = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftMeta) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightMeta)
			end)
			if not Bindings.isValidCombo(combo) then return end -- a modifier alone: wait for the key
			if _commitCombo(capturingActionId, combo) then _stopCapture("commit") end
		end)
		-- Through ConnectionManager too, so unloading mid-capture disconnects it.
		if Connections then Connections["ShortcutsCapture"] = _captureConn end
	end

	-- Leader capture: like chord capture, but a KeyCode alone, no modifiers.

	local function _refreshLeaderLabel()
		if not leaderLabel then return end
		local lk = Bindings.getLeaderKey(_settings)
		if lk == false then
			leaderLabel.Text = "Leader: (none)"
			leaderLabel.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		else
			leaderLabel.Text = "Leader: " .. tostring(lk)
			leaderLabel.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		end
	end

	local function _stopLeaderCapture(_reason)
		if _leaderCaptureConn then
			_leaderCaptureConn:Disconnect()
			_leaderCaptureConn = nil
			_captureEndedAt = os.clock()
		end
		_leaderCapturing = false
		_refreshLeaderLabel()
	end

	-- A modifier as leader would leave no key to press with it.
	local LEADER_MODIFIER_REJECT = {
		LeftControl = true, RightControl = true, LeftAlt = true, RightAlt = true,
		LeftShift = true, RightShift = true, LeftMeta = true, RightMeta = true,
		LeftSuper = true, RightSuper = true,
	}

	local function _startLeaderCapture()
		if _leaderCaptureConn then _stopLeaderCapture("rearm") end
		-- Stops a chord capture, or the next key would bind both.
		if _captureConn then _stopCapture("leader-rearm") end
		mod.ensureSettings()
		_leaderCapturing = true
		if leaderLabel then
			leaderLabel.Text = "Press leader key... (Esc cancels)"
			leaderLabel.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		end
		_leaderCaptureConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
			if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then _stopLeaderCapture("escape"); return end
			if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
			local kcName = input.KeyCode.Name
			if LEADER_MODIFIER_REJECT[kcName] then return end
			local clean, ok = Bindings.isValidLeader(kcName)
			if not ok then return end
			_settings.leaderKey = clean
			-- A direct action on the new leader's key gives it up.
			Bindings.normalize(_settings, Actions)
			Bindings.save(plugin, _settings)
			_fireChanged()
			_stopLeaderCapture("commit")
			mod.populate() -- chords show the new leader
		end)
		if Connections then Connections["ShortcutsLeaderCapture"] = _leaderCaptureConn end
	end

	local function _clearLeader()
		mod.ensureSettings()
		if _leaderCaptureConn then _stopLeaderCapture("clear") end
		_settings.leaderKey = false
		-- Without a leader a combo has one owner: a chord keeps it over a direct action.
		Bindings.normalize(_settings, Actions)
		Bindings.save(plugin, _settings)
		_fireChanged()
		_refreshLeaderLabel()
		mod.populate()
	end

	local function _makeRow(parent, actionId, def, layoutOrder)
		-- Row height 24, as the Settings panel's rows.
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Name = "Row_" .. actionId
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 24)
		row.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
		row.Parent = parent

		-- Name 130 px; the combo fills the rest but the 74 px the Bind and X buttons take on the right.
		local nameBlob = W.makeBlob("Name", row, UDim2.new(0, 130, 1, -2))
		nameBlob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1)
		W.addPadding(nameBlob, 6, 4, 0, 0)
		local nameLabel = W.makeLabel("L", nameBlob, def.displayName or actionId, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 10)
		nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

		local comboBlob = W.makeBlob("Combo", row, UDim2.new(1, -208, 1, -2))
		comboBlob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 134, 0, 1)
		W.addPadding(comboBlob, 6, 4, 0, 0)
		local comboLabel = W.makeLabel("L", comboBlob, "(unbound)", T.BrightGold, T.Font, 10)
		comboLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		comboLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

		-- Anchored right: X at -4, Bind at -(4 + 22 + 4).
		local unbindBtn = W.makeButton("Unbind_"..actionId, row, "X", UDim2.new(0, 22, 1, -4), T.DarkGold)
		unbindBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		unbindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 2)
		unbindBtn.TextSize = 10

		local bindBtn = W.makeButton("Bind_"..actionId, row, "Bind", UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, -4), T.DarkGold)
		bindBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		bindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 2)
		bindBtn.TextSize = 10

		bindBtn.Activated:Connect(function() _startCapture(actionId) end)
		unbindBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- Stops any capture, not just this row's: populate is about to destroy its prompt.
			if _captureConn then _stopCapture("unbind") end
			Bindings.clear(_settings, Actions, actionId)
			Bindings.save(plugin, _settings)
			_fireChanged()
			mod.populate()
		end)

		_rows[actionId] = {
			frame = row, comboLabel = comboLabel,
			bindBtn = bindBtn, unbindBtn = unbindBtn,
		}
		return row
	end

	local function _makeCategoryHeader(parent, name, layoutOrder, text)
		local hdr = Instance.new("Frame")
		hdr.Name = "Cat_" .. name
		hdr.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hdr.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 20)
		hdr.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
		hdr.Parent = parent
		W.addPadding(hdr, 4, 0, 4, 0)
		local lbl = W.makeLabel("L", hdr, text or name, T.Gold, T.Font, 11)
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	end

	function mod.populate()
		for _, child in ipairs(scrollList:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") or (child:IsA("TextLabel") and child.Name:sub(1,4) == "Cat_") or child.Name == "Placeholder" then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		_rows = {}
		local filter = (searchBox and searchBox.Text or ""):lower()
		-- Group by category, in this order.
		local categoryOrder = {"UI", "Tools", "Edit", "Animate", "Emit", "Editor", "Selection", "Workspaces"}
		local byCat = {}
		for actionId, def in pairs(Actions) do
			if def.implemented == true then
				local matchesFilter = filter == "" or
					(def.displayName or actionId):lower():find(filter, 1, true) ~= nil or
					actionId:lower():find(filter, 1, true) ~= nil
				if matchesFilter then
					local cat = def.category or "Other"
					byCat[cat] = byCat[cat] or {}
					table.insert(byCat[cat], {actionId = actionId, def = def})
				end
			end
		end
		local layoutOrder = 0
		for _, cat in ipairs(categoryOrder) do
			local rows = byCat[cat]
			if rows and #rows > 0 then
				-- A category of direct actions says so: its rows show a key without the leader.
				local headerText = cat
				if rows[1].def.direct then
					headerText = cat .. "  (key alone, no leader)"
				end
				_makeCategoryHeader(scrollList, cat, layoutOrder, headerText); layoutOrder = layoutOrder + 1
				table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.actionId < b.actionId end)
				for _, entry in ipairs(rows) do
					_makeRow(scrollList, entry.actionId, entry.def, layoutOrder)
					-- An active conflict notice shows instead of the combo, in red.
					local combo = _settings.bindings[entry.actionId]
					local cl = _rows[entry.actionId].comboLabel
					if _conflictNotice and _conflictNotice.actionId == entry.actionId and os.clock() < _conflictNotice.expiresAt then
						cl.Text = _conflictNotice.message
						cl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
					else
						cl.Text = combo and Bindings.formatCombo(combo, _isMac, _leaderFor(entry.actionId)) or "(unbound)"
						cl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
					end
					layoutOrder = layoutOrder + 1
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function mod.ensureSettings()
		if _settings == nil then
			-- An error in load() must not stop the plugin's start: fall back to fresh bindings.
			local ok, result = pcall(Bindings.load, plugin, Actions)
			if ok and type(result) == "table" then
				_settings = result
			else
				Log.warn("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] Bindings.load failed; using defaults: "..tostring(result))
				_settings = {version = Bindings.VERSION, overlayEnabled = true, bindings = Bindings._copyDefaults(), unbound = {}}
				pcall(Bindings.normalize, _settings, Actions)
			end
		end
		return _settings
	end

	local _resetArmed = false
	local _resetArmedAt = 0
	local _resetConfirmWindow = 3
	local _resetOriginalText = resetBtn and resetBtn.Text or "Reset all"
	local function _disarmReset()
		_resetArmed = false
		if resetBtn then resetBtn.Text = _resetOriginalText end
	end
	function mod.reset()
		mod.ensureSettings()
		Bindings.reset(_settings, Actions)
		Bindings.save(plugin, _settings)
		_disarmReset()
		-- A key pressed after Reset must not bind the row just cleared.
		if _captureConn then _stopCapture("reset") end
		_fireChanged()
		mod.populate()
	end
	local function _onResetClick()
		if not _open then return end
		if _resetArmed and (os.clock() - _resetArmedAt) <= _resetConfirmWindow then
			mod.reset()
			return
		end
		_resetArmed = true
		_resetArmedAt = os.clock()
		if resetBtn then resetBtn.Text = "Click again to confirm" end
		task.delay(_resetConfirmWindow, function()
			-- Skips when Reset already ran or a later click armed it again.
			if _resetArmed and (os.clock() - _resetArmedAt) >= _resetConfirmWindow - 0.05 then
				_disarmReset()
			end
		end)
	end

	function mod.open()
		if _open then return end
		_open = true
		mod.ensureSettings()
		_refreshIsMac() -- DisplayCmdAsMeta may have changed
		_refreshLeaderLabel()
		panel.Visible = true
		mod.populate()
	end

	function mod.close()
		if not _open then return end
		_open = false
		_stopCapture("close")
		_stopLeaderCapture("close")
		_disarmReset()
		panel.Visible = false
	end

	-- Plugin unload: cancels the conflict timer and any capture's listener.
	function mod.destroy()
		_destroyed = true
		if _captureConn then _captureConn:Disconnect(); _captureConn = nil end
		_captureActionId = nil
		if _leaderCaptureConn then _leaderCaptureConn:Disconnect(); _leaderCaptureConn = nil end
		_leaderCapturing = false
		if _conflictTimer then pcall(task.cancel, _conflictTimer); _conflictTimer = nil end
		_conflictNotice = nil
	end

	function mod.isOpen() return _open end
	function mod.isCapturing() return _captureActionId ~= nil or _leaderCapturing end

	-- True while a key press belongs to a capture: one is armed, or one just ended.
	function mod.captureHoldsKeys()
		if mod.isCapturing() then
			return true
		end
		return os.clock() - _captureEndedAt < CAPTURE_SETTLE_SECONDS
	end

	function mod.getSettings()
		return mod.ensureSettings()
	end

	function mod.setOnChanged(callback)
		_onChanged = callback
	end

	-- Through ConnectionManager, so plugin teardown disconnects them.
	if Connections then
		if searchBox then
			Connections["ShortcutsSearchChanged"] = searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
				if _open then mod.populate() end
			end)
		end
		if resetBtn then
			Connections["ShortcutsReset"] = resetBtn.Activated:Connect(_onResetClick)
		end
		if leaderSetBtn then
			Connections["ShortcutsLeaderSet"] = leaderSetBtn.Activated:Connect(_startLeaderCapture)
		end
		if leaderClearBtn then
			Connections["ShortcutsLeaderClear"] = leaderClearBtn.Activated:Connect(_clearLeader)
		end
	else
		-- Without Connections (Bootstrap always passes them) these never disconnect.
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles Shortcuts] Wiring built without Connections  -  search/reset signals are dangling")
		if searchBox then searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() if _open then mod.populate() end end) end
		if resetBtn then resetBtn.Activated:Connect(_onResetClick) end
		if leaderSetBtn then leaderSetBtn.Activated:Connect(_startLeaderCapture) end
		if leaderClearBtn then leaderClearBtn.Activated:Connect(_clearLeader) end
	end

	return mod
end

--[[
	WorkspaceKeys  -  which key does what in Modules/Workspaces: the bindings, and the test of a
	key press against them.
	  WorkspaceKeys.DEFAULTS            { next, send, new, merge, bar } -> combo
	  WorkspaceKeys.set(combos, leader) combos: the same names -> combo, a name left out is
	                                    unbound; leader: KeyCode name of the shortcut leader, or false
	  WorkspaceKeys.setGate(isBlocked)  a function that returns true while the keys must not act
	                                    (a shortcut is being captured); nil clears it
	  WorkspaceKeys.match(input) -> name or nil
	A combo is { key = KeyCode name, ctrl, alt, shift, meta }, as Shortcuts/Bindings stores it.
	Matching: a press that equals a combo exactly wins. Otherwise a combo without modifiers also
	takes the press with Shift held, as long as Ctrl, Alt and Meta are up and the key is not a
	letter: "=" and "+" are one key. The keypad's plus and minus count as "=" and "-".
	Nothing acts while the leader is held (another shortcut is in progress) or a TextBox has focus.
	Cross-file invariants: Modules/Workspaces calls match() from its own input listener, which
	keeps running while the plugin's UI is toggled off, so the bindings set here outlive the UI.
	Shortcuts/Runtime calls set() on every setup and after every change in the Shortcuts panel;
	the names are the `workspaceKey` fields of the Workspace actions in Modules/Actions.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local function combo(key, shift)
	return { key = key, ctrl = false, alt = false, shift = shift == true, meta = false }
end

local ALIASES = { KeypadPlus = "Equals", KeypadMinus = "Minus" }

local WorkspaceKeys = {}

WorkspaceKeys.DEFAULTS = {
	next = combo("Slash"),
	send = combo("Slash", true),
	new = combo("Equals"),
	merge = combo("Minus"),
	bar = combo("H"),
}

local combos = WorkspaceKeys.DEFAULTS
local leader = nil
local gate = nil

-- Enum.KeyCode raises on a name it does not have (LeftMeta is missing on some runtimes).
local function keyCode(name)
	local found, code = pcall(function()
		return Enum.KeyCode[name]
	end)
	if found then
		return code
	end
	return nil
end

local function eitherDown(leftName, rightName)
	local left = keyCode(leftName)
	local right = keyCode(rightName)
	if left and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(left) then
		return true
	end
	return right ~= nil and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(right)
end

function WorkspaceKeys.set(newCombos, leaderName)
	combos = newCombos
	leader = nil
	if type(leaderName) == "string" then
		leader = keyCode(leaderName)
	end
end

function WorkspaceKeys.setGate(isBlocked)
	gate = isBlocked
end

function WorkspaceKeys.match(input)
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		return nil
	end
	if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		return nil
	end
	if gate and gate() then
		return nil
	end
	if leader and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(leader) then
		return nil
	end

	local key = ALIASES[input.KeyCode.Name] or input.KeyCode.Name
	local ctrl = eitherDown("LeftControl", "RightControl")
	local alt = eitherDown("LeftAlt", "RightAlt")
	local shift = eitherDown("LeftShift", "RightShift")
	local meta = eitherDown("LeftMeta", "RightMeta")
	-- Letter keys are named by one character; Shift with a letter is a different shortcut.
	local shiftIsSameKey = #key > 1 and not (ctrl or alt or meta)

	local loose = nil
	for name, bound in pairs(combos) do
		if bound.key == key then
			if bound.ctrl == ctrl and bound.alt == alt and bound.shift == shift and bound.meta == meta then
				return name
			end
			local bare = not (bound.ctrl or bound.alt or bound.shift or bound.meta)
			if bare and shiftIsSameKey then
				loose = name
			end
		end
	end
	return loose
end

return WorkspaceKeys

--[[

	updates; a copy from anywhere else (the last GitHub release, `release.js final`) shows a banner
	once a Studio session that points to the store page.
	  StoreChannel.NAME            "store"; `release.js final` writes "github" into its build
	  StoreChannel.STORE_URL       the plugin's Creator Store page; `release.js final` refuses it empty
	  StoreChannel.notify(plugin)  outside the store: the banner, once a session
	  StoreChannel.farewell(since) outside the store, when the store copy runs here too (SettingsHandoff):
	                               a thank-you in the banner's place; `since` the first start (os.time)
	  StoreChannel.clear()         removes the banner (also one a v45 updater left)
]]

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local StoreChannel = {}

-- server/release.js finds and rewrites these two lines: keep their shape.
StoreChannel.NAME = "github"
StoreChannel.STORE_URL = "https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/78969824830970/Qwinkles-Particles-2"

-- The name the v45 updater gave its banner, so one sweep clears either.
local BANNER_NAME = "PartIclesUpdate"
-- The thank-you's own: the store copy clears the banner above at every build.
local FAREWELL_NAME = "PartIclesFarewell"
local BANNER_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(45, 85, 140)
local MESSAGE = "Part-Icles has moved to the Creator Store. Install it from there, then delete this copy from your Plugins folder."
local FAREWELL = "Thank you for every effect you made with this copy%s. Everything came with you to the Store version, so this one can rest now. You can delete it from your Plugins folder whenever you are ready."

local _shownThisSession = false

function StoreChannel.clear()
	local existing = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(BANNER_NAME)
	if existing then
		existing:Destroy()
	end
end

local function makeButton(frame, text, width, right)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	button.Text = text
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 225, 255)
	button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	button.TextSize = 11
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
	button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -right, 0, 0)
	button.Parent = frame
	return button
end

-- A bar named `name` across the top of the 3D view: the message on `lines` lines, then the buttons,
-- each { text, width, onPress }; a press of any closes the bar.
local function showBanner(name, message, lines, buttons)
	StoreChannel.clear()
	local previous = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(name)
	if previous then
		previous:Destroy()
	end
	local banner = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	banner.Name = name
	banner.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = BANNER_COLOR
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16 + 16 * lines)
	frame.Parent = banner

	local buttonsWidth = 30
	for _, button in ipairs(buttons) do
		buttonsWidth += button[2]
	end
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -buttonsWidth, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
	label.Text = message
	label.TextWrapped = lines > 1
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextSize = 12
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	label.Parent = frame

	local right = 10
	for index = #buttons, 1, -1 do
		local text, width, onPress = buttons[index][1], buttons[index][2], buttons[index][3]
		right += width
		local button = makeButton(frame, text, width, right)
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			if onPress then
				onPress()
			end
			banner:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	banner.Parent = CoreGui
end

function StoreChannel.notify(pluginRef)
	if StoreChannel.NAME == "store" or _shownThisSession then
		return
	end
	_shownThisSession = true
	showBanner(BANNER_NAME, MESSAGE, 1, {
		{ "Open store page", 110, function() pluginRef:OpenWikiPage(StoreChannel.STORE_URL) end },
		{ "Dismiss", 60, nil },
	})
end

function StoreChannel.farewell(since)
	if StoreChannel.NAME == "store" then
		return
	end
	local when = ""
	if type(since) == "number" then
		-- "4 March 2026": the day without its leading zero.
		when = " since " .. string.gsub(os.date("%d %B %Y", since), "^0", "")
	end
	showBanner(FAREWELL_NAME, string.format(FAREWELL, when), 2, { { "Goodbye", 70, nil } })
end

return StoreChannel

-- Builds the whole UI a few milliseconds per frame (BuildPacer); nil when teardown cancelled it.
-- With buildHidden (set by PanelPersistence.restart, read once) the UI stays hidden for the caller
-- while the old one stays on screen as RETIRED_UI_NAME.
UIBuilder.RETIRED_UI_NAME = "PartIclesUIOld"
function UIBuilder:Build(TypeRegistry)
	local started = os.clock()
	local build = BuildPacer.begin()
	local ok, result = xpcall(self._buildAll, debug.traceback, self, TypeRegistry)
	BuildPacer.finish(build)
	if ok and not build.cancelled then
		Log.print(string.format("[Part-Icles] UI built in %.2f s over %d frames", os.clock() - started, build.frames))
		return result
	end
	if build.screenGui then build.screenGui:Destroy() end
	if build.cancelled then return nil end
	error(result, 0)
end

-- Wired in init.server.lua (RandomizerWiring needs ctx); its refs join `ui` with a "Randomizer" prefix.

function UIBuilder:_buildAll(TypeRegistry)
	W.reset()
	-- Widgets read colours and metrics at build time.
	C.refresh()
	local hidden = UIBuilder.buildHidden == true
	UIBuilder.buildHidden = nil
	-- Also sweeps a UI a failed restart retired, unless it is on screen for this build.
	for _, old in pairs(game:GetService('CoreGui'):GetChildren()) do
		if old:IsA("ScreenGui") and (old.Name == "PartIclesUI" or (old.Name == UIBuilder.RETIRED_UI_NAME and not hidden)) then old:Destroy() end
	end
	local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui"); sg.Name = "PartIclesUI"; sg.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	sg.ResetOnSpawn = false; sg.Enabled = false; sg.Parent = game:GetService('CoreGui')
	UIBuilder._screenGui = sg
	-- The layout this UI is built for: UpdateTheme lays it out again when the theme's differs.
	UIBuilder._laidKey = C.layoutKey()
	BuildPacer.claim(sg)
	TypeScale.watch(sg)
	if W.setToastParent then W.setToastParent(sg) end
	-- The panel last pressed or opened draws on top (PanelStack): frames with a ZIndex under 20.
	-- Popups and modals built here keep theirs at 20 or above.
	W.watchPanelStack(sg)
	local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale"); uiScale.Scale = C.DEFAULT_UI_SCALE_PERCENT / 100 * C.BASE_UI_SCALE; uiScale.Parent = sg

	local hudRefs = buildHUD(sg)
	W.makeTray(hudRefs.HUD)
	-- The workspace bar lives outside this ScreenGui; it repaints with every theme change.
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, Workspaces.refreshTheme)
	local propRefs = BP.buildProperties(sg)
	local settingsRefs = buildSettings(sg)
	local toolbar = buildToolbar(sg)
	local counter, counterLabel = toolbar.counter, toolbar.counterLabel
	local optIndicator, optLabel = toolbar.optIndicator, toolbar.optLabel
	local toggleRefs = toolbar.toggles
	local toolBuilders = TP.builders()
	local qMenuRefs = toolBuilders.buildQMenu(sg)
	local deckRefs = TD.build(sg, TypeRegistry)
	local hueRefs = toolBuilders.buildHueChanger(sg)
	local emitCodeRefs = toolBuilders.buildEmitCode(sg)
	local renameRefs = require(script.RenamePanel).build(sg)
	local fixRefs = toolBuilders.buildFixBanner(sg)
	local themeRefs = buildThemeEditor(sg)
	local dotsMenuRefs = W.buildDotsMenu(sg)
	local inventoryRefs = IP.build(sg)
	local randomizerRefs, randomizerUI = buildRandomizer(sg)
	local shortcutRefs, shortcutUI = buildShortcuts(sg)

	-- A panel's default size: the one its builder lays for the layout, or the one it was made at.
	local function defaultSize(panel)
		return W.laidValue(panel, "Size") or panel.Size
	end

	-- Default positions from the default sizes: [Re:][PropertyTools][Properties] left to right, Hue
	-- and Emit Code bottom-left.
	local function defaultPositions()
		local dockGap = 6
		local toolsWidth = defaultSize(deckRefs.PropertyToolsDeck).X.Offset
		local reWidth = defaultSize(deckRefs.ReDeck).X.Offset
		local col1 = -(LAYOUT.PropsX + dockGap + toolsWidth)
		local col2 = -(LAYOUT.PropsX + dockGap + toolsWidth + dockGap + reWidth)
		local hueSize = defaultSize(hueRefs.HuePanel)
		local emitCodeSize = defaultSize(emitCodeRefs.EmitCodePanel)
		local randomizerSize = defaultSize(randomizerRefs.panel)
		local shortcutSize = defaultSize(shortcutRefs.panel)
		local bottomGap = 40
		return {
			[deckRefs.PropertyToolsDeck]    = UDim2.new(1, col1, 0, LAYOUT.PropsY),
			[deckRefs.ReDeck]               = UDim2.new(1, col2, 0, LAYOUT.PropsY),
			[hueRefs.HuePanel]             = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -(hueSize.Y.Offset + bottomGap)),
			[emitCodeRefs.EmitCodePanel]    = UDim2.new(0, 12 + hueSize.X.Offset + 8, 1, -(emitCodeSize.Y.Offset + bottomGap)),
			-- Centred modals: makeToolPanel sets no Position, so without an entry they pin to the top-left.
			[randomizerRefs.panel]          = UDim2.new(0.5, -randomizerSize.X.Offset / 2, 0.5, -randomizerSize.Y.Offset / 2),
			[shortcutRefs.panel]            = UDim2.new(0.5, -shortcutSize.X.Offset / 2, 0.5, -shortcutSize.Y.Offset / 2),
		}
	end

	-- The panels Reset Layout gives their default size again.
	local resizedPanels = { inventoryRefs.InventoryPanel }
	for panel in pairs(defaultPositions()) do
		table.insert(resizedPanels, panel)
		W.lay(panel, "Position", function()
			return defaultPositions()[panel]
		end)
	end
	-- From here Properties and the Inventory give way to a panel opened or moved over them (PanelPush).
	W.watchPanelPush(sg)

	W.registerPanel(hudRefs.HUD)
	W.registerPanel(propRefs.PropsPanel)
	W.registerPanel(settingsRefs.SettingsPanel)
	W.registerPanel(qMenuRefs.QMenu)
	W.registerPanel(deckRefs.ReDeck)
	W.registerPanel(deckRefs.PropertyToolsDeck)
	W.registerPanel(hueRefs.HuePanel)
	-- Selection tools fold into the HUD tray while nothing is selected (SelectionHandler calls autoTidy).
	W.registerTidyPanel(deckRefs.ReDeck)
	W.registerTidyPanel(deckRefs.PropertyToolsDeck)
	W.registerTidyPanel(hueRefs.HuePanel)
	W.registerPanel(inventoryRefs.InventoryPanel)
	-- Outside Classic the details are a bar inside the inventory panel, not a panel of their own.
	if inventoryRefs.InvDetail and inventoryRefs.InvDetail.Parent == sg then W.registerPanel(inventoryRefs.InvDetail) end

	local function resetLayout()
		-- Positions are set outright below: a pushed panel goes back to its own place first (PanelPush).
		W.releasePushes()
		for panel, pos in pairs(defaultPositions()) do panel.Position = pos end
		for _, panel in ipairs(resizedPanels) do panel.Size = defaultSize(panel) end
		hudRefs.HUD.Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.HudX, 0, LAYOUT.HudY)
		propRefs.PropsPanel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.PropsX, 0, LAYOUT.PropsY)
		qMenuRefs.QMenu.Position = W.laidValue(qMenuRefs.QMenu, "Position") or qMenuRefs.QMenu.Position
		inventoryRefs.InventoryPanel.Position = inventoryRefs.InvHome or UDim2.new(0.5, -240, 0.2, 0)
		if inventoryRefs.InvDetail then inventoryRefs.InvDetail.Visible = false end
		if inventoryRefs.InvImportDialog then inventoryRefs.InvImportDialog.Visible = false end
		if inventoryRefs.InvAddDialog then inventoryRefs.InvAddDialog.Visible = false end
	end

	-- QOLWiring wires the HUD and Properties close buttons (it has ctx).
	local function dimToggle(btn, panel)
		btn.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = not panel.Visible end)
	end
	-- A panel's toggle is lit exactly while the panel is visible, however it was shown or hidden.
	local function followPanel(btn, panel)
		toggleRefs.set(btn, panel.Visible)
		panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			toggleRefs.set(btn, panel.Visible)
		end)
	end
	followPanel(toggleRefs.counterToggle, counter)
	followPanel(toggleRefs.qolToggle, qMenuRefs.QMenu)
	followPanel(toggleRefs.settingsToggle, settingsRefs.SettingsPanel)
	followPanel(toggleRefs.inventoryToggle, inventoryRefs.InventoryPanel)
	settingsRefs.SettingsClose.Activated:Connect(function() settingsRefs.SettingsPanel.Visible = false end)
	dimToggle(toggleRefs.counterToggle, counter)
	dimToggle(toggleRefs.qolToggle, qMenuRefs.QMenu)

	-- QMenu buttons and shortcut Actions share these (deck tabs, deferred resolveOverlap, Settings
	-- colour); returned in `ui`.
	local function _toggleSolo(panel)
		panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
		if panel.Visible then task.defer(function() W.resolveOverlap(panel) end) end
	end
	local toolToggles = {
		toggleResize    = function() deckRefs.ReDeckApi.toggle("Size") end,
		toggleRetime    = function() deckRefs.ReDeckApi.toggle("Time") end,
		toggleReDeck    = function() deckRefs.ReDeckApi.toggle() end,
		toggleClipboard = function() deckRefs.PropertyToolsDeckApi.toggle("Clipboard") end,
		toggleShifter   = function() deckRefs.PropertyToolsDeckApi.toggle("Shifter") end,
		togglePropertyTools = function() deckRefs.PropertyToolsDeckApi.toggle() end,
		toggleHue       = function() _toggleSolo(hueRefs.HuePanel) end,
		toggleEmitCode  = function() _toggleSolo(emitCodeRefs.EmitCodePanel) end,
		toggleSettings  = function()
			settingsRefs.SettingsPanel.Visible = not settingsRefs.SettingsPanel.Visible
		end,
	}
	qMenuRefs.ReSizeTime.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleReDeck)
	qMenuRefs.Hue.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleHue)
	qMenuRefs.PropertyTools.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.togglePropertyTools)
	qMenuRefs.EmitCode.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleEmitCode)
	toggleRefs.settingsToggle.Activated:Connect(toolToggles.toggleSettings)
	settingsRefs.ResetLayout = resetLayout

	if settingsRefs.EditThemeButton then
		settingsRefs.EditThemeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			themeRefs.ThemeEditor.Visible = true
		end)
	end

	local ui = {}
	for _, tbl in ipairs({hudRefs, propRefs, settingsRefs, qMenuRefs, deckRefs, hueRefs, emitCodeRefs, renameRefs, fixRefs, themeRefs, dotsMenuRefs, inventoryRefs, randomizerUI, shortcutUI}) do
		for k, v in pairs(tbl) do ui[k] = v end
	end
	-- The theme's surfaces: drawn now, before it shows (over frames at start-up), and on widgets that
	-- later builds add (Skin); its sounds.
	Skin.apply(W.getThemed())
	-- Shown once built, so no half-built UI flashes; a hidden build is shown by its caller once wired.
	sg.Enabled = not hidden
	ui.ScreenGui = sg; ui.UIScale = uiScale; ui.Counter = counter; ui.CounterLabel = counterLabel
	ui.OptIndicator = optIndicator; ui.OptLabel = optLabel; ui.Toggles = toggleRefs
	for k, v in pairs(toolToggles) do ui[k] = v end
	ui.autoTidy = W.autoTidy
	Skin.watch(sg, W.getThemed())
	UISound.watch(sg, W.getThemed())
	return ui
end

-- Runs fn with Constants worked out from `doc`'s theme, then puts the UI's back; returns fn's

function UIBuilder.withTheme(doc, fn)

	if not ok then

	return result
end

--[[
	BuildPacer  -  spreads the startup UI build over frames.
	UIBuilder:Build marks its thread as paced: there step() yields once the build has run BUDGET_SECONDS
	this frame. On any other thread step() does nothing, so later rebuilds stay synchronous.
	BuildPacer.begin() -> build       on the building thread; build = { frames, cancelled, screenGui }
	BuildPacer.claim(screenGui)       the ScreenGui this thread's build fills (removed on cancel)
	BuildPacer.step()                 yields once the frame's budget is spent
	BuildPacer.finish(build)          the thread stops being paced
	BuildPacer.cancelAll()            every build in flight stops at its next step (teardown)
	A cancelled build raises BuildPacer.CANCELLED from step(); UIBuilder:Build catches it.
]]

local BuildPacer = {}

BuildPacer.CANCELLED = "Part-Icles UI build cancelled"
-- Building time per frame; Studio keeps the rest of a 60 fps frame.
local BUDGET_SECONDS = 0.008

local builds = {}

function BuildPacer.begin()
	local build = { frames = 0, cancelled = false, screenGui = nil, sliceStart = os.clock() }
	builds[coroutine.running()] = build
	return build
end

function BuildPacer.claim(screenGui)
	local build = builds[coroutine.running()]
	if build then build.screenGui = screenGui end
end

function BuildPacer.step()
	local build = builds[coroutine.running()]
	if not build or os.clock() - build.sliceStart < BUDGET_SECONDS then return end
	task.wait()
	build.frames += 1
	build.sliceStart = os.clock()
	if build.cancelled then error(BuildPacer.CANCELLED, 0) end
end

function BuildPacer.finish(build)
	for thread, entry in pairs(builds) do
		if entry == build then builds[thread] = nil end
	end
end

function BuildPacer.cancelAll()
	for _, build in pairs(builds) do
		build.cancelled = true
	end
end

return BuildPacer

local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local WidgetEvents = require(script.Parent.WidgetEvents)
local BuildPropertiesCameraShake = {}

local function appendEventsTo(typeRefs, section, typeName)
	if not section then return end
	local body = section:FindFirstChild("Body") or section
	typeRefs.Events = WidgetEvents.buildEventsSection(body, typeName, 100)
end

function BuildPropertiesCameraShake.buildSection(scroll, refs)
	local csDefs = {
		{name = "Emission", rows = {
			{key="EmissionMode", label="Mode", type="dropdown", options={"Emit","Animate"}, default="Emit"},
			{key="AnimateLoop",  label="Loop", type="toggle"},
			{key="Enabled",      label="Enabled", type="toggle"},
			{key="EmitMode",     label="Type", type="dropdown", options={"Auto","Burst"}, default="Auto"},
			{key="Rate",         label="Rate", type="input", default="10"},
			{key="Lifetime",     label="Lifetime", type="input", default="0.5, 0.5", placeholder="min, max"},
			{key="Timescale",    label="Timescale", type="graph"},
		}},
		-- Amplitudes are envelopes over life; noise spans about ±0.5, so the peak offset is about half.
		{name = "Shake", rows = {
			{key="ShakeAmplitude",    label="Amplitude", type="graph"},
			{key="ShakeRotAmplitude", label="Rot. Amplitude", type="graph"},
			{key="ShakeFrequency",    label="Frequency", type="graph"},
			{key="ShakeFalloff",      label="Falloff", type="input", default="0", placeholder="studs, 0=global"},
		}},
		{name = "Advanced", collapsed = true, rows = {
			{key="Keyframes",  label="Anim. Steps", type="input", default="100"},
		}},
	}
	refs.CameraShakeSection, refs.CameraShake = W.buildTypeSection(scroll, "Camera Shakes", csDefs, 3)
	refs.CameraShakeSection.Visible = false
	appendEventsTo(refs.CameraShake, refs.CameraShakeSection, "CameraShake")
end

return BuildPropertiesCameraShake
